Job Description

The ServiceNow Partner Design Studio is looking for a Partner Solution Engineer with a passion for innovation, design standards, and cutting-edge architecture practices. This is a unique opportunity to shape partner-branded solutions using an AI-first approach — where AI is embedded into every step of design and solutioning. You will help partners design, validate, and accelerate differentiated solutions on the Now Platform through design thinking, deep technical architecture, and go-to-market alignment, ensuring every solution is AI-ready, scalable, and outcome-driven. 

As a pooled, forward-deployed engineering authority, you will work across partners as a force multiplier focused on standards, reuse, and quality, certifying into Practices to bring domain depth where it’s needed. By applying the FLIGHT design thinking framework and maintaining architectural rigor, you will accelerate partner time-to-value by up to 2x while establishing reusable patterns and reference architectures that scale across the entire partner ecosystem. 

What You’ll Do 

As a Partner Solution Engineer, you will define the reference architectures, design standards, and validated patterns that partners build to — serving as the forward-deployed technical authority for AI-infused ServiceNow solutions that address real-world business challenges. 

AI-First Solution Blueprints & Design Workshops 

  • Lead design workshops using the FLIGHT framework to define AI-native reference patterns and set the solution standards partners build to on the Now Platform. 

  • Apply an AI-first mindset in all partner engagements — from design workshops to solution architecture — ensuring partners are equipped to lead in an AI-driven market. 

  • Translate partner ideas and industry opportunities into actionable blueprints, validated architectures, and minimum viable product specifications. 

  • Drive conversations around market positioning, industry opportunities, and how AI can create differentiated solutions. 

Technical Architecture & Validation 

  • Provide expert architecture and AI readiness guidance ensuring partner solutions meet ServiceNow standards for quality, performance, and simplicity. 

  • Conduct deep architectural reviews for net-new patterns, complex multi-product integrations, and advanced AI/agentic scenarios. 

  • Evaluate solution architectures against the Partner Co-Innovation Framework including upgrade survivability, security posture, and scalability. 

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to align partner innovations with ServiceNow platform priorities and AI strategy. 

Reusable Patterns & Standards 

  • Capture, document, and publish repeatable patterns, architectures, and design frameworks (Orbital, FLIGHT) to scale partner innovation across the ecosystem. 

  • Develop industry-specific reference architectures for verticals including Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, and Public Sector. 

  • Contribute validated patterns to the Pattern Library for use by partners across all Co-Innovation Maturity Tiers. 

  • Continuously refine design frameworks and delivery methods to enhance partner experience and measurable business outcomes. 

Partner Enablement & Strategic Alignment 

  • Mentor partner design and solution teams, building capability in AI-native solution development and Now Platform extensibility. 

  • Provide educational design reviews for Foundation-tier partners to accelerate learning and capability development. 

  • Support partners in defining go-to-market strategies, technical goals, and measurable outcomes through the lens of AI-enhanced capabilities. 

  • Promote partner success stories, highlighting business impact and thought leadership through structured design and standards engagements. 

Qualifications

Required: 

  • 8+ years in solution architecture, technical sales, pre-sales, or similar roles with deep platform architecture experience. 

  • Significant experience working with technology partners at either a partner or OEM level, including solution design and reference-architecture definition. 

  • Strong grasp of cloud platform architecture including SaaS, PaaS, automation, and multi-tenancy patterns. 

  • Proven ability to guide partners through complex solution designs and business strategy discussions. 

  • Deep curiosity and expertise in AI technologies, emerging trends, and design thinking methodologies. 

  • Clear communicator comfortable engaging at the CxO level, translating complex technical topics into actionable business insights. 

  • Experience facilitating workshops, design sessions, and collaborative innovation exercises that produce tangible outcomes. 

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. 

Preferred & Standout Experience: 

  • ServiceNow platform development experience and/or ServiceNow certifications (CSA, CAD, CIS, architectural certifications). 

  • Design Thinking training or certification; experience applying human-centered design principles in partner-facing design and standards work. 

  • AI and automation expertise: knowledge of generative AI, predictive analytics, or automation tools in enterprise solutions. 

  • Business development background: experience developing partner go-to-market plans or new solution plays. 

  • Industry experience in Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, or Public Sector. 

  • Familiarity with competitive cloud or enterprise software platforms. 

What This Role Does Not Do 

  • Perform platform configuration, development, or solution delivery for partners (guides architecture, does not build). 

  • Own commercial contracts, pricing, or financial program management. 

  • Serve as dedicated partner-assigned resource (operates as pooled, forward-deployed engineering authority). 

  • Replace Partner Technology Architects for holistic partner strategy or business development.

Job Description

Senior Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Search Infrastructure About the Role

Join us as we build the next generation of enterprise search infrastructure powering AI agents. Our mission is to evolve from traditional product-specific search systems into a composable, agent-native platform that enables agents and applications to discover, retrieve, reason over, and recommend information across heterogeneous enterprise data sources.

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will be the technical owner for foundational search infrastructure that serves as the backbone of our agentic platform. You will drive the architecture, scalability, and evolution of core indexing and retrieval systems while partnering closely with Search Ranking, ML, Platform, and AI teams to deliver production-grade search capabilities that power agent experiences across the company.

What You'll Do Own Core Search Infrastructure

  • Lead the design, development, and operation of critical search infrastructure components, including indexing systems, ingestion pipelines, metadata enrichment frameworks, and retrieval foundations that support a growing ecosystem of AI agents.
  • Drive technical strategy and architectural decisions across multiple search infrastructure domains, ensuring the platform scales to support future agent use cases and expanding enterprise datasets.
  • Serve as the technical authority for the end-to-end search lifecycle, from content ingestion through retrieval and ranking.

Build Next-Generation Indexing Systems

  • Design and operate large-scale hybrid indexing architectures that combine sparse retrieval, dense vector search, semantic retrieval, and emerging indexing approaches.
  • Establish clean abstractions and interfaces that allow downstream ranking systems and AI agents to leverage search capabilities consistently across multiple retrieval paradigms.
  • Drive innovations that improve search quality, latency, scalability, and cost efficiency across billions of indexed entities.

Lead Enterprise Data Intelligence

  • Architect high-throughput ingestion and enrichment pipelines that transform enterprise content into rich, permission-aware representations optimized for agent consumption.
  • Define strategies for content parsing, chunking, embedding generation, entity extraction, metadata enrichment, and access control enforcement.
  • Ensure consistency between index-time representations and query-time retrieval mechanisms to provide reliable foundations for agent reasoning.

Advance Multi-Modal Search

  • Lead the evolution of indexing and retrieval systems across diverse enterprise content types, including text, structured data, images, diagrams, audio, and video.
  • Develop unified frameworks that enable agents to discover and reason across modalities through a consistent retrieval experience.
  • Partner with ML and AI teams to bring emerging multi-modal capabilities into production.

Drive Knowledge and Entity Infrastructure

  • Contribute to the design and evolution of enterprise knowledge graph capabilities that connect people, content, tickets, documents, conversations, and business entities.
  • Lead initiatives that improve entity resolution, relationship modeling, and contextual understanding throughout the search platform.
  • Enable richer retrieval and agent reasoning through high-quality enterprise knowledge representations.

Scale Reliability and Performance

  • Own key platform metrics including search latency, indexing throughput, retrieval quality, infrastructure efficiency, and cluster health.
  • Drive operational excellence through observability, capacity planning, resiliency engineering, and lifecycle management.
  • Lead efforts to optimize infrastructure costs while maintaining high-performance retrieval experiences at scale.

Technical Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship for engineers across the organization.
  • Influence roadmap and architectural direction through technical vision, design reviews, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Drive alignment across Search Infrastructure, Ranking, ML, and Platform teams to deliver cohesive solutions to complex engineering challenges.
  • Lead multi-quarter initiatives that span teams and materially advance the capabilities of the agentic search platform.

Qualifications

Qualifications Required

  • BS or MS in Computer Science or a related technical field; PhD is a plus.
  • 8-12+ years of industry experience building large-scale distributed systems, search platforms, or data infrastructure.
  • Deep hands-on experience with search technologies such as Lucene, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Solr, or comparable retrieval systems.
  • Strong experience designing and operating distributed systems at scale, including storage, indexing, serving, and data processing infrastructure.
  • Experience building and scaling production systems that leverage vector search, embeddings, retrieval systems, or AI-driven search capabilities.
  • Proven track record of leading complex technical initiatives across teams and influencing architectural decisions beyond an individual team's scope.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance technical depth with pragmatic delivery and operational excellence.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $190,900 - $334,100, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits.  Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure.  Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies and work location.  We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs.  

Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location. 

Preferred

  • Experience with information retrieval, ranking systems, recommendation systems, or AI-powered search platforms.
  • Experience with knowledge graphs, entity resolution systems, or enterprise data modeling.
  • Familiarity with modern retrieval approaches including dense retrieval, RAG architectures, hybrid search, and semantic indexing.
  • Experience operating large-scale search clusters and performance-sensitive distributed infrastructure.
  • Background working closely with ML or AI platform teams to productionize intelligent retrieval systems.

Culture

  • Passion for collaborating in a highly engaged, in-person engineering culture.

Program Directors (EMs) lead and drive multiple Expert Service engagements, ensuring on-time, on-budget delivery of solutions to achieve customer business outcomes. They are the key point of communication and coordination for the delivery team, keeping the project on track by establishing and maintaining governance forums, mitigating risks and issues, and driving rapid and effective decision-making, escalating issues as required.  

Job Responsibilities  

  • Manage multiple ES engagement workstreams, leveraging a deep understanding of project impacts, cross effects, and alternative actions.  

  • Proactively develop and implement plans to address risks, issues, and escalations.  

  • Drive problem resolution through swift escalation and clear responsibility division.  

  • Identify discrepancies between actual progress and planned objectives, driving effective resolutions.  

  • Coach, mentor, and lead Principal Engagement Managers and Senior Engagement Managers in large complex projects.  

  • Influence, support and provide thought leadership to the customer during times of ambiguity or conflict.  

  • Lead the delivery team throughout the engagement, often in collaboration with a services partner.

  • Collaborate with the Sales Account Team, partner and customer to understand the customer and the engagement; including business challenges, key stakeholders, issues and business value being delivered.  

  • Understand the business objectives and align the deliverables accordingly.  

  • Act as a thought leader, applying expertise from the Now Create methodology and prescriptive guidance to drive successful delivery of the engagement, including long term customer success.  

  • Accountable for communication and acts as the single point of contact to facilitate collaboration, decision making and customer buy-in on proposed solutions.  

  • Coach, mentor and manage Customer Outcomes and/or Partner team members to achieve the engagement’s deliverables and enable the customer’s desired business outcomes.  

  • Typically manages multiple projects simultaneously.  

  • Identify gaps between actuals and plan of record, propose solutions and drive resolution.  

  • Lead the delivery team throughout large, complex programs, often with multiple workstreams and in collaboration with a services partner.  

  • Support Business Development efforts for Multi-Million-dollar engagements.

title: Staff Data Platform Software Engineer - Persistence
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Position Location:
This is a Flexible (Hybrid) position.  Flexible positions require 2 days per week in a ServiceNow office location.  We have offices in several locations, including San Francisco, CA; Pleasanton, CA; Santa Clara, CA and San Diego, CA

Position Overview: 

ServiceNow is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Staff Software Engineer in Platform Persistence to solve complex problems in management of data lifecycles within the ServiceNow ecosystem. This pivotal role focuses on ensuring the efficient stewardship of data within our platform.

The Platform Persistence team is at the forefront of some of the most impactful projects, offering visibility to the executive leadership. As part of this team, you will play a crucial role in shaping the future of our platform’s data architecture and ensuring that data is stored, retrieved, and managed efficiently. 

In addition to traditional data management, this team will have a unique focus on telemetry and data visualization, making a substantial impact on how customer and platform data is utilized and presented. 

What you get to do in this role:

  • Writing highly scalable code leveraging best practices on concurrency and memory utilization. 
  • Contribute to data management strategies, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and security. 
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement data-related initiatives. 
  • Explore and experiment with challenging data problems including but not limited to data loss detection & recovery. 
  • Champion data best practices and security standards across the organization. 
  • Monitor and optimize data performance, troubleshooting and implementing improvements as needed. 
  • Stay current with the latest data storage and management technologies, including distributed storage systems (S3, Apache Iceberg) and Kubernetes-based deployments. 
  • Use AI tools to help solve challenging data and distributed systems problems at scale, applying sound judgment on guardrails and process for AI-led software development. 
  • Fosters a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

To Be Successful in this role you have:

  • 8+ years of software development experience with a Bachelor's degree; OR 5+ years with Master's degree; OR 3+ years with a PhD; OR equivalent work experience.
  • Proficiency in Java programming and strong expertise in data structures and algorithms. 
  • Proficiency with concurrency and parallel programming concepts. 
  • Working knowledge of databases, data modeling, and data storage technologies. 
  • Strong relational database experience to handle large amount of data on relational systems. 
  • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes and hands-on experience with Kubernetes service deployment is a strong plus. 
  • Working knowledge of distributed storage systems such as S3 and Apache Iceberg. 
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based and distributed systems. 
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow platform is a plus. 
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. 
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript is beneficial for cross-functional collaboration. 
  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools and awareness of related guardrails/process is a plus. 


For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $176,100 - $308,200, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About the role 

We are hiring a Sr. software engineer for the Telemetry Data Platform team, which carries product usage telemetry & performance telemetry for the entire ServiceNow platform on a stack built with Kubernetes, Kafka, and ClickHouse. We are distributed across Israel, India, and the Americas.  

This is a full stack role with its center of gravity firmly on telemetry development, data pipelines, Kubernetes and DevOps work, supporting Billions of records per day. You will be equally comfortable designing a distributed system and owning it in production. If you like following a system from the event that fires to the chart that renders — and you want the pager for it — you will feel at home.  

You will lead design and delivery of complex, multi-service features, own technical decisions within a domain, and are fully self-directed — escalating only genuine ambiguities and driving decisions to closure. Of the ten critical skills at this level, incident response management is the only one set at Expert; the rest are Experienced.  

What you’ll do 

Telemetry data pipelines 

  • Design, build, and own backend services for distributed data streaming and processing that handle high-volume, high-cardinality event data with predictable latency and no silent data loss.  

  • Build and maintain Kafka-based streaming pipelines and the pipeline components that feed ClickHouse.  

  • Own data modeling and query performance in ClickHouse — partitioning, sort keys, materialized views, retention, and the cost curve that comes with all of it.  

  • Partner with product and platform teams to shape requirements for telemetry ingestion and processing, then drive the solutions to production.  

Kubernetes, DevOps, and production ownership 

  • Deploy, scale, and operate services in production Kubernetes environments, including Helm-based deployments and CI/CD pipelines that make releases repeatable and safe to roll back. 

  • Own observability for what you build — meaningful metrics, useful logs, real tracing, and alerts that fire on customer impact rather than on noise. 

  • Debug and resolve production incidents independently, participate in on-call, run root-cause analysis, and operate against defined service level objectives. 

Full stack engineering and technical leadership 

  • Own the full development lifecycle for your work, and build the backend services and APIs that expose telemetry to internal consumers, product surfaces, and AI agents — including API contracts, data models, and schema migrations. 

  • Contribute to the analytics front end — dashboards, funnels, and exploration tools — with an eye on performance against large result sets, and improve the web and mobile capture SDKs. 

  • Lead the design of complex, multi-service features across team boundaries, drive decisions to closure, and write the design docs and postmortems that outlive the conversation. 

  • Raise the bar through code review, test strategy, and automation coverage, and mentor engineers on the team. 

Qualifications

Experience and education requirements 

The job profile defines by scope, independence, and impact rather than years served. The minimums below are the screening bar for this requisition: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related – Required 

  • 6+ years’ experience as backend software engineer 

  • 4+ years’ experience in designing and operating distributed systems 

  • 3+ years’ experience with Kubernetes in production, including Helm and CI/CD 

  • 3+ years’ experience with Kafka or equivalent streaming and data pipelines 

  • Experience with on-call and production support 

A master’s degree may offset up to one year of the experience minimum. Equivalent practical experience is considered where technical depth is clearly demonstrable. 

Required qualifications 

  • Strong backend development experience in Java, Python, Go or equivalent, used in production at scale. 

  • Hands-on experience building distributed systems for data streaming, processing, and storage. 

  • Production experience deploying and managing services on Kubernetes, including Helm and CI/CD pipelines. 

  • Working knowledge of Kafka or an equivalent messaging and streaming system.  

  • Solid SQL skills and hands-on experience with a columnar or analytical data store, including query optimization and physical data modeling. 

  • Demonstrated depth in incident response and customer escalations 

  • Enough front-end capability to build and debug a data-heavy interface: JavaScript or TypeScript with React or Angular. 

Desired qualifications 

  • Production experience with ClickHouse or another OLAP or columnar store — sharding, replication, materialized views, cost tuning. 

  • Exposure to observability tooling: OpenTelemetry, metrics and logging stacks, alerting platforms. 

  • Experience building product analytics or telemetry platforms, or with stream processing frameworks such as Flink or Spark. 

  • Client-side instrumentation — web or mobile SDK development, event capture, session and consent handling. 

AI skills 

Artificial intelligence strategy is a critical skill at Experienced proficiency — it applies to how you build and to what you build. 

  • Confident use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor, paired with the critical eye to review AI-generated code as rigorously as any other — catching logic errors, security anti-patterns, and missed edge cases rather than treating model output as production-ready. 

  • AI-assisted debugging and trace analysis, and a clear understanding of the data privacy rules governing what goes into a prompt. 

  • Integrating LLM APIs into production features — and knowing when a model is the wrong tool for the job. Working knowledge of RAG pipelines, embedding stores, and agent frameworks; familiarity with the Model Context Protocol is a plus. 

  • Exposing telemetry to AI agents through tool interfaces agents can use safely: predictable schemas, bounded results, clear error semantics, sane cost controls. 

  • Designing safeguards for non-deterministic components — retry logic, circuit breakers, human-in-the-loop checkpoints — and hardening against latency spikes and hallucinated output reaching a customer. 

  • Instrumenting AI features in production and judging their quality from telemetry and evaluation rather than impressions.

www.servicenow.com

As a Staff Technical Product Manager for ServiceNow University, you will help shape the next generation of artificial intelligence-native learning and credentialing experiences for customers, partners, employees, and individual learners.

ServiceNow University is transforming how people build the knowledge and skills needed to succeed with ServiceNow. The product is evolving toward personalized, proactive, conversational, and hands-on experiences that help learners achieve their goals at the moment of need. This direction is consistent with the current ServiceNow University strategy, which emphasizes artificial intelligence-driven simulation, real-time guidance, skills intelligence, intelligent pathways, and measurable learner capability.

You will own defined technical product capabilities that support this transformation and span multiple ServiceNow University experiences. Job Description

ServiceNow is seeking a Manager, Technical Accounting, to join our Technical Accounting team in our next phase of growth. This is a high-visibility position that will play an important role in researching and documenting a wide variety of complex technical accounting matters, supporting purchase accounting for an active M&A pipeline, and other related topics. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders throughout the Company to support the successful execution of key initiatives within the Finance organization. This role will report to the Director, Technical Accounting, who reports to the Sr. Director, Technical Accounting and M&A. The Sr. Director has responsibility for all technical accounting matters and leads Finance’s M&A process from diligence through integration. 

What you get to do in this role: 

  • Research and prepare technical accounting memos documenting the Company’s technical accounting issues and conclusions, supported by authoritative US GAAP guidance; support the presentation and resolution of the Company’s positions on critical accounting issues with internal leadership and external auditors 

  • Monitor and assess new accounting pronouncements applicable to the Company; partner with stakeholders to analyze the impact and support implementation 

  • Key contributor throughout the M&A process, supporting pre-letter of intent review, financial diligence, purchase accounting, and valuation, as well as post-close accounting integration 

  • Develop and apply deep technical knowledge in areas such as business combinations, investment accounting, goodwill and intangible asset impairment testing, accounting for share-based compensation programs, revenue accounting matters (e.g., payments to a customer, gross versus net), and hedge accounting, amongst a variety of other complex accounting areas 

  • Draft and review SEC disclosures on relevant technical accounting topics 

  • Execute the quarterly and year-end close process for technical accounting matters, including preparation of journal entries, reconciliations, and SEC disclosure support 

  • Be a trusted business partner and advisor to various stakeholders within Accounting, Finance, Legal, Corporate Development, and other cross-functional teams 

  • Take initiative for process improvements to scale and optimize the technical accounting process, including the implementation of AI initiatives 

  • Contribute to the design, implementation, and maintenance of effective global accounting policies, processes, procedures, and internal controls 

  • Serve as a day-to-day technical accounting contact for external auditors, supporting resolution of complex accounting matters 

  • Support special projects and workflow process improvements 

  • Involvement in the SEC reporting process to help ensure the financial statements are in compliance with US GAAP 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have: 

  • Total experience of minimum 6 years, including Big Four public accounting experience and/or technical accounting experience at a public company 

  • BS/BA degree in Finance or Accounting and active CPA license is required 

  • Manager role in a Big Four public accounting firm and/or technical accounting role at a public company 

  • Positive, service-oriented attitude, highly motivated to learn and to make an impact within the organization 

  • Experience mentoring and reviewing the work of junior team members; prior team leadership experience is a plus 

  • Strong technical accounting background with a knowledge of US GAAP, SEC reporting standards, and SOX 404, as well as experience performing technical research and preparing technical accounting memos 

  • Excellent verbal/written communication and presentation skills 

  • Relationship builder across all levels of the organization 

  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders (Finance, Legal, Corporate Development) on technical accounting positions without direct authority 

  • Strong organizational skills to manage numerous workstreams at once and complete work timely 

  • Self-starter and a great team member 

  • Proactive approach to identifying root causes and implementing durable solutions, including escalation when appropriate 

  • Ability to be flexible and work analytically in a dynamic environment 

  • Meticulous and superior attention to detail 

  • Strong Excel knowledge 

  • Familiarity with emerging AI tools for accounting automation is valued 

  • Experience with SAP or other large ERP systems is a plus

Job Description

What You Own: 

Performance Evaluation & Calibration: 

  • Own ServiceNow's performance evaluation framework, including rating definitions, behavioral expectations by level, and the standards that ensure assessments are consistent and meaningful. 
  • Define and maintain the philosophical underpinnings of how performance evaluation at ServiceNow, in alignment with the COE's design principles and broader performance management strategy. 
  • Partner with Compensation to ensure evaluation outcomes connect logically to rewards decisions. 
  • Strategically design to leverage AI to assist with relevant evaluation process components that improve consistency and reduce bias while ensuring human judgment remains at the center of every performance decision. 
  • Design and govern the calibration process, comprehensively supporting how managers and leaders should align on performance assessments across teams and business units. 
  • Collaborate with the enablement team to create strong, concise, clear facilitation guides, pre-work materials, and decision-making frameworks that help calibration sessions produce fair, consistent, and documented outcomes. 
  • Collaborate with Product and DT to design enhancements to the YE Evaluation tool to seamlessly facilitate peer reviews of ratings and write ups to support calibrated outcomes while preserving manager ROI on the overall evaluation process. 
  • Identify and address systemic calibration inconsistencies; partner with HRBPs to close gaps in how the process is applied across different parts of the business. 

How You Work: 

  • You work in a co-ownership model: COE defines the what and why; Product owns the how and when. You represent the business logic and employee / leader experience in every tech conversation. 
  • You bring a consulting mindset, diagnosing what senior leaders actually need, not just what they ask for. 
  • You strategically consider how AI capabilities can improve the evaluation processes at ServiceNow. 
  • You operate at a strategic level while remaining close enough to the work to catch execution gaps before they become problems. 
  • You are a strong cross-functional partner. The work you own touches nearly every HR function, and you build trust by seeing around corners, owning solutions, and rolling up your sleeves to help get work done.  

What Great Looks Like:

  • Your frameworks and philosophy are adopted, not just documented. HRBP partners use your resources because they're useful, not because they're required. 
  • ServiceNow's evaluation framework reflects our recently updated performance philosophy and informs how HR leaders & business leaders talk about performance. The ‘why’ is crisp and clear. 
  • Calibration sessions produce consistent, defensible outcomes, and HRBPs report high confidence in the process. Leaders understand why it matters and where to invest their time and focus. 
  • DT understands why calibration matters and how they can evolve the evaluation tool to best support calibrated decision making and outcomes. 
  • Employees get critical insight into their performance throughout the year and after the performance cycle, understanding transparently how they did and how they are rewarded. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you have:

  • 8+ years of experience in performance management, talent management, HR strategy, or a related field, including ownership of enterprise programs or processes
  • Deep expertise in performance evaluation and calibration, including rating frameworks, assessment standards, and approaches that support fair, consistent, and meaningful decisions
  • Proven experience translating performance philosophy and strategy into practical frameworks, processes, tools, and leader guidance
  • A strong consulting mindset and experience advising senior HR and business leaders on complex or sensitive talent decisions
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional work across HR, Compensation, HR Business Partners, Product, and technology teams
  • Experience designing and scaling global processes while accounting for business, employee, and regional needs
  • Strong analytical judgment, with the ability to use qualitative and quantitative insights to identify inconsistencies, evaluate effectiveness, and improve outcomes
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex concepts clear, concise, and actionable for different audiences
  • The ability to operate strategically while remaining close to execution, proactively identifying risks, resolving gaps, and driving work through completion
  • Curiosity about how AI and emerging technology can improve performance processes, strengthen consistency, and reduce bias while preserving human judgment

descriptionHtml:

Job Description

Position Location:
This is a Flexible (Hybrid) position.  Flexible positions require 2 days per week in a ServiceNow office location.  We have offices in several locations, including San Francisco, CA; Pleasanton, CA; Santa Clara, CA; San Diego, CA

Please Note:  This position will include supporting our US Regulated Markets.
“This position requires passing a ServiceNow background screening, USFedPASS (US Federal Personnel Authorization Screening Standards). This includes a credit check, criminal/misdemeanor check and taking a drug test. Any employment is contingent upon passing the screening.  Due to Federal requirements, only US citizens, US naturalized citizens or US Permanent Residents, holding a green card, will be considered.

Team Overview

The Data Platform group builds highly scalable, high‑performance platform capabilities for data‑in‑motion and backend storage systems. Our customers operate at massive scale, pushing the boundaries of data volume, throughput, and concurrency. We are looking for a seasoned IC5 Senior Staff Engineer with deep expertise in distributed systems and Data Lake architectures to drive next‑generation platform innovation.

Role Summary

As an IC5 Senior Staff Engineer, you will architect and deliver large‑scale distributed platform components, lead complex technical initiatives, and define engineering best practices. You will bring strong leadership, hands-on engineering depth, and the ability to design and operate reliable, scalable, and high‑performance data systems.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Architect, design, and build high‑performance distributed systems and platform components.
  • Build distributed systems data ingestion solutions with strong emphasis on scalability, quality, and operational excellence.
  • Deliver high‑quality, clean, modular, and reusable code while enforcing engineering best practices (code reviews, unit testing, automation, design reviews).
  • Build foundational libraries, frameworks, and tools focused on modularity, extensibility, configurability, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate across engineering teams to refine requirements and deliver end‑to‑end solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership for projects with significant complexity and risk.
  • Research, evaluate, and adopt new technologies that enhance platform capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot and diagnose complex production issues across distributed systems.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into engineering work — whether using AI-powered coding and operational tooling, automating workflows, or reasoning about how AI changes the way software and infrastructure are built.
  • 12+ years of hands‑on engineering experience in distributed systems, data platforms, or large‑scale backend infrastructure with a Bachelor's degree; OR 8+ years with a Master's degree; OR 6+ years with a PhD OR equivalent work experience.

Core Engineering Expertise

  • Strong fundamentals in distributed systems architecture, design patterns, and algorithms.
  • Deep programming expertise in Java, including JVM internals, memory models, and garbage collection.
  • Proven experience in JVM performance tuning, profiling, and diagnosing performance bottlenecks.
  • Deep programming expertise and hands-on experience working with Helm (charts authoring, templating, managing overlay layering across environments)
  • Strong understanding of concurrency, networking, sockets, OS internals, and performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating large‑scale distributed systems.
  • Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL.
  • Security systems, methods and protocols.
     

Distributed Systems Expertise

  • Experience with large‑scale deployments of distributed systems.
  • Deep knowledge of replication, fault-tolerant, and HA strategies.
  • Experience working in DevOps environments to operationalize distributed platforms.
    • GitOps and release engineering for distributed k8s-native services.
  • Strong expertise in designing and architecting platforms using:
    • Kubernetes (workload deployments, upgrades, monitoring and maintenance).
    • Apache Iceberg (tables, catalogs, data encryption, schema evolution, metadata management).
    • Apache Kafka (high‑scale clusters, topic/partition strategies, HA).
    • Apache Flink (stateful stream processing, exactly‑once semantics).
    • Apache Spark (batch & streaming jobs, optimization, partitioning).
  • Expertise in data formats such as Parquet, ORC, and Avro, along with compaction and governance strategies.

Job Description

What you'll do:

UX Architecture & Strategy — Define and own the long-term architecture for AI-native user experiences across the platform, making critical build-vs-buy decisions (design systems, agent-to-UI interaction patterns, real-time/streaming UX for AI-generated content) to ensure the experience layer stays resilient and coherent as the platform scales.

AI-Native Intelligent Experiences — Design and build user-facing surfaces where agentic backends - recommendations, autonomous triage, generated fixes/insights, multi-step agent reasoning - are exposed to end users through fast, trustworthy, low-friction interaction patterns. Own the hard UX problems unique to AI-native products: progressive disclosure of agent reasoning, graceful handling of uncertainty/latency, human-in-the-loop review flows, and making autonomous system behavior legible and controllable to end users rather than a black box.

UXC & Workspace Platform — Deep ownership of the UXC (User Experience/Workspace, UI16) surface — component architecture, design system consistency, and performance — as the primary canvas AI-native features are built on top of.

Agentic Pipeline Awareness — Partner closely with platform/ML teams building the agent orchestration and tool-calling infrastructure underneath (multi-agent dispatch, MCP-style tool integration, reasoning traceability) — translating what these backends can do into UX patterns that make them usable, safe, and trustworthy for real users.

Business Alignment — Align UX and technical architecture with business goals, ensuring engineering velocity, experience quality, and adoption of AI-native features directly support customer acquisition, retention, and time-to-market.

Hands-on Engineering — Write high-performance, clean, production-grade code primarily across the frontend/experience stack (Lit.js, React/TypeScript, design systems, component architecture), with working fluency in backend/platform code (Java, Python, Postgres, K8s) to collaborate effectively with platform teams.

Cross-functional Execution — Drive business-critical UX and platform outcomes in close collaboration with ML, backend platform, and product teams.

Engineering Culture — Mentor senior engineers, champion UX and engineering excellence, and foster a culture of rapid, impact-driven innovation in AI-native product development.

Ownership & Initiative — Proactively identify UX and platform gaps in the AI-native experience, propose solutions, align stakeholders, and drive execution with a high degree of ownership.

Qualifications

  • Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into engineering and platform work—AI-powered tooling, automated operational workflows, agentic systems for fleet visibility and operations, or reasoning about AI’s impact on how infrastructure is built and run.
  • 15+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated progression into senior technical leadership, and a track record concentrated in user experience and frontend platform engineering.
  • Deep UXC / AI-native UX expertise - has shipped intelligent, AI-driven user experiences (not just consumed an LLM API), with strong intuition for how agent/model output should surface to real users.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic/multi-agent systems from the consumer side — understands agent orchestration, tool-calling protocols (MCP or equivalent), and reasoning traceability well enough to design UX around them, even if platform-layer implementation sits with another team.
  • Strong hands-on coding ability with deep design thinking in the frontend/experience stack (React/TypeScript, component/design systems), working proficiency in backend fundamentals (K8s, Java, Python, Postgres) to bridge into platform architecture conversations.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect UX and engineering decisions to business outcomes - adoption, retention, time-to-market, not just technical metrics.

  • Experience integrating or critically evaluating AI tools/agentic workflows in product and engineering decision-making, particularly from a user-experience and trust/legibility angle.

  • You have strong familiarity with APIs, authentication, and integrations. 
  • You are have experience building enterprise products that required 3rd party platform integrations 
  • You have a proven track record of taking ownership of product goals and delivering against them 
  • You have sound framework for when to iterate, when to discard, and when to scale products 
  • You have the skills needed to take input from multiple sources, crystallize clear priorities, and communicate them effectively. 
  • You are someone who can bridge the technical with the enterprise and cultivate challenging relationships with internal and external stakeholders with grace. 
  • You feel most at home working hand-in-hand with data science, engineering, user experience, and customer success teams. 
  • You are an effective communicator, you pay attention to the finer details, and you empathize with customers and stakeholders and build meaningful relationships 
  • You are curious and bring genuine excitement to learn new subject areas and are comfortable to be scrappy as and when needed

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer- Voice AI
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

What you get to do in this role:

The Advanced Technology Group (ATG) at ServiceNow is a customer-focused innovation group building intelligent software and smart user experiences using existing and latest advanced technologies to enable end-to-end, industry-leading work experiences for customers. We are a group of researchers, applied scientists, engineers, and product managers with a dual mission. We build and evolve the AI platform, and partner with teams to build products and end-to-end AI-powered work experiences. In equal measure, we lay the foundations, research, experiment, and de-risk AI technologies that unlock new work experiences in the future.

You will play a major part in building AI and Machine Learning (ML) solutions that transform the user experience and workflow efficiency of enterprise services. Traditional analytical tools tend to require a technically knowledgeable user to produce even simple results. We are taking a completely fresh approach with the expectation that any user, regardless of technical knowledge, can use the AI/ML solutions we develop to operate the services in the enterprise setting in a thoughtful and scalable manner. We are just getting started with our early-adopter customers and we need your help in building and making available an amazing range of solutions to our 5k+ enterprise customers around the world.

  • Contribute to the design, development and implementation of the core Voice Platform (Audio Acquisition, Conversation Management, Speech Generation, integration with API and self-hosted Voice AI models, Voice Harness)
  • Partner with product managers to work with customers, understand their use cases and technology challenges, and build for their success
  • Build and deploy large Voice AI distributed systems at scale spanning multiple regions and datacenters
  • Build high-quality, clean, scalable and reusable code by enforcing best practices around software engineering architecture and processes (Code Reviews, Unit testing, etc.)
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the SRE practice by turning operational use cases into requirements for software tooling
  • Be a mentor for colleagues and help promote knowledge-sharing across Voice AI engineering disciplines

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 8+ year of relevant industry experience
  • Hands-on experience building distributed Voice AI systems with a large operational scale
  • ~4+ years building LLM-based applications (integrating models, not training)
  • 6+ years of development experience with Python, Golang, Java, or similar languages. 
  • 2+ years of experience building agents (prompt engineering) and developing LLM-based experiences
  • Working experience operating highly available distributed workloads on Kubernetes following a DevOps approach. 
  • Experience building software for compliance and security in regulated environments is considered an asset
  • A proven track record of architecting and shipping distributed Voice AI or voice platform systems (real-time audio, STT/TTS, telephony or WebRTC) at large operational scale
  • Critically thinking around AI integrations for work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. 
  • Experience building with AI tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf

We are building a real-time conversational AI voice platform. An orchestrator runs every call through Voice Activity Detection, Speech-to-Text, LLM-based agent matching, tool calling against ServiceNow platform (Glide) APIs, and Text-to-Speech.

In voice, latency and reliability are the product. You will own the platform's reliability, performance and operational architecture, and set direction across teams.

  • Define and drive SLIs/SLOs for availability, perceived latency (end-of-speech to first audio), and call quality.

  • Lead load, soak and breakpoint testing, and turn results into capacity models.
  • Build resilience for LLM, STT and TTS dependencies: failover, fallbacks, rate-limit handling and graceful degradation.
  • Own Kubernetes architecture, infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD with safe progressive delivery.
  • Lead incident response and postmortems, and mentor engineers across the team.

  • 1+ year building or operating real-time voice systems (VoIP, SIP/RTP, WebRTC, or STT/TTS integration).
  • 2+ years building or operating AI agentic systems and orchestration pipelines (agent routing, tool calling, multi-step LLM workflows).
  • 1+ year deploying and operating LLMs in production (model serving, inference optimization, provider integration and failover).

The right person has lived across GTM, value technical value, and delivery, has the executive presence to hold a room with senior sales and product leadership.

Who Thrives Here
Operator-builders who've sat in seats across GTM, value engineering, and delivery and want all three at once. Comfortable being the strategist in a GTM planning session on Monday and the deployment tactician solving capacity trade-offs on Tuesday. No ego about scope; deep ego about outcomes.

What You'll Own

FDE Global Deployment & Portfolio Strategy
Own the global FDE portfolio and allocation strategy. Work with regional leadership, Geo Presidents, and SVP/GTM to calibrate where FDE delivers the most impact on revenue, product signal, and customer reference value. Run the investment thesis that positions the FDE team in the highest-conviction customer, product, and GTM moments. Navigate the competing priorities across regions, portfolios, and strategic accounts and make the calls that maximize team impact globally, not just locally.

2. FDE Investment Strategy & ROI Operations
FDE capacity is scarce and expensive. Deploy it like capital.

  • Treat every FDE engagement as an investment. Approve only work tied to a clear strategic imperative or commercial outcome: a renewal, net-new ACV, or a key product expansion. Set approval criteria that hold up under CFO scrutiny. Lock scope, success criteria, and the target outcome before work starts, then track every engagement through to the result.
  • Prove the return. Measure the renewals, net-new ACV, consumption, and expansion influenced per FDE-week, by engagement type, region, and industry. Make sure every value case clears its cost to serve. Use the results to steer where FDE deploys next and when to scale headcount or extend through partner capacity.

3. Value Velocity & Build Economics
Compress the time from use case identification to value defined, aligned to token burn, and executive-signed-off. Build the repeatable playbook that gets engagements from "interesting problem" to "approved investment with quantified outcomes" in a fraction of the current cycle. Scale that playbook across the portfolio so every FDE engagement benefits from the same velocity and rigor, regardless of region or industry.

4. Evolving Initiatives & Scale Path Orchestration
Stay close to what's working in the portfolio and what's not. Own the emerging initiatives that define FDE's next frontier - agentic use cases, go-to-market motions, industry verticals, platform capabilities - and build the scale paths that turn early wins into portfolio-wide capability. Recognize when an initiative is ready to scale, when it needs more signal, and when it should be archived. Define and manage the partner motion that extends FDE reach without diluting caliber. Build the vetting standards, engagement model, and guardrails that let tier-1 SIs and specialist partners deliver on FDE-adjacent work under FDE brand and quality standards.

5. Executive Narrative & Senior Relationship Alignment
Drive how the FDE impact shows up at the highest altitudes - board narratives, Financial Analyst Day, C-suite QBRs, marquee customer references. Own the throughline from raw deployment and build outcomes to the story that moves markets, analysts, and pipeline.

6. The Charter Isn't Fixed - It's Ever-Evolving
The AI market shifts week to week. What resonated with customers last quarter may be table stakes today, and what's not working needs to be killed fast. Stay close enough to the field to read those signals in real time, and move mountains internally to make sure the team is leaning into what's landing and pulling back from what isn't. Pattern-match across the portfolio, find the highest-leverage deployment decision in any given week, and go solve it at an expert level. Comfort with ambiguity and speed is the price of entry.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience spanning AI GTM, applied AI or technical solutioning, management consulting, or strategic delivery in a Fortune 500 environment
  • A track record of personally owning complex, multi-stakeholder GTM and deployment decisions with C-suite and senior executive partners. Ownership - not coordination.
  • Demonstrated fluency in agentic AI, LLM-based systems, or applied AI builds. Enough technical depth to challenge scope, pressure-test architecture, and credibly engage customer and internal engineering leadership.
  • Experience designing and scaling commercial frameworks, capacity models, or strategic allocation constructs that have held up under CFO and procurement scrutiny.
  • A history of managing portfolios or programs that have scaled beyond your individual reach. Resource allocation decisions that moved the needle across a region or function.
  • The judgment to know which deployment decision in the portfolio deserves your time this quarter, and the operating instinct to go solve it without waiting for a directive.

Why ServiceNow

AI is changing how enterprises run, and ServiceNow is where it gets put to work. Our platform connects people, data, workflows and AI agents across the whole organisation, so customers get outcomes, not just insights. We're a team that stays hungry and humble, wows customers, creates belonging and wins together.

About this role

Great ideas don't win Enterprise deals. Great ideas you can see working do.

As an Advisory Presales Solution Consultant, you'll work alongside account teams to help some of Australia's biggest organisations solve real business problems on the ServiceNow AI Platform. You'll guide customers from the first conversation to confident decisions, and you'll have the room to try bold ideas, learn fast and make an impact that shows.

Qualifications

What you bring

  • Experience in presales, consulting, solution architecture or a similar hands-on role in enterprise technology
  • Confidence engaging senior stakeholders and a knack for storytelling, strong demonstration and presentation skills
  • A love of building: you're happiest when you're making something work and showing someone what it can do
  • Hands on experience with AI, automation or low code tools, and an interest in the evolving AI landscape

title: Staff AI Security Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Our team secures the AI in ServiceNow's products and platform from adversaries. As AI agents gain the ability to reason, retrieve context, and take real action on behalf of users, they become a new and largely unmapped attack surface - and the controls that protect them mostly don't exist yet. We build them. 

We're looking for a Staff AI Security Specialist who sits at the intersection of AI and Security and is happiest building. This is an applied role: you'll spend your time reasoning about how agentic systems break and then writing the code that stops it, from prototype to shipped control in collaboration with Security Engineers. 

What you get to do in this role: 

  • Analyze the security of AI agent systems - how the harness assembles context and drives the tool-calling loop, how agents plan and delegate, what they persist to memory, and how all of it responds to untrusted input - and find where an adversary can subvert them 
  • Design and build security controls for agentic systems: static analysis of agent and tool configurations, runtime policy enforcement, behavioral detection, and mitigations for tool and goal hijacking 
  • Build working prototypes end to end, then partner with engineering to harden the ones that prove out 
  • Threat model new AI architectures and features before they ship, and turn findings into concrete controls rather than a list of risks 
  • Red-team our own agents and our own defenses: indirect prompt injection, tool abuse, privilege escalation across agent boundaries, data exfiltration through model and tool channels 
  • Build repeatable evaluations and benchmarks so we can measure whether a control actually holds, and prove it as models and products change underneath us 
  • Track offensive and defensive AI security research and judge quickly what's real, what's noise, and what should change our roadmap 
  • Advise product and platform teams building agentic features on secure design, and raise the team's collective depth in AI security 
  • Publish what's worth publishing - internal research, patents, and external talks 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you have: 

  • Experience in leveraging integration of AI capabilities into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. 
  • 6+ years of combined experience in security, software engineering, or applied research, including 2+ years working hands-on with AI/ML or LLM-based systems, is required 
  • Strong working knowledge of the agent harness and its security-relevant seams: system prompt and context construction, the tool-calling loop, context window management and compaction, sub-agent delegation, sandboxing and execution boundaries, is required 
  • Working knowledge of agent memory and retrieval systems - what persists, who can write to it, and how it is read back - along with orchestration frameworks and tool protocols such as MCP, and the failure modes each introduces, is required 
  • Demonstrated depth in at least one security domain (application security, offensive security, authorization and identity, or detection engineering), with the instinct to reason in terms of attacker capability, preconditions, and attack chains rather than checklists, is required 
  • Practical understanding of the AI-specific threat landscape - prompt, tool, and goal hijacking, indirect injection through retrieved content, memory poisoning and adversarial instruction persistence across sessions, insecure agent configurations, cross-session and cross-tenant data leakage, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS - is required 
  • Proficiency in Python, sufficient to independently build and ship working systems, is required 
  • Ability to take an ambiguous problem statement to a working artifact, own it end to end, and abandon it without ceremony when the evidence says it doesn't work, is required 
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to both non-technical business users as well as technical stakeholders is required 

Preferred qualifications: 

  • Experience building systems that make and enforce security decisions at runtime 
  • Experience building static or dynamic analysis tooling 
  • Experience with AI red-teaming, adversarial ML, or evaluating models and guardrails at scale 
  • Published security or AI research, patents, CVEs, or meaningful open-source contributions

title: Director, Product Management, Microsoft Product Partnership
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

We seek a Director of Product Management to set and lead the product strategy for the Microsoft partnership across ServiceNow's full vertical stack, from data and AI through agents, governance, and industry-specific workflows. This is an individual contributor role with enterprise-wide scope and executive-level influence. You are the senior product leader and definitive internal authority on how ServiceNow's platform aligns with Microsoft's product stack end-to-end.

The scope is intentionally broad and will shift as both companies' product stacks evolve. Rather than a fixed list of integration points, this role is defined by a mandate: wherever ServiceNow's stack and Microsoft's stack meet, you are accountable for the product relationship. You'll partner with product marketing, business development, corporate development, and other functions to define and execute the engagement strategy, track execution milestones, and maximize value generated for ServiceNow, our customers, and Microsoft. You will serve as ServiceNow's senior product counterpart to Microsoft product leadership.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Set the strategy for and lead technical due diligence, roadmap alignment, and integration delivery across the Microsoft relationship, from qualification through activation-ready handoff to GTM, spanning whichever stack layers are active priorities at a given time, not a fixed set.
  • Establish and continuously evolve the enterprise view of where ServiceNow's stack and Microsoft's stack intersect, so the organization always has one owner and one point of view on the relationship rather than fragmented, layer-by-layer ownership.
  • Drive dual-roadmap alignment: translate Microsoft's capability and platform changes into internal roadmap asks, and translate ServiceNow's platform roadmap into Microsoft-facing requirements.
  • Define and advocate ServiceNow's point of view on how Microsoft's stack complements (rather than overlaps with) our platform, and articulate that positioning clearly to internal and partner stakeholders.
  • Define success metrics and measure downstream customer-funnel signals (adoption, attach rate, win/loss) across the partnership in partnership with GPC and field, and use them to drive roadmap and investment decisions.
  • Own prioritization and resourcing recommendations across this broad scope, and decide, with leadership, where to go deep now versus defer. Communicate the rationale clearly.
  • Shape and recommend leadership-level decisions on deeper strategic engagement with Microsoft (investment, co-sell motions, joint roadmap commitments).
  • Track competitive and industry trends across the Microsoft ecosystem, and define the implications and response for partnership strategy.
  • Lead cross-functional alignment with Engineering, Platform, Product Marketing, and GTM BD across the many teams whose work touches the Microsoft relationship. Represent ServiceNow in executive and strategic customer and partner engagements where Microsoft-specific technical context is needed, without owning the deal.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Demonstrated ability to operate across a wide, multi-layered product scope without needing it reduced to a fixed checklist, with comfort synthesizing a coherent strategy across data, AI, agents, governance, and application-layer partnership work.
  • 15+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS product management, with working knowledge of key SaaS growth drivers.
  • Track record of setting multi-year product strategy and influencing decisions at VP and C-level, internally and at partner or customer organizations.
  • Experience critically integrating AI into product decision-making, workflow design, or technical evaluation of partner solutions.
  • Experience leading product strategy for technology partnerships, including build-vs-partner analysis, technical due diligence, and integration architecture.
  • Experience owning business cases for partnership investment, including accountability for outcomes, combining analytical rigor with judgment under ambiguity.
  • Comfortable operating with dual accountability: influencing an internal roadmap you don't own and a partner roadmap you don't control, across an unusually broad set of stack layers.
  • Highly collaborative; able to drive alignment and decisions across many internal teams at the senior leadership level without direct authority over the people or teams involved.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to represent partnership rationale clearly to both technical and executive audiences, including translating across very different technical domains.
  • Ability to paint a compelling vision to inspire teams and senior stakeholders across a broad, evolving scope.
  • Familiarity with the ServiceNow platform and applications portfolio, and the associated competitive/partner landscape, is a plus.
  • Broad familiarity with Microsoft's AI, data, and agent product ecosystem is a strong plus. Depth in a few areas plus fluency across the rest is more valuable here than deep expertise in only one.
  • Hands-on product management experience with AI-powered or AI-enabled enterprise software is a strong plus.

title: Staff Research Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

As a Staff Researcher, you will work on research questions that most AI labs simply do not have access to. ServiceNow AI Research is chartered to build the future of enterprise agentic AI, from a rare vantage point: we see how agents actually behave, inside complex enterprise environments, at scale. 

You will contribute to research initiatives on how agents accumulate and reuse tacit knowledge, learn and improve continuously, and on their resilience, their safety, and the privacy of the data they handle. These are the real obstacles to enterprise agentic deployment today, and they surface in operational reality well before they appear in the literature. 

While much of the AI and NLP community concentrates on core agent capabilities, our team explores the dimensions that determine real adoption: safety mechanisms, threat detection, privacy guarantees, and responsible AI practices. You will have the freedom to publish and advance the state of the art, with the rare advantage of testing your hypotheses against real deployments rather than against benchmarks. 

Qualifications

  • PhD in computer science, machine learning, or a related field, or equivalent research experience 
  • 2 or more years of research experience post-PhD, a significant portion of it in an industrial setting or in direct contact with deployed systems 
  • Established publication record at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, or equivalents), with contributions recognized as influential in your field 
  • Demonstrated track record of setting/executing research agenda, not only executing one: you have chosen problems before the community turned to them, and you can explain why 
  • Experience working on cross-disciplinary teams or projects collaborating with researchers and engineers 
  • Strong software development skills: you write, maintain, and optimize high-quality research code, and you know what it takes for a result to survive the move into production
