Job Description

About the Team

The Adoption Services team builds and quality-assures a connected suite of in-product experiences designed to help customers learn, adopt, and use the platform successfully. By embedding targeted assistance directly into the workflow, these capabilities accelerate time-to-productivity, simplify complex onboarding, improve feature discovery, and reduce support dependency.
 
The core portfolio features a reorganized structure starting with 
Dynamic Guidance which provides conversational, voice-based AI assistance equipped with consent controls, transcripts, pause/resume, multi-tab synchronization, and resilient connectivity. 
AI Native Help for AI-generated answers, contextual Q&A, term and widget popovers, page- and element-level nudges, auto-launch guidance, and secure role and domain controls. 
 Guided Tours offering accessible, localized, multi-page walkthroughs spanning Classic UI, custom pages, portals, workspaces, and AI experiences. 
Help Center delivers searchable, localized articles featuring rich media, role-targeted content, feedback loops, telemetry, contextual help, and AI-generated article support. 
Guided Setup  provides configurable single- and multi-run setup journeys, checklists, embedded activities, permissions, migration support, and domain-separated execution. 
What’s New  for release discovery via unread badges, feature cards, multimedia carousels, availability indicators, and personalized content, alongside 
Onboarding Modals for targeted multi-step announcements, interactive questionnaires, rich media, and configurable calls to action.
 
Beyond individual product features, the team is supported by critical platform and technical foundations. These include AI and content services that power AI-generated Help Center articles, global content delivery network (CDN) integration for scalable performance, and rigorous quality standards ensuring cross-browser compatibility, web accessibility, and multi-language localization. Additionally, the architecture enforces strict governance, security, and domain-separated execution while driving smooth platform upgrades, telemetry tracking, and the transition toward LUX (Next-Gen UX) frameworks.
 
Together, these capabilities deliver major business value and strategic outcomes by accelerating time-to-value, enhancing feature adoption, enabling self-service productivity, and significantly reducing support ticket volumes through proactive in-product assistance.
 

About the role 

We’re looking for a Sr Staff Software Engineer to set technical direction for a team building AI-native products . You’ll shape how we design, build, and operate systems where AI agents, LLM-driven workflows, and traditional platform engineering work together. This is a hands-on role with broad influence: you’ll make architectural calls, raise the engineering bar, and help the team move from AI-assisted development to AI-native delivery.

  • Define and drive how the team uses AI tools across the development lifecycle: code generation, test automation, review, triage, and documentation. Measure the impact and share what works.
  • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers and set standards for code quality, observability, and safe AI usage.
  • Partner with product, UX, and other engineering leads to turn ambiguous problems into scoped, shippable plans.
  • Own production quality for your area, including defect triage, release readiness, and gate reviews. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership at the staff level or equivalent.
  • Strong proficiency in Java, JavaScript, or another language relevant to the platform, plus solid system design skills.
  • Hands-on experience building or integrating LLM-based features: prompt design, retrieval or context management, evaluation, and cost/latency tradeoffs.
  • Working knowledge of agentic architectures, including tool use, orchestration, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools in daily work, with an opinion on where they help and where they don’t.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to brief senior leaders and align multiple teams.
  • Familiarity with enterprise SaaS, multi-tenant systems, and secure, compliant software delivery.

title: Sr Staff Product Security Engineer - Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT)
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

ServiceNow seeks a senior staff-level product security engineer to serve as a senior technical authority within the Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT). PSIRT is ServiceNow's awareness, response, and investigation capability for post-release vulnerabilities in ServiceNow-developed products and service offerings. 

This role is for a recognised expert who can operate independently and as part of a team on the most significant security issues facing the platform—vulnerabilities that require evaluating intangibles. You will lead deep-dive investigations, coordinate resolution across engineering, product, and release teams, and demonstrate calm, decisive leadership during significant security events. 

This is a role for someone who already understands product development cycles and the engineering and product relationships that drive them—and will use that fluency to lead fixes to completion under incident pressure. You will help shape how ServiceNow responds to product security vulnerabilities at scale and the technical rigour of the entire response capability. 

The coverage provided by this role is: 

  • Sunday: 10:00 - 18:00 UTC. 
  • Monday: 08:00 - 16:00 UTC. 
  • Tuesday: 08:00 - 16:00 UTC. 
  • Wednesday: 08:00 - 16:00 UTC. 
  • Thursday: 08:00 - 16:00 UTC. 

Due to the nature of incident response and the needs of the business, coverage may change. Additional coverage outside of stated hours may be required in response to significant incidents. 

Key Responsibilities 

Lead Through Significant Security Events 

  • Demonstrate technical and organisational leadership during these events—bringing structure and clear decision-making under pressure. 
  • Partner with incident commanders, business information security leadership, engineering, and customer-facing teams to maintain clear ownership, workstream prioritization, and hand-offs during these events. 

Reduce Exposure Window 

  • Drive coordinated response across affected releases, balancing risk and remediation feasibility. 
  • Leverage an understanding of product development cycles and engineering/product partnerships to move fixes through the release pipeline without stalling on organisational boundaries. 
  • Verify fix completeness and guard against incomplete mitigations before release. 

Drive the CVE & Coordinated Disclosure Process 

  • Collaborate with external security partners, vendors, and researchers on coordinated disclosures, aligning timelines and messaging across parties. 
  • Conduct technical accuracy reviews of external advisories, researcher write-ups, and joint disclosure content to ensure correctness before publication. 
  • Represent PSIRT's technical position in multi-party coordinated disclosures and researcher engagements. 

Pursue After-Action Outcomes & Continuous Improvement 

  • Author postmortems and drive lessons learned to closure following product security incidents. 
  • Participate in retrospectives following significant product security events, translating findings into concrete process and technical improvements. 
  • Contribute to partner teams tracking product security risk themes and trends across the portfolio. 
  • Contribute to SDLC improvement areas, feeding incident learnings upstream into secure development practices. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you have:

Qualifications 

  • Minimum 12 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 8 years with a Master's degree; or a PhD with 5 years of experience; or equivalent experience. 
  • Minimum of 5 years of auditing source code for security vulnerabilities. 
  • Demonstrated leadership during significant security events or major incidents, with willingness to participate in on-call. 
  • Ability to read and comprehend Java and JavaScript code.  
  • Strong understanding of common Java and JavaScript vulnerabilities.  
  • Proficiency in scripting in both Python and JavaScript for data gathering, processing, and visualisation.  
  • Development of proof-of-concept exploits for web application vulnerabilities.  
  • Written and verbal communication of complex security risks clearly to both technical teams and leadership. 
  • Experience with leading fix implementation and release coordination across engineering, product, and test/release teams. 
  • Proficiency in deep-dive product security investigations and root-cause analysis spanning design, code, configuration, and operational layers. 
  • Exploit analysis and proof-of-concept development that distinguishes real exploitability from theoretical risk. 
  • Familiarity with SDLC integration, CI/CD pipelines, SaaS threat models, and secure development practices. 
  • Experience leading a CVE disclosure process, including CVE assignment, scoring (CVSS), and advisory publication. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in a PSIRT or similar function for a major software or SaaS platform. 
  • Recognized expertise in product security incident response, vulnerability research, or application security within a software or SaaS environment. 
  • Experience conducting vulnerability assessments on the ServiceNow platform. 
  • Experience with emerging threats: AI-specific attack vectors, software supply chain security, and SDLC tooling security. 
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerized environments. 
  • Relevant security certifications (e.g., OSWE) or demonstrated equivalent expertise.

title: Staff AI Engineer, Agentic AI Harness & Quality - Moveworks
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Who we are

Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce. 

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.

Moveworks is trusted by over 5.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award. 

In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Moveworks’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business. 

Come join us!
 

ServiceNow

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

The Role

We are looking for an experienced software engineer with expertise building AI-native product and platform to join us in expanding ServiceNow’s customer-facing agentic AI capabilities.

As a member of the Agentic AI Harness & Quality team, you will have all the tools of modern agentic AI engineering at your disposal, from frontier LLMs and tools to all the infrastructure needed to tune, evaluate, and serve AI agents in production. We are an eval-driven, data-centric team, and you will have the assistance of a world-class annotation team to build error-free, inclusive, and privacy-preserving datasets for tuning and evals.

You will push the envelope of AI performance in production, in every meaning of the word “performance”: not just accuracy and quality of outputs, but also latency, reliability, and capability of the end-to-end user-facing system as a whole. Successful AI engineers on the team are motivated to design and maintain high-performing compound AI systems.

Our team indexes on increasing our ability to move fast, solving challenging product and engineering challenges, and pushing the envelope of agent reliability and value provided to customers. Your work will impact our team’s core objective to build the highest-performing enterprise assistant platform the world has ever seen, in close collaboration with other functions within Moveworks and ServiceNow as a whole.


What you get to do in this role:

  • Apply software engineering and compound AI system engineering to create lasting value for all our customers

  • Drive quality in agent behavior, both in terms of increasing success rate at achieving goals set by end users and decreasing misbehavior in the customer business environment

  • Take on exciting and difficult challenges in AI harness engineering, such as agent cognitive architecture, eval benchmark creation, context engineering, generative UI, dynamic agent orchestration, multimodal I/O such as image and voice, multilinguality, conversational memory management, reasoning strategies, grounding and verifiability for generated text, deployment safety, and automatic harness optimization

  • Read, discuss, and build on the latest AI research and open-source repositories and models

  • Research and develop innovative, scalable and dynamic solutions to hard problems

  • Use your knowledge of machine learning fundamentals and LLMs to make improvements to the agentic harness and its AI components, evaluate them with small scale experiments and productionize your solutions at scale

  • Partner closely with web and chat platform engineering teams to turn harness investments into delightful user experiences that wow our customers

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Drive to ship product improvements with production-quality, fully unit-tested code and rigorously-evaluated updates to models, prompts, context curation code, or other tunable system components

  • Solid grasp of LLM and agent evaluation fundamentals, especially for agent action trajectories, generated text, and non-uniform sampling regimes

  • Attention to detail and high standard of data quality for eval datasets

  • Thoughtfulness about API contracts and implications of exposing a platform feature to a given type of stakeholder or end user

  • Readiness to hit the ground running in a Mac development environment, programming in Python and/or Golang with the assistance of coding agents

  • Familiarity with industry standard agent architectures and large language models

  • Critical reading skill to catch subtle “miscommunication bugs” in English-language agent instructions

  • Ability to fix miscommunication bugs with precise writing and evals

  • Desire to move fast with a high degree of ownership

  • Drive to ship product improvements with production-grade code

  • Strong appetite for continuous incremental wins and completing challenging projects fast

  • High level of curiosity about engineering outside of immediate discipline and ongoing desire to learn and stay at the cutting edge of agentic AI

Job Description

About the team:   

This role will support the Strategic Partnerships team within Central Product Management. The Strategic Partnerships team works with the leading technology and AI native companies to define a product led partnership motion, including building high value joint solutions and defining the ideal GTM, with an eye to accelerating customers adopting and getting value from AI. Together, we identify high-value opportunities, accelerate business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that advance the Now AI Platform.  The Strategic partnership team is focused on activating strategic partnerships and driving adoption of the joint solutions. 

Why This Role Matters:  

Enterprise leaders aren’t just experimenting with AI—they’re demanding outcomes. The next wave of adoption will be led by those who can move fast, deliver measurable value, and transform 1-off wins into repeatable success.  The lines are blurring across platforms, with coopetition being the new normal. The partnerships team sits at the intersection of this coopetition and helps define the better together where applicable. 

As a Strategic Partnerships Technical Program Manager, you operate on the frontlines of transformation. You will support ServiceNow’s cross-functional Strategic Partnership teams in organizational direction and structure, build partnerships, unblock delivery challenges, and ensure scalability. Your leadership accelerates innovation and drives repeatable success across industries. You shape internal tooling, build internal relationships, manage the customer portfolio, and cultivate a culture of excellence and impact.   

Who You Are:  

You are a dynamic and innovative problem-solver who thrives in complex, fast-paced environments. You have a strong analytical mindset while keeping focus on the bigger picture. You have a background managing SDLC processes and a portfolio of projects while keeping a customer-first mentality. You have a passion for AI and scaling innovation. You are curious and knowledgeable on the ecosystem of platforms. You excel at transforming ambiguity into clarity and have hands on experience driving projects/programs end to end.   

What You’ll Do:  

Manage the Partner Build Portfolio  

  • Manage the portfolio of partner engagements, overseeing phases, delivery timelines, scope, and outcomes for each engagement. 
  • Maintain a single source of truth for engagement progress, risks, and outcomes. 
  • In partnership with Strategic Partnership Leaders, balance priorities across accounts to ensure resources are allocated effectively. 
  • Aggregate engagement learnings to influence and scale go forward engagements. 
  • Organize complex, ambiguous problems into prioritized milestones, deliverables, and success criteria for engagements, translating business objectives into execution strategy (tactical and strategic). 
  • Help manage risks, dependencies and escalate impediments, as well as releases and navigating AI release requirements. 

Establish and Maintain Product & Engineering Partnerships + Feedback Loops 

  • Serve as central liaison between Strategic Partnerships, Applied AI FDE, Product, Engineering, Experience (UI/UX) and supporting orgs. 
  • Define and operationalize a structured model for engaging Strategic partnership team and broader APEX org. 
  • Work with Strategic Partnership leaders to translate engagement insights and patterns into actionable product feedback, influencing and tracking engagement to platform innovation progress. 
  • Develop standardized intake templates, RACIs, and collaboration playbooks.  

Drive Build Scale & Repeatability  

  • Capture lessons from early engagements (Phase 0 setup through rollout) and codify best practices. 
  • Implement tools, dashboards, and automation to streamline delivery and accelerate engagement impact and velocity. 
  • Drive process improvements and create documentation to promote best practices using automation to replace repeatable, operational tasks. 

Create Communication, Visibility & Governance Structure  

  • Centralize and manage all Strategic Partnerships documentation, resources, and operational structure. 
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure clarity and execution. 
  • Establish consistent reporting cadence for engagement status, metrics, and risks.  
  • Create executive-ready dashboards and summaries for leadership visibility. 
  • Drive internal storytelling on product adoption, innovation velocity, and customer value. 
  • Reinforce transparency, learning, and disciplined scale across the program. 
  • Seek to continuously grow by proactively seeking and embracing constructive feedback, as well as provide feedback to colleagues to encourage an open and collaborative culture.  

Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of portfolio/program management experience in mid/large-size software development companies. 
  • A solid understanding of SDLC and release management practices in cloud-based SaaS product organizations.   
  • Prior work delivering AI or intelligent workflow solutions at scale, with proven success in deploying AI solutions that delivered tangible customer impact. 
  • Familiarity with AI governance, compliance, and enterprise security practices.  
  • Up to 25% travel required (Customer Onsite). 

Preferred Qualifications:  

  • Demonstrated competence in key AI/ML software engineering program management best practices: program planning, schedule construction and management; risk assessment & mitigation, dependency management, change management, and predictive metrics. 
  • Outstanding collaboration and communication skills - clearly communicate changes, requests, and deadlines to the teams and risks, status, progress, and decisions to a variety of audiences including executives. 
  • Passion for working with people in technical and innovative environments, with the ability to work well with many different types of personalities in various functions. 
  • Strong leadership and relationship building skills to influence and motivate without authority - masterful in the art of bringing people together. 
  • Strong facilitation skills to lead/drive a variety of build events, with a high regard for quality, drive for continuous improvement across the organization, and ability to keep the big picture in view. 
  • Experience deploying AI solutions to production and skilled at identifying waste/delays in AI end-to-end development, deployment, and release processes is a plus. 
  • Exceptional team building and team management skills, including interpersonal skills, conflict resolution, and negotiation. 
  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving.

Because Carahsoft’s public sector and commercial business spans federal, state and local, and enterprise accounts, this role requires deep familiarity with US contracting vehicles, procurement rules, and reseller operations.

Distributor operating framework

Job Description

The Customer Success Executive—US Manufacturing is a senior individual contributor role within the Customer Excellence Group (CEG), responsible for driving customer outcomes, retention, and expansion across a portfolio of high-value US Manufacturing accounts. This role carries full accountability for the commercial health and strategic growth of assigned accounts—operating with the ownership mentality of a general manager at the account level.

This is not an account-monitoring role. We are looking for a commercially minded operator who has personally driven demonstrable YoY growth within a large portfolio, built trusted executive relationships, and executed cross-functional motions that convert platform adoption into measurable business outcomes. You will serve as the primary post-sales customer executive for your accounts—a strategic advisor to manufacturing CIOs and senior IT leaders—and partner closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, and peer CEG functions to ensure customers realize the full value of their ServiceNow investment and view us as a long-term digital transformation partner.

What you get to do in this role

• Own account-level commercial performance. Drive GRR, NRR, and renewal outcomes for your assigned accounts through proactive risk management, downsell prevention, and expansion motions.

• Engage at the executive level as a strategic advisor. Build and maintain trusted relationships with C-suite and senior IT stakeholders. Co-develop digital transformation strategies with customer executives, positioning ServiceNow as the strategic platform partner for their modernization and AI agendas. Bring relevant industry thought leadership and a consulting mindset to every engagement. Your executive presence and credibility at this level must be a proven strength, not an aspiration.

• Translate customer strategy into a ServiceNow roadmap. Take each customer’s enterprise priorities—modernization, cost-out mandates, AI ambitions—and map them to a phased ServiceNow roadmap that connects platform capabilities to measurable business outcomes. You bridge the gap between what the C-suite wants to achieve and how the platform gets them there.

• Run complex transformations in our largest accounts. Own governance, delivery excellence, and cross-functional orchestration across multiple business units and concurrent workstreams—defining governance models aligned to business and platform strategy and evolving them as engagements scale.

• Tell the story through data. Deliver compelling executive presentations—both internally and to customers—that articulate the value of ServiceNow through data-driven narratives. You are equally effective presenting a portfolio review to leadership and standing in front of a customer CIO making the case for platform expansion.

• Drive AI consumption and platform adoption. Own AI consumption as a strategic KPI within your accounts. Design and execute adoption journeys that convert license entitlements into measurable business outcomes, with a focus on emerging agentic capabilities.

• Set success metrics and drive value realization. Establish clear, measurable success metrics with each customer. Regularly review progress, proactively identify risks, and refine business transformation plans to

ensure milestones are met and value is realized. Work with internal teams and the customer to develop strategies that overcome barriers on the path to outcomes.

• Champion the voice of the customer. Synthesize industry-specific feedback, feature requests, and adoption blockers into structured input for Product Engineering and roadmap prioritization. Stay current on manufacturing industry trends, regulatory environments, and digital transformation priorities shaping your accounts.

• Operationalize customer health at scale. Define and manage operational KPIs for your portfolio—adoption, technical health, renewals, customer satisfaction, and expansion. Deliver regular reporting on customer health, adoption trends, downsell risk, and advocacy pipeline. Leverage AI-enabled tools and platforms to automate insights and drive proactive outreach.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience leading large-scale digital business transformations, acting as a trusted advisor to both internal and C-level customer executives. You combine deep post-sales expertise with the executive presence to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with manufacturing CIOs and a bias toward action that turns customer outcomes into revenue outcomes. You will be an expert in governance, strategy, value alignment, and execution across cross-functional teams, with a track record of delivering scalable, repeatable success. Your passion for driving customer success at an enterprise scale and your ability to work in complex, dynamic environments will be key to your success in this role.

To be successful in this role, you will need

• AI driven. Experience leveraging or critically evaluating how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.

• Educational background. BA/BS or equivalent required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

• Experience. 10–15 years of experience in management consulting, enterprise SaaS, senior customer success, or technology-enabled business transformation roles.

• Strategic account ownership. Demonstrated experience operating as the primary post-sales customer success executive—owning the commercial outcomes, adoption trajectory, and renewal health. You drive long-term commercial strategy with a deep understanding of how to grow and protect strategic relationships.

• Transformational leadership expertise. Demonstrated success in running large-scale, strategic account transformations and exceeding business objectives. Proven ability to build repeatable processes for scalable execution while maintaining a hands-on approach to ensure critical tasks are completed.

• Business acumen. Exceptional commercial instincts. You think in portfolio economics, understand the interplay between adoption, consumption, and revenue, and can translate customer outcomes into business impact narratives that resonate with Finance, Sales leadership, and executive sponsors.

• Executive presence and C-suite engagement. Proven ability to engage at the C-suite level—both with customers and internally. Direct experience partnering with CIOs and senior IT executives to co-develop digital transformation strategies. You bring gravitas, credibility, and the ability to influence without relying on positional authority.

• Data storytelling. Ability to translate complex adoption metrics, value realization, and portfolio performance into executive-level narratives that drive decisions.

• Cross-functional collaboration. Strong track record building productive relationships across Sales, Presales, Delivery, Product, and Enablement in matrixed, fast-paced environments. You lead through influence, not org-chart authority.

• Customer centricity and industry awareness. Deep understanding of how manufacturing enterprises operate, what drives their priorities, and where friction lives. You instinctively orient around the customer’s outcomes—anticipating concerns, removing barriers to satisfaction, and ensuring every interaction reinforces ServiceNow’s position as a trusted partner. Familiarity with adjacent verticals (Energy, Transportation, Services) is a plus.

• Platform knowledge. Experience overseeing technical account health—adoption telemetry, integration health, platform upgrades, and solution expansion. Background with AI/ML platform products or driving AI adoption programs is a significant differentiator.

• Adaptability and travel. Ability to thrive in a high-velocity, high-accountability environment. Willingness to travel domestically to strategic customer sites as required.

descriptionHtml:

Job Description

Platform Security Team

Platform Security builds foundational security infrastructure and AI-driven detection systems for enterprise-scale operations. Our mission is to make security proactive, intelligent, and seamlessly integrated into the ServiceNow platform. Outbound Security within Platform Security owns the controls on traffic leaving the ServiceNow platform across multiple domains: egress filtering and policy, outbound proxying, SSRF protection, data exfiltration prevention, and workload egress identity for a SaaS platform. This is core, regulated-environment security engineering.

Role Summary

As a Staff AI Security & Outbound Security Engineer, you will architect and deliver enterprise-scale security solutions that integrate outbound security systems with machine learning, reasoning engines, and real-time inference. You will bring deep expertise in network and application egress security, strong technical leadership, and hands-on machine learning depth. You will design and operate intelligent, adaptive security systems for egress control, outbound proxy infrastructure, and exfiltration detection at SaaS scale.

What You Get to Do in This Role

•       Design, build, and maintain high-quality, scalable, secure outbound security services meeting FIPS compliance and regulated-environment requirements

•       Architect and operate mission-critical egress services with reliability and security as first-class design constraints, not afterthoughts

•       Own services end-to-end on Kubernetes in a multi-tenant SaaS environment: deployment, scaling, on-call, incident response

•       Bring a security mindset to every design review: threat model the feature, not just the happy path. This is a deliberate area we're leveling up as a team

•       Evaluate where AI/ML has a legitimate role in outbound security, such as anomaly detection in egress traffic, ML-assisted destination risk scoring, and AI-assisted code review for SSRF and unsafe outbound-request patterns, and separate that from where it's a distraction

•       Collaborate with product owners, security architects, and platform teams to translate compliance and security requirements into working outbound security frameworks

•       Mentor engineers on secure coding, outbound-request pitfalls (SSRF, DNS rebinding, open redirects, unrestricted egress), and design review rigor

•       Stay current on evolving exfiltration techniques and egress-security advancements, including post-quantum readiness for outbound TLS, and bring that forward before it's a compliance deadline

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

•       8+ years of professional software engineering experience; Java, Go, or a comparable strongly-typed language at production scale

•       Strong CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, OO design, distributed systems tradeoffs

title: Senior Staff Technical Program Manager | Product Security
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

**PLEASE NOTE** This role has a minimum of 2 days per week in Santa Clara or San Diego offices requirement.

If you are unable to come into the Santa Clara office a minimum of 2 days per week, please do not apply. Thank you. 

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) 
 
The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) delivers world-class, innovative security solutions to reduce risk and protect the company and our customers. We enable our customers to migrate their most sensitive data and workloads to the cloud, accelerating our business so that we are the most trusted SaaS provider. We create an environment where our employees are proud to work and can make a positive impact.

This role exists so Product Security's technical programs land on time. It takes security strategy and turns it into defined workstreams with a credible sequence, then drives them to measured closure, and is technical enough to argue that sequencing and its tradeoffs directly with senior leaders rather than relaying them. This reports directly to the VP of Product Security. 


Five areas owned end to end:

  • Strategy to workstream translation. Takes strategic direction and ambiguous initiatives and decomposes them into defined workstreams with owners, dependencies, milestones, and a defensible sequence. Owns the "how and in what order," including what must be true before a workstream can start and what gets staged versus run in parallel.
  • Technical program delivery. Secure-by-default initiatives, tooling rollouts, and remediation campaigns from intake through closure and measurement. Owns the plan, the sequencing, and the outcome, not just the tracking.
  • Cross-team dependency and release coordination. Launches, sequencing, and critical-path management where Product Security gates an engineering ship. 
  • Engineering-facing delivery escalation. The first stop when security work is blocked or contested. Resolves at the engineering level wherever possible and escalates with a recommendation when it cannot.

Decision rights:

  • Decides: how strategy decomposes into workstreams and in what order they run; how individual programs are structured, sequenced, and staged; technical tradeoffs within a program; when a program is complete and what evidence closes it.
  • Recommends: prioritization tradeoffs across programs and workstreams; which initiatives to stop, defer, or absorb; where the strategy is not sequence-able as written and needs a scope or timeline change.

Key relationships:

  • VP, Product Security: escalation path for decisions that require prioritization authority. Not the day-to-day reporting relationship for portfolio status.
  • Product Security Directors and Team leads: Peers and delivery partners. Programs run through their teams; this role does not direct their employees.
  • Engineering partner teams: Internal customers for security work and the primary working relationship day to day.
  • Business Operations: Strategy and Business Operations sets strategic direction with the VP and leadership team and owns the operating rhythm, portfolio reporting, and OKR linkage; this role translates that direction into sequenced workstreams and supplies delivery truth back into it. Escalates cross-program conflicts, aging risk, and sequencing infeasibility here for prioritization.

Success at 6, 12, and 24 months:

  • 6 months. Has mapped the assigned programs and their dependencies across engineering and knows where the real constraints sit. Delivery status is reliable enough to report from.
  • 12 months. Takes net-new, ambiguous security initiatives and shapes them into sequenced, delivered outcomes without a playbook. Sequencing recommendations carry enough credibility that leadership shapes commitments around them before making them externally. Has visibly influenced how security requirements enter the SDLC upstream, with a measurable reduction in downstream remediation load.
  • 24 months. Takes net-new, ambiguous security initiatives and shapes them into delivered outcomes without a playbook. 
     

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 12 years of technical program or project management, with 3+ in security, product security, or a closely adjacent technical domain. Has independently run multi-team programs from intake to close. Or similar experience plus education
  • Hands-on software development background, or enough time embedded with engineering teams to read a codebase, follow an architecture discussion, and challenge an engineering estimate without translation.
  • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous strategic goal and produce a sequenced, resourced delivery plan that stakeholders commit to, including saying when the stated timeline is not achievable.
  • Experience in a large-scale product engineering organization shipping continuously at high volume, with the dependency and release complexity that comes with it.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive delivery through teams that do not report to them, including holding a release or negotiating an exception under pressure.
  • Familiarity with Secure Development Lifecycle frameworks such as NIST 800-218, BSIMM, and Microsoft SDL.
  • Familiarity with Software Development Lifecycle frameworks such as Agile, Scrum, and CI/CD.
  • Bachelor's in a technical or related field (CS, engineering, information security) or equivalent practical experience. Certifications that strengthen: PMP, CISSP, CSM, Security+.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Fred Luddy started ServiceNow with a simple idea: automate the tedious work so people can focus on what matters. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Security and risk sit at the center of how our customers run their businesses, and this role helps us extend that platform through partners across the security and risk ecosystem. Security and Risk is one of ServiceNow’s priority areas and hence, this role will be critical to driving growth via partner led motions.

Job Description

We are looking for a Director of Product Management to identify and lead product-led partnership opportunities across the security and risk ecosystem. You will set the product strategy for how ServiceNow partners with security and risk vendors, platforms, and service providers to deliver more value to customers than either could alone. This is an individual contributor role with enterprise-wide scope and executive-level influence. You will be the senior product leader and the internal authority on where these partnerships create the most value.

The ecosystem is broad and changing quickly, so this role is defined by a mandate rather than a fixed list of partners. You will evaluate where partnerships make sense, decide where to go deep now versus defer, and bring a clear product rationale to the decisions. You will partner closely with the security business unit, engineering, product marketing, business development, channel team, and sales to define and execute partnership strategy, track milestones, and measure results for ServiceNow and our customers.

What you will do:

  • Identify and qualify product-led partnership opportunities across the security and risk landscape, including security operations, agentic SOC, identity, threat and vulnerability management, governance, risk, and compliance.
  • Set strategy for and lead technical due diligence, integration architecture, and roadmap alignment, from qualification through activation-ready handoff to go-to-market.
  • Build the business case for partnership investment, and be accountable for the outcomes it projects.
  • Define success metrics such as adoption, attach rate, and win/loss, and incubate the first few customers adopting the joint solution to prove the better together outcomes.
  • Track competitive, regulatory, and technology trends across the ecosystem, and define the implications for our partnership strategy.
  • Shape leadership-level decisions on partner investment, co-sell motions, and joint roadmap commitments.
  • Lead cross-functional alignment with engineering, platform, product marketing, security, risk, and GTM business development. Represent ServiceNow in executive partner and customer conversations that need product-level technical context.

Qualifications

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About This Role

Australia’s most important private-sector industries are rethinking how they serve customers, manage operations and respond to disruption. That spans energy and resources through to retail and technology. As an Advisory Solution Consultant on our ANZ CRM & Industry Workflows team, you’ll help them work out what’s possible with ServiceNow.

This is a hands-on, multi-industry role. You’ll work with energy companies, utilities, miners, retailers, MSPs and tech companies. Every quarter brings different problems and different people to learn from. You’ll join a collaborative team that invests in your growth through mentoring, industry enablement and belonging groups. In return, we expect you to add to the team’s collective capability.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Lead discovery and shape solutions: Run discovery and design engagements. Turn business challenges into transformation strategies on ServiceNow’s platform. Think an energy company transforming field service, a utility modernising customer engagement, or a retailer unifying service channels.
  • Build and demonstrate: Design and deliver demonstrations that combine customer & industry workflows with partner technologies, AI agents and automation. Configure demo environments, stand up lightweight POCs, wire integrations and style portal experiences. You won’t always have a developer behind you. You need to be comfortable building things that work and fixing them when they don’t.
  • Develop industry expertise: Become a credible voice across your portfolio. Build solution frameworks, reference architectures and go-to-market plays. You don’t need to arrive as an expert in every sector. You do need the curiosity to build depth quickly.
  • Support account strategy: Partner with Sales to shape account strategies and build relationships that position you as a trusted advisor.
  • Build ecosystem relationships: Connect with Product Management, technology partners and consulting firms to advocate for customer needs and stay ahead of market shifts.
  • Contribute to the team: Share best practices and build reusable assets that lift the whole pre-sales organisation. Learn from senior Solution Consultants and grow your scope over time.

Why Join Us

ServiceNow is one of Fortune’s 100 Best Companies to Work For. You’ll get purposeful work that shapes how major organisations serve their customers. You’ll join a team that collaborates rather than competes. We invest in your growth through certifications, mentoring and peer networks. You’ll have flexibility and trust in how you work, competitive pay with salary, variable incentives and equity, and the autonomy to bring your own thinking to varied problems.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 7+ years in pre-sales solution consulting, sales engineering or a related technical advisory role. Ideally focused on customer experience, operational transformation or digital service workflows.
  • A solid technical foundation. You understand how front-ends, back-ends, APIs and data fit together well enough to build POC integrations and reason about where things break. You don’t need to be a developer. You do need the technical literacy to learn new tools quickly and work productively with AI-assisted development.
  • Proficiency with ServiceNow (particularly CSM, FSM and Industry Workflows) or equivalent hands-on depth on Salesforce, Pega, SAP or Dynamics. What matters is that you’ve built and configured things yourself.

Job Description

The Team Lead, Strategic Partner Operations runs the business for ServiceNow's largest GSI partnership and the partner operations engine behind it. The role owns the Pre-Buy motion end to end and extends well beyond it — into forecasting, operating rhythm, process and policy design, and governance — while acting as a strategic business partner to the sales team to remove blockers and scale what works. 

This is a hands-on IC4 team lead: an analytical operator who sets direction for a small pod of partner operations analysts, raises the bar on rigor, and leads with an AI-first mindset — using AI and automation to simplify how the business runs, eliminate manual work, and give leadership faster, more reliable insight. 

Run the Business: Forecasting & Operating Rhythm 

  • Own the partner business forecast — weekly and quarterly by GEO and stage (Commit / Expect / Upside / Pre-Pipeline), with call accuracy tracked and variance explained 

  • Design and run the operating cadence: weekly business reviews, pipeline inspections, quarter-end readiness, and QBR packages for partner and executive audiences 

  • Define and own the KPI framework and scorecards for partner performance — consumption, burndown, pipeline coverage, and partner health — anchored on a single source of truth 

  • Surface trends, risks, and opportunities proactively with a point of view and recommended action, before they become escalations 

Pre-Buy Program Ownership 

  • Own end-to-end Pre-Buy execution across both active contracts as reviewer and approver (not processor) of inventory tracking, burndown, OPTY validation, add-backs, swaps, and leftover reconciliation 

  • Deliver bridge-normalized burndown reporting and flag slow-burn patterns, stranded inventory, and expiration risk early 

  • Own LOI governance: interpret contract language into booking and comp guidance, and prevent LOI actions from triggering unintended downsell or GRR distortion 

Process, Policy & Governance 

  • Build robust, documented processes for partner deal intake, approvals, exceptions, and reconciliation — designed to scale with volume, not headcount 

  • Author and maintain partner operations policy (crediting, exceptions, program rules) with Finance, Deal Desk, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Comp, and drive clean adoption across the field 

  • Uphold governance and controls: approval audit trails, policy compliance, and decision logs that stand up to Finance and audit scrutiny 

  • Run continuous improvement — find the root cause of recurring escalations and retire them through process, policy, or system fixes 

Strategic Business Partner to Sales 

  • Act as the operational thought partner to GPLs, GPMs, and Partner Sales leaders — removing deal blockers, resolving policy gray areas, and accelerating pipeline through the right partner motions 

  • Serve as the first escalation point for field issues — mis-bookings, comp disputes, exceptions — resolving directly or packaging for leadership with a clear recommendation 

  • Own field and partner enablement: playbooks, SOPs, and self-serve reference materials that reduce recurring questions and speed deal execution 

  • Contribute to annual planning — partner targets, coverage inputs, and investment cases grounded in data 

AI-Led Simplification & Scale 

  • Lead the team's AI agenda: identify high-volume manual work (reporting, reconciliation, intake triage, policy Q&A) and redesign it with AI, agents, and automation 

  • Build and deploy AI-enabled tools — automated forecast and burndown reporting, anomaly detection on inventory and bookings, and assistants that answer policy and process questions for the field 

  • Set data quality and governance standards for AI use: human-in-the-loop review, accuracy checks, and responsible handling of partner and deal data 

  • Measure and communicate impact — hours returned, cycle-time reduction, forecast accuracy — and scale wins across Global Partner Operations 

Team Leadership 

  • Provide day-to-day leadership for a small pod of partner operations analysts — set priorities, review work quality, and coach for ownership and judgment 

  • Build the team's analytical and AI fluency through shared tooling, templates, and peer review 

  • Model calm urgency at quarter-end and serve as backup to the Director on partner operations decisions 

Qualifications

Required Qualification

  • 6+ years in Partner Operations, Sales or GTM Operations, Business Operations, or Sales Strategy in global enterprise SaaS 

  • Strong analytical background: forecasting, pipeline analytics, and KPI design, with advanced Excel/BI and SQL or equivalent data skills 

  • Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI to simplify or automate business workflows — GenAI assistants, agent workflows, or automation that removed manual effort at measurable scale 

  • Track record designing and enforcing process, policy, and governance in a cross-functional environment 

  • Experience leading, mentoring, or setting direction for analysts or project teams 

  • Experience working with or within a large GSI or strategic channel partner — understands how GSIs structure deals, allocate budgets, and consume licenses 

  • Comfort with enterprise SaaS deal mechanics: NNACV/ACV, GRR/NRR, revenue bridge normalization, crediting, and comp treatment 

  • Proven strategic partner to sales leaders, influencing across Finance, Legal, Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, and Comp without direct authority 

  • Executive communication: turns complex data into clear narratives and recommendations 

  • Operates with calm urgency in high-stakes, quarter-end environments with competing priorities 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience with prepaid, Pre-Buy, or inventory-based GTM models; familiarity with burndown accounting and OPTY reconciliation 

  • Prior experience supporting a large GSI relationship (Cognizant, Infosys, or similar) at global scale 

  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Power BI, SQL, and Python or low-code automation platforms 

  • Experience building with LLM tools or agent frameworks, including ServiceNow AI capabilities such as Now Assist 

  • Familiarity with LOI structures, deal governance, and revenue bridge accounting 

  • Experience running GEO-distributed programs across EMEA, AMS, APAC, and JPN

Job Description

Team

Platform Security builds foundational security infrastructure and AI-driven detection systems for enterprise-scale operations. Our mission is to make security proactive, intelligent, and seamlessly integrated into the ServiceNow platform. Cryptography within Platform Security owns the cryptographic backbone of the ServiceNow platform across multiple domains: certificate lifecycle, key management, secrets distribution, and workload identity for a SaaS platform. This is core, regulated-environment security engineering

Role Summary 

As a Staff AI Security & Crypto Engineer, you will architect and deliver enterprise-scale security solutions that integrate cryptographic systems with machine learning, reasoning engines, and real-time inference. You will bring deep expertise in applied cryptography, strong technical leadership, and hands-on machine learning depth — designing and operating intelligent, adaptive security systems for key management, PKI, and secrets infrastructure at SaaS scale.

What you get to do in this role :

  • Design, build, and maintain high-quality, scalable, secure cryptographic services meeting FIPS compliance and regulated-environment requirements
  • Architect and operate mission-critical crypto services  with reliability and security as first-class design constraints
  • Own services end-to-end on Kubernetes in a multi-tenant SaaS environment - deployment, scaling, on-call, incident response
  • Bring a security mindset to every design review: threat model the feature, not just the happy path — this is a deliberate area we're leveling up as a team
  • Evaluate where AI/ML has a legitimate role in the crypto/security space — anomaly detection in key usage, ML-assisted certificate lifecycle risk scoring, AI-assisted code review for cryptographic anti-patterns — and separate that from where it's a distraction
  • Collaborate with product owners, security architects, and platform teams to translate compliance and security requirements into working cryptographic frameworks
  • Mentor engineers on secure coding, cryptographic pitfalls, and design review rigor
  • Stay current on cryptographic advancements, including post-quantum readiness, and bring that forward before it's a compliance deadline

Qualifications

Preferred qualifications :

  • Direct experience in cryptography, PKI, key management, or secrets management — certificate lifecycle systems, HSM/KMS integration, or crypto-agility work
  • Some hands-on AI/ML exposure — not a research background, but real experience applying ML techniques to security/ops problems (anomaly detection, risk scoring, log/telemetry analysis) or critically integrating LLM tooling into engineering workflows
  • Experience with regulated environments (FIPS 140-2/3, FedRAMP, common criteria, or similar)
  • Exposure to post-quantum cryptography
  • Track record mentoring engineers and raising the security bar on a team, not just shipping features

Basic qualifications :

ServiceNow seeks a senior staff-level product security engineer to serve as a senior technical authority within the Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT). You will lead deep-dive investigations, coordinate resolution across engineering, product, and release teams, and demonstrate calm, decisive leadership during significant security events.

This is a role for someone who already understands product development cycles and the engineering and product relationships that drive them—and will use that fluency to lead fixes to completion under incident pressure. Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of auditing source code for security vulnerabilities.

  • Ability to read and comprehend Java and JavaScript code. 
  • Strong understanding of common Java and JavaScript vulnerabilities. 
  • Proficiency in scripting in both Python and JavaScript for data gathering, processing, and visualization. 
  • Development of proof-of-concept exploits for web application vulnerabilities. 
  • Written and verbal communication of complex security risk clearly to both technical teams and leadership.
  • Experience with leading fix implementation and release coordination across engineering, product, and test/release teams.
  • Proficiency in deep-dive product security investigations and root-cause analysis spanning design, code, configuration, and operational layers.
  • Exploit analysis and proof-of-concept development that distinguishes real exploitability from theoretical risk.
  • Familiarity with SDLC integration, CI/CD pipelines, SaaS threat models, and secure development practices.
  • Experience leading a CVE disclosure process, including CVE assignment, scoring (CVSS), and advisory publication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a PSIRT or similar function for a major software or SaaS platform.

Job Description

Team and Role 

This role is part of our Product Design team, which turns a deep understanding of our users and customers into product experiences they love. Our designers bring expertise across design systems, visual design, interaction design, content design, and product design. At ServiceNow, design has an intentional seat at the table, and we partner with engineering and product management from the outset. 

The Customer and Partner Experience Enablement Lead owns the strategy and execution of how ServiceNow’s implementers at customers or partners who are not UX professionals, learn to design great user experiences on the platform. The goal is faster customer adoption, faster time to value, and stronger satisfaction with what gets built. This role teaches UX and service design methods to people who aren’t UX practitioners and helps them see ServiceNow as a system of capabilities they can compose into solutions people want to use.  

This is an IC role with direct influence—no direct reports, but a clear mandate to set the strategy, align teams, drive organizational change, and ultimately help our customers, partners and ServiceNow succeed by vastly improving implementation experience outcomes. 

What you get to do in this role 

  • Design and deliver enablement that teaches UX and service design to implementers, adapted for people without design backgrounds. 
  • Own the content strategy and get enablement into the hands of implementers via events, social media, and the ServiceNow Community. 
  • Work cross-functionally with teams across ServiceNow to develop content and identify evolving UX enablement needs. 
  • Partner with the Design Enablement team to align internal and external programs, roadmap, and resources so that all stakeholders benefit from enablement efforts. 
  • Build relationships with ServiceNow’s implementation partners to drive and effect change that results in a strong UX focus for their ServiceNow implementation models. 
  • Establish relationships with customers’ ServiceNow teams to identify enablement needs focused on delivering great user experiences on ServiceNow. 
  • Serve as a customer liaison to the ServiceNow product design team. 
  • Take a leadership role (with the Design Enablement team) in planning and executing the Experience Organization’s presence at Knowledge (our annual user conference) and other customer/partner events. 
  • Shape how sales and partner enablement teams build UX focus into their messaging and curriculum. 

Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • 8+ years of UX experience in design or user research roles, with a focus on scalable enterprise platforms. 5+ years implementing an enterprise workflow platform with a human-centric approach. 
  • 2+ years direct experience implementing the ServiceNow AI Platform. 
  • Experience leveraging or critically evaluating how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. 
  • Previous work applying UX and service design methods to complex enterprise platform problems, and can show how that work changed the solution, not only the artifacts. 
  • Experience teaching UX methods to people without design backgrounds, such as engineers, administrators, consultants, or product managers, and can describe how those learners changed their work.
  • Strong writing, facilitation, teaching, and communication skills at all levels: from C-suite to developers/admins to users. 
  • Experience in managing high pressure situations requiring diplomacy. 
  • Communicates effectively across executive, delivery, and end-user audiences, adapting writing, facilitation, and teaching to each. 
  • Manages high-pressure situations with diplomacy. 
  • Strong program management and operational leadership skills, with the ability to translate strategy into clear priorities, coordinated execution, and measurable outcomes. 
  • Demonstrated success in organizational change management (OCM) aligning stakeholders and leading complex cross-organizational work through influence. 
  • Has influenced a partner or channel program through certification criteria, delivery methodology, or incentives. 
  • Has worked in consulting, professional services, or on the partner side of implementation.

Team

Platform Security builds foundational security infrastructure and AI-driven detection systems for enterprise-scale operations. This is core, regulated-environment security engineering

Role Summary 

As a Staff AI Security & Crypto Engineer, you will architect and deliver enterprise-scale security solutions that integrate cryptographic systems with machine learning, reasoning engines, and real-time inference. You will bring deep expertise in applied cryptography, strong technical leadership, and hands-on machine learning depth — designing and operating intelligent, adaptive security systems for key management, PKI, and secrets infrastructure at SaaS scale.

What you get to do in this role :

  • Design, build, and maintain high-quality, scalable, secure cryptographic services meeting FIPS compliance and regulated-environment requirements
  • Architect and operate mission-critical crypto services  with reliability and security as first-class design constraints
  • Own services end-to-end on Kubernetes in a multi-tenant SaaS environment - deployment, scaling, on-call, incident response
  • Bring a security mindset to every design review: threat model the feature, not just the happy path — this is a deliberate area we're leveling up as a team
  • Evaluate where AI/ML has a legitimate role in the crypto/security space — anomaly detection in key usage, ML-assisted certificate lifecycle risk scoring, AI-assisted code review for cryptographic anti-patterns — and separate that from where it's a distraction
  • Collaborate with product owners, security architects, and platform teams to translate compliance and security requirements into working cryptographic frameworks
  • Mentor engineers on secure coding, cryptographic pitfalls, and design review rigor
  • Stay current on cryptographic advancements, including post-quantum readiness, and bring that forward before it's a compliance deadline

Preferred qualifications :

  • Direct experience in cryptography, PKI, key management, or secrets management — certificate lifecycle systems, HSM/KMS integration, or crypto-agility work
  • Some hands-on AI/ML exposure — not a research background, but real experience applying ML techniques to security/ops problems (anomaly detection, risk scoring, log/telemetry analysis) or critically integrating LLM tooling into engineering workflows
  • Experience with regulated environments (FIPS 140-2/3, FedRAMP, common criteria, or similar)
  • Exposure to post-quantum cryptography
  • Track record mentoring engineers and raising the security bar on a team, not just shipping features

Basic qualifications :

  • 8+ years of experience in professional software engineering experience; Java, Go, or a comparable strongly-typed language at production scale
  • Strong CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, OO design, distributed systems tradeoffs
  • Production experience running services on Kubernetes (deployments, Helm, CI/CD) in a SaaS/multi-tenant environment — this is assumed, not a differentiator
  • Working understanding of core cryptographic primitives (symmetric/asymmetric encryption, hashing, digital signatures, TLS/PKI fundamentals)

  • Working understanding of internet protocols such as DNS, NTP, and HTTP. 
  • Works independently across interconnected systems and investigates root causes without waiting for direction. 
  • Experience integrating AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem solving. 
  • Has a learning mindset and is motivated to build new skills and bring real improvement to internal and external customers. 
  • Is an excellent oral and written communicator.

Staff Level additionally 

  • Drives architectural discussions and influences technical decisions to simplify and streamline infrastructure.

Job Description

ServiceNow's Advanced Technology Group is a customer-focused innovation team building intelligent software and AI-powered work experiences. We combine AI workers, workflows, chat, knowledge, and integrations to make complex enterprise operations accessible to everyday users.

Our researchers, applied scientists, engineers, designers, and product managers have a dual mission: build end-to-end products for customers while experimenting with and de-risking the technologies that will shape how people work.

The role

We are looking for an experienced, backend-leaning full-stack engineer who can take a problem and solve it across the product and system. You will build customer-facing capabilities spanning the browser, APIs, data models, realtime infrastructure, asynchronous jobs, and external integrations.

You will have the autonomy to shape problems, make sound architectural decisions, and own work from idea through production. We value engineers who are self-directed, pragmatic, curious, and uncompromising about security and software quality.

What you will do

  • Build AI-powered product capabilities across React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and shared contracts.
  • Own features from product definition and system design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operation.
  • Design secure APIs, authorization rules, data models, and backward-compatible migrations.
  • Build reliable asynchronous and realtime workflows using queues, pub/sub, jobs, schedules, and WebSockets.
  • Develop enterprise integrations involving OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, external APIs, and vendor failures.
  • Protect tenant boundaries and validate untrusted input across HTTP, sockets, queues, and AI tool execution.
  • Build, deploy, and operate services running on AWS and Kubernetes.
  • Diagnose production behavior using logs, traces, metrics, databases, and message brokers.
  • Work closely with product, frontend, AI, and platform engineers while independently driving execution.
  • Help evolve our engineering practices as AI changes how software is designed and built.

Qualifications

What we are looking for

  • Strong TypeScript fundamentals and production experience with React and Node.js.
  • A track record of driving complex, customer-facing features end to end with visible product impact.
  • Strong SQL and relational data-modeling skills, including transactions, indexes, and migrations.
  • Experience with asynchronous or distributed systems: queues, pub/sub, WebSockets, retries, and idempotency.
  • Sound API, schema, and backward-compatibility judgment.
  • Strong security instincts for multi-tenant authorization, credentials, uploads, and external input.
  • Experience with automated unit, integration, API, and end-to-end testing.
  • Product judgment and comfort operating without heavy specification or process overhead.
  • High ownership: you stay accountable for reliability and customer outcomes after the code ships.

AI Development Lifecycle

Hands-on ADLC experience is mandatory. You must have shipped software using AI across discovery, design, implementation, testing, review, documentation, and production debugging—not only used a coding assistant occasionally.

You know how to validate AI-generated work, define evaluations and regression criteria, manage context, and account for nondeterminism, hallucinations, latency, cost, privacy, and security. You retain human ownership of the architecture, code, and customer outcome.

You can design reliable AI execution paths involving prompts, structured outputs, agents, tools, approvals, schemas, authorization, retries, observability, and failure recovery. Model output is treated as untrusted input, and consequential actions require explicit authorization.

Our technology

TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Sequelize, Redis, RabbitMQ, Socket.IO, Zod, Nx, Vite, Vitest, Playwright, Sentry, AWS, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, Cursor, and Linear.

Experience with every technology is not required. Python, FastAPI, AI agent runtimes, MCP, enterprise integrations, and direct AWS infrastructure experience are valuable but not mandatory.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Job Description

At ServiceNow, we put AI to work for people. IT operations is where that matters most. When services slow down or fail, everyone feels it. Our IT Operations Management (ITOM) and AIOps portfolio helps organisations see their whole IT estate, predict issues before they reach users, and resolve them automatically. It sits at the heart of our Autonomous IT story.

Our UK & Ireland Specialist Presales Solution Consulting organisation is going through a significant evolution. We’re bringing separate specialist teams together into one organisation with one way of working: one front door for requests, deployment based on deal criteria rather than availability, and a shared set of measures across every domain. We’re doing it because customers buy the platform, not individual products, and our specialists need to show up as one team.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager to lead our ITOM and AIOps presales specialists through this change. This is a quota-carrying sales leadership role and a first-line people leadership role in equal measure. You’ll build a high-performing team, bring them with you through a new operating model, and make sure their expertise reaches the deals and customers where it makes the biggest difference.

How you’ll work with sales

Your team brings specialist depth when an opportunity needs it, and you share accountability for the result. In practice, that means:

  • Partnering with the Solution Consulting Directors in each core industry area: Enterprise Industries, Financial Services, Public Sector, Energy Telco & Media, and Ireland. Together you’ll agree which accounts and opportunities to prioritise, how specialists get engaged and how you’ll measure impact.
  • Running a criteria-based engagement model. Requests come through a single front door, self-service assets are offered first where they fit, and specialist time goes to the opportunities with the highest stage, value and complexity.
  • Building capability across the Core SC community so they can lead standard ITOM conversations and demos with confidence, spot when a specialist is needed, and bring your team in early.
  • Creating pipeline with the regions through specialist-led activities such as hands-on workshops, customer connect sessions and value labs, rather than waiting for opportunities to arrive.

You’ll succeed through influence, not reporting lines. Comfort with matrix management is essential.

What you get to do in this role

Lead and grow a high-performing team

  • Recruit, coach and develop a team of ITOM and AIOps specialists, growing experienced and emerging talent alike.
  • Set clear expectations, run consistent operational and team cadences, and hold the team to a high standard for customer impact and follow-through.
  • Build belonging and momentum in a team that’s adapting to a new way of working.
  • Develop specialists into T-shaped consultants: deep in ITOM and AIOps, and fluent in how IT operations connects to asset management, security, risk and data across the platform.

Champion the change

  • Actively support and help the Specialist Solution Consulting operating model. Translate it for your team, raise concerns early and model the behaviours you expect.
  • Establish consistent rules of engagement with Core SC, Account Executives and partners.
  • Be data driven using data to support business execution and change

Win deals and drive consumption

  • Lead from the front on strategic opportunities, owning the technical win for ITOM and AIOps alongside Core SC and sales.
  • Shape cross-domain, platform-level solutions with specialist peers in asset management, Risk & Security, Employee Workflows and Data & AI.
  • Make the CMDB a strength in every customer conversation. It’s the foundation of the ServiceNow platform, and your team brings the deepest expertise in the discovery and service mapping that keep it accurate.
  • Partner with our Customer Excellence Group to help customers adopt and get value from capabilities they already own.

Enable and influence

  • Own the ITOM and AIOps contribution to UK & Ireland SC enablement, from Level 100 for every Core SC to Level 200 champion tracks. Ensure your team is operating at Expert Level 300.
  • Track record of building and maintaining reusable assets: demos, use cases, discovery guides and points of view.
  • Develop industry points of view on IT operations, and represent ServiceNow at customer, partner and industry events.

Job Description

Role and team: 

We are looking for an experienced Senior Auditor to support planning and lead execution of global and/or regional operational and integrated audits spanning business operational controls, IT general controls and application controls. This remote position will be reporting to Director, Internal Audit Management. You’ll also help build the next version of Internal Audit by designing AI-enabled tools and automations that change how audits get done, not just using the tools others hand you. 

We have a tight team environment where support, loyalty, and honest feedback are the currency. ServiceNow employees are expected to be self-starting, proactive, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. 

What you get to do in this role: 

  • Support planning and scoping of operational and integrated audits across business and IT operations. Complete assignments efficiently and timely. 
  • Conduct walkthroughs, evaluate process design, and perform controls testing across both business processes and IT systems, consistently delivering quality audit work papers that support and substantiate audit observations. 
  • Identify manual or repetitive steps in the audit lifecycle and build AI-enabled solutions to automate them, such as prompt workflows, AI agents, scripts, or data pipelines for evidence gathering, testing, and workpaper drafting. 
  • Use data analytics and AI to test full populations when possible, identify control gaps, quantify risk exposure, and deliver data-driven insights to management. 
  • Document and share what you build so the team can reuse it, and help shape Internal Audit’s AI playbook. 
  • Assist in producing high-quality Internal Audit reports by clearly drafting audit issues and developing valid conclusions resulting in process and internal control improvements, while considering implementation requirements, cost, and stakeholder feedback. 
  • Timely and effective communication with audit leads on audit status, escalations, issues, and reporting. 
  • Perform action tracking follow-up with management for Audit Committee reporting purposes. 
  • Participate in major business initiatives and proactively advise and assist the business on key risks, control environment, and change initiatives. 
  • Contribute to the evolution of Internal Audit methodology, automation, and reporting, including ServiceNow IRM to scale audit coverage and quality. 
  • Responsible for internal stakeholder engagement, including the development of working relationships with key stakeholders and proudly representing the Internal Audit function.
