Job Description

What you get to do in this role:

About the team - The AI Services Platform Group at ServiceNow is a customer-focused innovation group building intelligent software and smart user experiences using existing and latest advanced technologies to enable end-to-end, industry-leading work experiences for customers. We are a group of researchers, applied scientists, engineers, and product managers with a dual mission. We build and evolve the AI platform, and partner with teams to build products and end-to-end AI-powered work experiences. In equal measure, we lay the foundations, research, experiment, and de-risk AI technologies that unlock new work experiences in the future.

We are seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer - AI/ML Inference Engineering to lead the architecture, optimization, and operational excellence of our AI inference platform. You will own the end-to-end inference lifecycle—from onboarding cutting-edge models to deploying optimized inference engines in production across multiple backends on Kubernetes infrastructure. You'll also architect the intelligent gateway layer using Envoy and ext_proc to enforce access control, provide observability, and enable advanced request routing. This role combines deep technical expertise in GPU compute, LLM APIs, inference frameworks, containerization, orchestration, and API gateway architecture with a bias toward pragmatic engineering and measurable performance impact. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Expertise in Go or Python, OOP, Design Patterns, time and space-efficient algorithms
  • Model-serving and runtime experience, such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server.
  • Exposure to LLM APIs or ML-serving systems, or a clear ability to ramp up quickly
  • Experience building new products that use challenging algorithms
  • Expertise in coding efficient, object-oriented, modularized and quality software
  • Knowledge of core AI/ML techniques and algorithms
  • Knowledge of unit testing, profiling, and code tuning


AI skills 

Artificial intelligence strategy is a critical skill at Experienced proficiency for IC5 — it applies to how you build and to what you build. 

  • Confident use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor, paired with the critical eye to review AI-generated code as rigorously as any other — catching logic errors, security anti-patterns, and missed edge cases rather than treating model output as production-ready. 
  • AI-assisted debugging and trace analysis, and a clear understanding of the data privacy rules governing what goes into a prompt.

Mandatory minimum 

  • 8+ years of Backend software engineering experience 
  • 4+ years of designing and operating distributed systems 
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related technical field required.
  • A master’s degree may offset up to one year of the experience minimum. Equivalent practical experience is considered where technical depth is clearly demonstrable.


Desired skills:

  • Deploy, scale, and operate services in production Kubernetes environments, including Helm-based deployments and CI/CD pipelines that make releases repeatable and safe to roll back. 
  • Own observability for what you build — meaningful metrics, useful logs, real tracing, and alerts that fire on customer impact rather than on noise. 
  • Debug and resolve production incidents independently, participate in on-call, run root-cause analysis, and operate against defined service level objectives.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer_Voice AI Agent Prompting
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The Forward Deployed Engineer, Voice AI Agent Engineering designs, builds, ships, and operates voice AI agents whose core behavior is model-driven rather than explicitly authored — conversational and agentic experiences that interpret caller intent over a live audio channel, reason over context, invoke tools, and act on the caller's behalf. The engineer works across the full lifecycle: shaping ambiguous call flows and telephony requirements into precise specifications, authoring the instructions and prompts that govern voice agent behavior, proving through automated evaluation that the result behaves correctly on real calls. This is not a machine learning or AI research role — the engineer does not train foundation or speech models — but it is distinct from traditional software engineering, where systems follow deterministic call-flow logic rather than selecting execution paths at runtime. 

Two things follow, and voice makes both harder. First, the agent's most important logic often lives in natural language — instructions, prompts, tool descriptions, and guardrails — which must be engineered, versioned, and reviewed with the same discipline as code, while also holding up under what a spoken channel adds: turn-taking, barge-in, and disambiguating what speech recognition got wrong. Second, because behavior is probabilistic and happens live on a call, correctness is established by measuring behavior at scale — including latency, containment, and transcription accuracy — rather than by asserting fixed outputs, making automated evaluation a first-class engineering activity rather than a quality-assurance afterthought. The engineer owns the correctness of what ships to a live caller, whether a human or an agent produced it. 

What You Get to Do in this role: 

  • Build voice AI agents. Design and ship agentic voice applications — intent interpretation, multi-step reasoning, tool invocation, and action on the caller's behalf — together with the CTI, CCaaS, and telephony integrations that make them usable in production. 

  • Design AI-driven autonomous voice workflows. Decompose call flows and business processes into the steps and decision points a voice agent can execute — determining where autonomy is appropriate, where a live-agent handoff is required, and how misrecognition, retries, and escalation are handled. 

  • Engineer for what voice demands. Build experiences that hold context across turns, manage barge-in and interruption, recover gracefully from speech-recognition error, disambiguate caller intent, and confirm before consequential actions — all within the latency budget a live call imposes. 

  • Author and maintain voice agent instructions. Write, structure, and version the system instructions, role definitions, tool descriptions, guardrails, and escalation rules that govern voice agent behavior — as engineering artifacts under review and regression coverage, not configuration text. 

  • Engineer prompts for reliability rather than demo quality. Iterate prompts against measured call outcomes: task decomposition, golden call transcripts, structured output schemas, grounding and citation, graceful hand-back to a human agent, and the token and latency cost that directly shapes caller experience. 

  • Build automated evaluation and test non-deterministic voice behavior. Design and operate the evaluation that makes change safe on a live channel — golden call datasets, multi-turn conversation suites, model-as-judge scoring calibrated to human QA review, CI gates, and drift detection — plus adversarial, jailbreak, grounding, and tool-selection testing specific to voice. 

  • Specify precisely and direct AI coding agents. Convert customer call-flow and telephony requirements into testable specifications with explicit scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria; decompose work into agent-sized tasks; and review agent output for correctness and maintainability. You own the result regardless of what produced it. 

  • Deliver as a forward deployed engineer, embedded in the voice stack. Work directly inside a customer's telephony, CTI, and CCaaS environment — building against their call data, integrations, and channels, tuning instructions and evaluation sets against live traffic, and returning with evidence that improves the product. 

  • Own quality, safety, and reliability on live calls. Monitor call containment, hallucination, unsafe actions, and transcription accuracy; defend against prompt injection and data leakage on live calls; and feed production call failures back into specifications and evaluation sets. 

  • Collaborate across product, design, and engineering. Partner with product managers, designers and platform teams to define success criteria, align on tradeoffs, and communicate capability and risk clearly. 

Qualifications

To Be Successful in This Role:

A demonstrated track record of building, shipping, and operating production voice applications, including hands-on delivery of AI-native voice agent features that real callers depend on rather than demos. Direct experience authoring agentic instructions and prompts for voice, designing AI-driven autonomous call workflows, and building the evaluation and testing that verifies them against live call traffic, is required. Willingness to work directly with customers in a forward deployed capacity, embedded in their voice and contact center environment, is required. At least 10 years of experience in software engineering with at least 2 years of experience in deploying contemporary AI solutions at customers.  

Education:Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees or certifications are a plus but are not a substitute for a demonstrated record of shipping reliable, production voice AI agents. 

Key Competencies, Skills, and Experience 

  • Software engineering fundamentals. Strong command of data structures, algorithms, system design, APIs, data modeling, and testing. 

  • AI native voice application development. Hands-on experience building applications where model-driven behavior is central — agent orchestration at the application layer, tool and function calling, context assembly, grounding against enterprise data, and handling the latency, cost, and failure modes unique to a live audio channel. 

  • AI-driven autonomous workflow design. Demonstrated experience designing workflows in which voice agents carry out multi-step call processes with limited supervision: call-flow decomposition, decision points and autonomy boundaries, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, exception and retry handling, and observability over what the agent did and why. 

  • Voice and telephony platform expertise. Practical experience with telephony integration, speech recognition and synthesis, and streaming audio — including the barge-in, turn-taking, and confirmation patterns a live call requires. 

  • Agentic instruction authoring. Demonstrated skill writing and maintaining the natural-language logic that governs voice agent behavior — instructions, role definitions, tool descriptions, guardrails, and refusal and escalation rules — with versioning, review, and regression coverage applied as they would be to code. 

  • Prompt engineering. Intent-driven prompt design tuned for voice: decomposition, golden and few-shot examples, structured output and schema enforcement, grounding and citation, and disciplined iteration against call-level evaluation results rather than impressions. 

  • Evaluation and testing of non-deterministic voice systems. Ability to build measurable frameworks assessing call quality, agent behavior, tool-selection accuracy, and regression risk — golden call datasets, scenario suites, model-as-judge scoring with human QA calibration, continuous evaluation pipelines, and drift detection — plus adversarial, jailbreak, and grounding testing. 

  • Specification precision and architectural judgment. Ability to define call-flow problems rigorously enough that another engineer or an AI agent implements them correctly, and to decide soundly when to solve a problem in code, in instructions, or by delegating to an agent. 

  • Safety, security, and data handling. Working knowledge of risks specific to AI-integrated voice applications — prompt injection, sensitive-data and call-recording leakage, over-broad tool access, unsafe autonomous action — translated into concrete guardrails, least-privilege controls, and monitoring. 

  • Forward deployed delivery and stakeholder communication. Comfort working directly with customers inside their telephony environment under incomplete information and fixed timelines, judgment about when a fast local solution is right and when to hold out for the durable one, and credibility communicating capability, limitation, and risk to non-engineers. 

Desired Experience 

  • Forward deployed or customer-embedded delivery. Prior work as a forward deployed engineer, solution engineer, or in professional services, delivering software inside a customer's environment. 

  • Voice and contact center technology. Telephony and contact center platforms, IVR, speech recognition and synthesis, streaming audio, and real-time latency optimization. 

  • Conversation design partnership. Experience working alongside conversation or content designers, contributing to dialogue flow, tone, and error-recovery design. 

  • Evaluation and observability tooling. Evaluation frameworks, prompt and instruction management tooling, tracing for LLM applications, and analysis of production call transcripts at scale. 

  • Enterprise domain depth. Customer service, contact center operations, sales, or enterprise workflow, at a depth sufficient to challenge a requirement rather than only implement it. 

  • Years of Experience. At least 10 years of experience in software engineering with at least 2 years of experience in deploying contemporary AI solutions at customers

title: Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

会社概要 

すべての始まりは2004年、カリフォルニア州の陽光あふれるサンディエゴで始まりました。革新的なエンジニアであるフレッド・ラディが、働き方を変革できる可能性を見出したのです。 

それから今日まで、ServiceNowはグローバル市場のリーダーとして、革新的なAI強化テクノロジーを8,100社以上のお客様に提供し、その中にはFortune 500に選ばれた企業が85％程含まれています。 

当社のインテリジェントなクラウドベースプラットフォームは、人・システム・プロセスをシームレスにつなぎ、組織がよりスマートで迅速、そして優れた働き方を実現できるよう支援します。 

しかし、これは私たちの旅の始まりに過ぎません。世界をより良く働ける場所にするという目的を追求する私たちと共に歩みませんか？ 

Job Description

職務内容 

Impact GuidedのCSMは、複数の顧客を担当し、効率的かつスケーラブルな方法で顧客のビジネス成果達成を支援します。ServiceNow製品の採用と活用を促進し、顧客が最大限の価値を得られるよう、標準化されたガイドやベストプラクティスを提供します。また、顧客からの技術的な相談に対する一次窓口として、基本的な技術的知識を活かし、適切な対応や社内連携を行います。 

具体的な業務内容： 

  • 複数の顧客を同時に担当し、共通課題に対する標準化されたソリューションを提供 

  • 顧客のビジネス目標を理解し、成果達成に向けたアクションを計画・実行 

  • 製品の利用状況をモニタリングし、最新バージョンへの移行や技術的健全性を維持 

  • 顧客の状況に応じたガイドやコンテンツを活用し、利活用率と利用範囲を拡大 

  • 成功事例やベストプラクティスを共有し、顧客の価値最大化を支援 

  • 顧客との信頼関係を維持しながら、技術的な質問や課題を適切に把握し、迅速な解決に向けた調整を実施。必要に応じて社内の専門チームと連携し、円滑なエスカレーションを推進。 

  • 社内チームと連携し、スケーラブルなデリバリーを実現 

Qualifications

応募資格 

  • 顧客向けプロフェッショナルサービスまたはカスタマーサクセス領域での7年以上の経験 

  • プリセールス活動における顧客提案や技術的デモンストレーションの経験を活かし、顧客の課題解決や価値訴求などポストセールスに新たに挑戦したい方

  • AIを業務プロセスや意思決定に統合する方法を考え、活用した経験（AIツールの利用、ワークフロー自動化、AI分析の活用など）

  • グローバルクラウドベンダーのSaaSソリューションにおける販売、導入、展開、拡張、運用の各フェーズでの技術的支援経験

descriptionHtml:

Job Description

As a Sales Coach, you will work one on one with sellers to lift pipeline generation, deal quality, and forecast accuracy. This is a hands-on field coaching role. You will spend most of your week with sellers and in live deal work, and the rest building the programs that scale what works. You report to the manager of the department and partner closely with frontline sales managers, enablement, product marketing, and the teams integrating newly acquired sellers.

What you get to do in this role:

Coach sellers one on one - This is the center of the role. You will spend most of your week with individual sellers, working on whatever stands between them and their number.

● Run a recurring one-on-one coaching cadence with each assigned seller against a written individual development plan

● Coach the full seller motion—prospecting and outbound rigor, territory and account management, deal management and qualification, executive presence, time and calendar management, CRM accuracy and forecast hygiene, and personal change management through reorgs and portfolio shifts

● Facilitate role plays and certification checkpoints across discovery, executive conversations, pricing, objection handling, and competitive positioning, so mastery is demonstrated rather than assumed

● Observe live customer calls and give same-day feedback that names the specific behavior to change

Build coaching programs with your manager

● Partner with your manager to design programs that answer real business needs—segment ramp paths, focused skill sprints, manager coaching enablement, and remediation tracks

● Build segment-appropriate variants where Enterprise and Commercial need different treatment of the same skill—multi-stakeholder pursuit strategy and executive alignment on one side, call volume, cycle discipline, and portfolio juggling on the other

● Design coaching that scales across a large Commercial population without losing the personal quality that makes coaching work

● Contribute reusable assets back to the global library: playbooks, call frameworks, role play scenarios, and certification rubrics

● Pilot, measure, and retire—keep what moves the number and cut what does not

Support large-scale training events

● Help design and deliver org-wide moments: sales kickoff, bootcamps, mid-year kickoffs, product launch enablement, and field readiness days

● Own assigned tracks end to end—content, facilitators, breakout design, certification, and the reinforcement plan that follows

● Build the follow-through so event content shows up in seller behavior 30 and 60 days later

Document and report progress

● Build and maintain the documentation layer that makes coaching visible and auditable—rep scorecards, skill matrices, certification records, development plans, and progress over time

● Report coaching impact to sales and enablement leadership on a set cadence, tied to business results rather than activity counts

● Keep records consistent enough that another coach could pick up any rep and know exactly where they stand

Shorten time to productivity for new hires, transfers, and acquired teams

● Own the coaching side of ramp for new hires, internal transfers, and sellers joining through acquisition, with an explicit goal of moving time to productivity from roughly six months to three

● Build and run acquisition-specific enablement: cross-portfolio positioning, joint account mapping, tooling and process conversion, and the cultural onboarding that makes acquired sellers feel like part of the team quickly

● Track ramp milestones by cohort and flag an at-risk ramp early enough to fix it

● Give hiring managers a clear read on where each new seller stands and what they need next

Validate readiness on new products, releases, and acquisitions

● Assess whether sellers are genuinely equipped to sell new products, new releases, and newly acquired portfolios—measured through certification, call review, and pipeline evidence, not attendance

● Report readiness gaps to product, marketing, and enablement partners with a recommended fix and a date

● Re-test after remediation and close the loop

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

● Seven or more years in enterprise or commercial software sales, sales management, or sales coaching and enablement

● Direct experience with both a large-deal Enterprise motion and a higher-velocity Commercial or mid-market motion, and a clear point of view on how coaching differs between them

● A track record of coaching adults to behavior change—specific sellers or teams who improved on a measurable metric because of your work

● Fluency in at least one recognized sales methodology, such as MEDDICC, Challenger, Strategic Selling, or Command of the Message, and the ability to coach to it rather than just describe it

● Strong CRM discipline—you can inspect a pipeline and tell the difference between a data problem and a deal problem

● Comfort with the enablement stack: CRM, conversation intelligence, sales content management, and a learning management system

● Credibility with senior sellers and frontline managers—this role carries influence, not authority

● Excellent facilitation and written communication skills, and the judgment to know when to teach and when to ask

Nice to Have:

● Prior quota-carrying experience at both Enterprise and Commercial

● Experience coaching across a multi-product or platform portfolio

● Formal coaching certification, such as ICF or equivalent

● Experience integrating an acquired sales team

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. Job Description

ServiceNow’s Product Security organisation is building a dedicated Security R&D function — a software engineering team that builds security capabilities with the same engineering rigour as ServiceNow’s product organisation. We are looking for a Staff Security Engineer to be a core contributor on this team.

Security R&D operates in two complementary modes: open contribution to product engineering — writing code alongside product teams where security expertise adds value — and developing its own security capabilities, including internal tooling, externally facing product features, AI-powered security automation, and third-party integrations.

This is a new team being stood up in Petah Tikva, Israel, co-located with ServiceNow’s AI Security Research team. You will help shape the team’s engineering practices and technical foundation from day one.

This role reports to the Sr. Engineering Manager, Security R&D.

What You Will Do

Build Security Capabilities

  • Design and develop security tooling, automation, and platform services that operate at ServiceNow’s enterprise scale.
  • Contribute code directly into ServiceNow product engineering codebases, embedding security capabilities where they have the highest impact.
  • Build AI-powered security automation by integrating in-house models and third-party services into production workflows.
  • Leverage ServiceNow’s platform — Agent Framework runtime, ACL enforcement, data layer, and workflow engine — to create security capabilities that external vendors cannot match.

Collaborate Across Teams

  • Work closely with the AI Security Research team on tooling for AI agent security, translating research insights into production-grade engineering.
  • Partner with product engineering teams during open contribution engagements, earning trust through code quality, reliability, and delivery.
  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and architecture discussions, contributing to the team’s technical standards and engineering culture.

Grow with the Team

  • Help define engineering best practices as a founding member of the Security R&D team.
  • Contribute to hiring and onboarding as the team scales, helping maintain the engineering bar.
  • Stay current on emerging AI/ML technologies and security threats, bringing new ideas into the team’s roadmap.

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Builder-led culture: Security R&D is defined by engineering output, not advisory reviews. We build production security capabilities with the same discipline as product engineering.
  • Dual operating model: The team both contributes directly to product engineering and develops its own security products and services.
  • Platform advantage: ServiceNow owns the entire stack — runtime, ACLs, data layer, workflow engine. You will build security capabilities that no external vendor can replicate.
  • Founding team: This is a new team being built from scratch. You will shape its engineering culture, technical standards, and identity from day one.
  • AI intersection: The role sits alongside the AI Security Research team, placing you at the frontier of securing AI systems at enterprise scale.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you have:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building production systems at scale.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Strong hands-on proficiency in Python and Java. You write production code daily and take pride in software craftsmanship.
  • Strong, hands-on experience and a solid understanding of AI/ML pipelines, LLM integration, and agentic frameworks, including their underlying architectures and workflows.
  • Solid foundation in distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and building services that meet enterprise requirements for scalability, reliability, and performance.
  • Experience working in collaborative engineering environments, contributing to shared codebases with high code quality standards.
  • Interest in or exposure to security engineering concepts — application security, infrastructure security, identity systems, or trust & safety. A security mindset is valued; deep security expertise can be developed on the team.

Preferred

  • Experience with security tooling development, SSDLC automation, or building security features into a product.
  • Familiarity with container/Kubernetes environments, cloud security, or infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience in a SaaS or platform company building multi-tenant enterprise software.
  • Experience working in a globally distributed engineering team.

descriptionHtml:

Job Description

As a Senior HRBP Manager, Finance & Strategy, you are a business leader who specializes in building and enabling high-performing organizations. You'll immerse yourself in the business to understand strategic priorities, operating models, and future growth plans, then translate those insights into workforce strategies that drive measurable business outcomes.

What sets this role apart is how you'll think about the future of work. As ServiceNow continues to lead in the AI era, you'll partner with Finance & Strategy leaders to redesign how work gets done, helping determine where AI can augment work, where human capabilities create the greatest value, and how organizational structures must evolve to support future business success.

You'll serve as a trusted thought partner to Finance & Strategy leadership, using a combination of business acumen, workforce planning, organizational design, change management, and talent expertise to help shape the future of the organization. This role requires someone who can move fluidly between strategic planning and execution, influence senior leaders, and help drive transformation at scale.

You'll partner with leaders to understand how AI is changing work across Finance & Strategy, helping them rethink workflows, operating models, and talent strategies to prepare for what comes next. You'll advise leaders on how work should evolve, where AI can create leverage, how roles and teams may change over time, and what skills and capabilities will be required to succeed in an AI-first environment.

You will serve as a strategic HR Business Partner focused on Finance & Strategy and play a critical role in shaping the future workforce, operating models, talent strategy, and organizational effectiveness of the function.

What You Get to Do in This Role

  • Immerse yourself in the Finance & Strategy organization to understand strategic priorities, business challenges, and operating objectives. Partner with leaders to translate business goals into actionable workforce, talent, and organizational strategies.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, helping them navigate growth, transformation, organizational design, talent decisions, and evolving workforce needs.
  • Partner with leaders to assess how AI, automation, and emerging technologies are changing the way work is performed. Help identify opportunities to redesign workflows, optimize operating models, and reimagine how work is shared between humans and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Drive workforce planning efforts by anticipating future capability needs, identifying skill gaps, developing succession plans, and building strategies that position the organization for long-term success.
  • Lead annual talent processes including performance management, talent reviews, succession planning, calibrations, leadership assessments, and development planning with a consistent and equitable approach.
  • Analyze people and business data to identify trends, organizational risks, and opportunities related to engagement, performance, retention, productivity, and workforce readiness. Develop recommendations and action plans informed by data and business insights.
  • Partner closely with Compensation, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, People Analytics, Learning & Development, and other Centers of Excellence to deliver scalable solutions aligned to business priorities.
  • Influence leaders through change and transformation initiatives, helping teams adopt new ways of working and ensuring organizational change is effectively embedded and sustained.
  • Advise leaders on organizational structure, role design, team effectiveness, and operating model evolution. Help leaders think strategically about future-state organizations and the capabilities required to support them.
  • Help shape a modern, AI-forward HR function by contributing to innovative people practices, talent strategies, and operating models that can scale across the enterprise.
  • Foster an inclusive, high-performance culture where employees feel engaged, supported, and empowered to deliver meaningful business impact.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you have:

  • Proven experience partnering with senior leaders to solve complex business challenges and drive workforce and organizational strategies.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to think and operate like a business leader, balancing people, operational, and financial considerations.
  • Experience leading large-scale organizational transformation, operating model redesign, workforce modernization, or strategic change initiatives.
  • Understanding of how AI is transforming work, workforce planning, organizational design, and talent strategy, with the ability to guide leaders through these changes.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage people analytics and business data to identify trends, make recommendations, and influence decisions.
  • Exceptional influence and change-management capabilities, with a proven ability to drive adoption and behavioral change across organizations.
  • Experience supporting Finance, Strategy, Corporate Functions, Business Operations, or other highly analytical business organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in strategy, consulting, business operations, organizational effectiveness, workforce transformation, or change management environments is highly valued.
  • Ability to move seamlessly between strategic thinking and hands-on execution in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Outstanding relationship-building, communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.

Job Description

This role includes on-call rotation responsibilities.

Team:

Our SWAT (Software Action Team) ensures the production stability of our customer application(s) and infrastructure services from an operations perspective. Our engineers are responsible for production stability and "champions at all service levels” and act as the last level of support for our customers (internal and external). 
The ideal candidate for this position is a software engineer with a strong background in database technologies, performance analysis, and strong troubleshooting skills. The candidate must have a passion for chasing issues of complex systems running under dynamic, real-world loads. You will work in a fast-paced, innovative environment that allows direct influence on the organization and all our customers. In this role you will support the infrastructure by learning the platform from end to end.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Become an SME in production database troubleshooting, ServiceNow instance performance issues and Linux performance analysis on prem and on Hyperscaler
  • Own complex incident RCA across multi-tenant PostgreSQL/MariaDB fleets at scale
  • Develop observability and automation to prevent recurrence of critical issues
  • Influence infrastructure decisions that shape our multi-tenant cloud platform
  • Mentor and collaborate with engineers across operations, support, and development

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 3 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD without experience; or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of experience supporting or testing large scale web-based distributed applications
  • 5+ years of experience on multiple relational databases (especially on Postgres database)
  • The database experience should include but not limited to MVCC, transaction management, vacuum mechanics, database and query performance tuning, buffer management, WAL architecture, backup/restore etc.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience working on a SaaS, PaaS, or Cloud Infrastructure product/solution
  • Unix skills: including development, navigation, file manipulation, permissions, searching/finding files and text contents, and administrative actions
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with an aptitude for learning new technologies
  • And most importantly, eagerness to learn everything about the ServiceNow Platform

Desired Skills:  

  • Experience with ServiceNow platform, scripting, tuning, and troubleshooting is highly preferred.
  • Scripting: basic shell scripting, Python, Javascript, Ansible
  • Good understanding of schemas, table spaces, indexing, and database performance optimization
  • Familiarity or knowledge of CentOS/RedHat operating system
  • Formal experience on a DevOps(Kubernetes and CICD pipeline) or Performance or support team supporting a Web-Based application is desired.

title: Senior Director, Product Creative Direction
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Team and Role 

This role is part of our Product Design team, which turns a deep understanding of our users and customers into product experiences they love. Our designers bring expertise across design systems, visual design, interaction design, content design, and product design. At ServiceNow, design has an intentional seat at the table, and we partner with Engineering and Product Management from the outset. 

We're looking for a Senior Director of Product Creative Direction to define and evolve the visual expression of our product portfolio. This leader will set a distinctive product visual direction, translate it into a scalable system, and help teams make complex enterprise software feel clear, coherent, modern, and unmistakably ServiceNow. 

This is a product-focused creative leadership role. You will work as part of cross-functional software development teams and partner across Platform and the business units to connect creative vision with customer needs, product strategy, and technical realities. Product teams retain ownership of their product strategy, design, roadmap, quality, and delivery; this role provides shared visual direction, systems, critique, and enablement. 

You will also advance the responsible use of AI in creative work and make accessibility intrinsic to the product visual language. 

What you get to do in this role 

  • Define and champion a differentiated visual direction for the product portfolio, grounded in our brand, customer needs, product strategy, and the evolving relationship between people and AI. 

  • Establish a clear point of view across typography, color, composition, iconography, illustration, motion, data visualization, density, and other visual foundations. 

  • Create future-state concepts, reference experiences, and exemplars that make the visual direction tangible. 

  • Work with Design Systems, Product Design, Content Design, Accessibility, Localization, and Research to translate the visual language into scalable foundations, components, patterns, and guidance. 

  • Partner with Design Systems, Product Management and Engineering throughout the software development lifecycle so the creative direction can be applied effectively in shipped products. 

  • Define where consistency is essential, where variation creates value, and how teams can extend the system without creating a centralized bottleneck. 

  • Lead the strategy for AI-enabled creative exploration, prototyping, asset creation, system evolution, and evaluation, focusing on meaningful gains in range, speed, consistency, and quality. 

  • Move promising AI approaches from experimentation to repeatable practice through pilots, playbooks, training, exemplars, responsible-use standards, and measurable adoption goals. 

  • Provide creative direction and hands-on critique for priority, cross-product initiatives while reinforcing product-team ownership. 

  • Partner with Brand and Marketing so the company expression and product experience tell a coherent story while remaining useful and native to interactive software. 

  • Make accessibility intrinsic to the creative vision and visual foundations, partnering with Accessibility and Engineering to meet or exceed applicable standards, including WCAG 2.2 AA. 

  • Lead, develop, and attract exceptional visual, motion, and multidisciplinary design talent. 

  • Build the culture, enablement, and shared critique practices that help product designers and distributed visual designers understand, apply, and continually raise the visual craft bar. 

  • Build a network of creative leaders and contributors across the business units who can extend the direction while maintaining coherence. 

Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications 

  • 12+ years of experience in product design, visual design, experience design, creative direction, or a related field, including significant leadership experience shipping complex digital products. 

  • A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft and creative leadership across shipped product experiences, not only brand campaigns or marketing communications. 

  • Experience defining or materially evolving a visual language across a complex, multi-product software portfolio. 

  • Deep understanding of design systems, including visual foundations, design tokens, components, patterns, governance, contribution models, and the relationship between design and code. 

  • Demonstrated experience adopting AI-enabled creative tools and workflows and moving teams from isolated experimentation to sustained, responsible use at scale.

Job Description

The Senior Executive Talent Sourcer, Go-to-Market is a strategic member of our Executive Search team, dedicated to identifying and engaging Senior Director+ leaders across our revenue organization. You will be a trusted market advisor to recruiters and hiring leaders: mapping talent markets, shaping search strategy with data, and building calibrated slates of executives who can sell and scale AI in the enterprise. 

This role primarily supports searches based in the United States, with partnership on global GTM searches as needed. 

What you'll do 

  • Partner with executive recruiters and GTM hiring leaders at intake to define and challenge the search: the problem the role solves, the profile that fits, and where that talent sits in the market. 

  • Build market maps and competitive org charts across enterprise software, AI, cybersecurity, and hyperscaler sales organizations, and keep them current as leaders move. 

  • Identify, engage, and qualify Senior Director+ GTM leaders, assessing quota and attainment history, deal size, segment, team scale, and experience selling AI and consumption-based offerings. 

  • Deliver calibrated talent slates with a clear point of view on each candidate and on the market overall. 

  • Use market data, including compensation benchmarks, talent supply, and competitor moves, to advise hiring leaders and adjust search strategy when the market doesn't match the spec. 

  • Source for emerging roles without established titles, such as forward-deployed engineering, AI specialist overlays, and AI value realization, by mapping capabilities rather than matching titles. 

  • Use AI tools every day for research, mapping, and outreach, and help the team improve how we source. 

  • Create a high-touch, discreet experience for every executive you engage, whether or not they join ServiceNow. 

  • Manage multiple concurrent executive searches while maintaining pipeline quality and responsiveness. 

Search areas 

You will support Senior Director+ searches across the GTM organization focusing on talent that often comes from enterprise software, AI platforms, cybersecurity, hyperscalers, and GSIs. 

Qualifications

What you bring 

  • Current executive sourcing experience at the Senior Director+ level, in retained executive search or an in-house executive search team. 

  • 3+ years focused on sourcing executive level GTM/Sales leadership in enterprise software, AI, cybersecurity, or cloud infrastructure. 

  • Fluency in GTM metrics and the ability to qualify a sales leader's track record: quota, attainment, ACV, net revenue retention, deal size, segment, and team scale. 

  • Strong understanding of GTM compensation, including OTE, base and variable mix, accelerators, and equity, and how it shapes candidate motivation and offer strategy. 

  • Deep knowledge of the enterprise GTM talent landscape: key competitors, how their sales organizations are structured, and recent leadership moves. 

  • Hands-on use of AI tools in sourcing, research, and market mapping, plus the ability to assess a candidate's real experience selling and scaling AI. 

  • Proven ability to build market maps and use talent data to influence hiring leaders and change search strategy. 

  • A track record of building diverse, calibrated executive slates across multiple concurrent searches. 

  • Executive presence, discretion, and clear written and verbal communication with senior candidates and hiring leaders. 

  • The judgment to work independently and the instinct to collaborate closely with recruiting partners. 

  • Knowledge of the cybersecurity and identity GTM landscape. 

  • Experience sourcing for GSI and hyperscaler alliance leadership or co-sell roles. 

  • Experience sourcing in the context of M&A, including identifying and retaining GTM talent from acquired companies. 

  • Familiarity with talent intelligence platforms and executive compensation data sources.

Job Description

We are seeking a motivated and experienced lawyer specialized in Employment Law to join our Global

We are seeking a motivated and experienced lawyer specialized in Employment Law to join our Global Employment Law team to support the continued growth of ServiceNow across Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA). The role will report to the Senior Director, Global Employment Law.    

We are open to hiring this role in any of our major hubs across Europe. 

The Director, Global Employment Law, EMEA will be primarily responsible for providing legal counsel and partnership to the Global People Organization and other key internal stakeholders globally on employment law matters.  This is a unique opportunity to play a pivotal role in ServiceNow’s expanding legal team and to work on challenging legal issues in an exciting, fast-paced environment.   

What you get to do in this role:   

  • Help us build a culture of high performance and great inclusion. Deliver business oriented, risk-based advice and counsel on the full range of employment law issues including: hiring, separations and dismissals, employee relations issues, restructurings, works councils and collective consultation, compensation and benefits, leaves of absence, global workforce innovation and culture, workplace investigations and employee relations, and employee privacy matters. Fully understanding the legal requirements is the starting point – treating people fairly and creating an amazing working environment is the end point   

  • Partner with our Global People Organization to create and revise global and locally compliant policies and procedures consistent with our values   

  • Partner with our Ethics & Compliance, Employee Relations, and Global People teams to conduct prompt, thorough investigations into employee concerns   

  • Lead strategy and advise on works council, trade union, and collective employee relations matters across EMEA, partnering with the Global People Organization and senior leadership on information and consultation processes  

  • Advise and collaborate with the Global People Organization to develop and implement global programs  

  • Develop and deliver best in class employee related trainings   

  • Manage employment claims and litigation matters across EMEA, including selecting and managing outside counsel   

  • Partner and collaborate with other members of the Global Employment Law team on global projects and issues   

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to EMEA senior leadership on complex, high-risk employment matters, including multi-country restructurings, M&A and M&A integration, workforce transformation, and executive matters  

  • Deliver strategic advice and counsel on the development and deployment of AI tools in the employment lifecycle, including advising on works council consultations and agreements  

  • Contribute to the development of ServiceNow's Legal Services Delivery applications, envisioning, creating, and deploying workflows on the ServiceNow Platform   

  • Monitor and maintain knowledge of changes in EMEA employment laws and regulations and industry practices that impact our business, and provide practical advice and support to the business regarding the same   

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging and critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, and problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function  

  • A strong work ethic, exceptional judgment, and uncompromising integrity   

  • A law degree with strong academic credentials    

  • Fully qualified lawyer in good standing in a relevant European jurisdiction (preferably France, Germany, Ireland or the UK)    

  • A minimum of 12+ years of relevant legal experience practicing employment law at a top law firm and/or in-house legal department of a multi-national company; high tech experience a plus. In-house experience at a global employer strongly desirable.   

  • Deep employment law experience across a variety of EMEA jurisdictions, including leading works council and collective consultation processes, and a desire to develop and expand expertise   

  • Proven track record leading complex EMEA employment litigation and multi-country restructurings, including management of outside counsel   

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, a good sense of humour, and a proven ability to build strong and deep working relationships with internal stakeholders over multiple geographical locations   

  • Ability to understand complex issues, assess risk and provide concise business-focused legal and risk mitigation advice and counsel   

  • A practical, proactive, collaborative and solution-oriented approach to problem solving with the ability to make sound decisions and exercise good judgement   

  • Ability to work independently and under pressure and to handle multiple competing tasks simultaneously and thoroughly to closure in a fast-paced environment   

  • Demonstrated a global mindset and sensitivity to all cultures   

  • Fluency in English; working knowledge of additional language(s) a plus   

  • The ability to travel throughout the world and within EMEA as needed

We are architecting a transformational reinvention, and you have the rare opportunity to build from the ground up — establishing the culture, practices, and capabilities that will define how our function works and learns in an AI era. 
  • Inspect how work actually gets done and redesign workflows and operating models. Identify inefficiencies and gaps. Work with leaders to close the distance between current state and future vision, considering both human roles and AI agent contributions. 
  • Lead annual performance and development cycles — goal setting, talent reviews, calibrations, succession planning — with consistent and equitable execution. Use these moments to advance learning and upskilling in areas like AI literacy and modern operating models. 
  • Use people data and operational data to surface risks and organizational effectiveness issues. Spot patterns in attrition, engagement, performance, and AI readiness; recommend targeted interventions. 
  • Partner with Compensation, Benefits, Learning & Development, People Analytics, Talent Acquisition and other subject matter experts to design and deliver solutions that fit the business needs and scale appropriately. 
  • Advise leaders on organizational design, team structures, roles, and operating models — especially as work evolves. Help them think through team structure and how responsibilities shift between humans and AI. Guide them through restructures, new processes, and scaling. 
  • Support workforce planning by anticipating hiring needs, identifying and closing skill gaps, and building succession pipelines for critical roles. Think strategically about where AI agents augment or replace functions. 
  • Drive culture and engagement initiatives across MarCom: make sure people feel heard, managers have what they need, policies get applied consistently. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have: 

  • A business operator's mindset: you think and act like a business leader, not just a People specialist. You understand how organizational decisions impact business delivery and can navigate constraints and trade-offs. 
  • You've led large-scale transformation — building operating models, redesigning processes, modernizing functions — by examining how work actually gets done. You can manage the gap between current state and future vision. 
  • Strong ability to use data to benchmark performance, make informed decisions, and recommend solutions. You can read and interpret people analytics and operational metrics, and you spot patterns others miss. 
  • Direct coaching and client support experience. You build trusted partnerships with leaders and help them navigate complexity. Experience working with business functions beyond HR is a plus. 
  • Understanding of how AI is changing talent, work, and organization design — and a genuine passion for building learning-led cultures and enabling continuous upskilling. You can help leaders think through the implications for structure and capability. 
  • Proven track record leading large-scale organizational or technology transformation. You navigate change and help it actually stick. 
  • Ability to move fluidly across domains — strategic thinking, operational execution, organizational design, tactical problem-solving — and work effectively with multiple stakeholder groups. 
  • Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills. You bring people together, build real relationships, and explain complex changes simply. 
  • Comfort with ambiguity and independent work. You juggle complex issues, prioritize with limited guidance, and thrive in unstructured environments. 
  • The confidence to challenge respectfully — to push back on ideas when it matters, ask hard questions, and influence decisions with data and clear thinking. 
  • 8+ years of professional experience in talent strategy, organizational effectiveness, or in relevant experience within the business, ideally with a Marketing & Communications organization.

title: Senior CRM Sales Specialist, CPQ
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

The Senior CRM Sales Specialist, CPQ will drive market success of ServiceNow’s Configure Price Quote (CPQ) and CRM Sales solutions. These solutions sit alongside our market-leading Service Management platform and unify the selling motion by giving sellers a single source of truth for products, pricing, quoting, and deal execution. 

What you get to do in this role: 

The Senior CRM Sales Specialist for CPQ leads the full sales cycle for our CPQ and CRM Sales products, partnering closely with Solution Consulting, Product, and GTM teams. Responsibilities and activities may vary depending on territory, industry coverage, or account segmentation. 

  • Support territory strategy and planning by aligning CPQ/CRM capabilities to account priorities, whitespace, and revenue opportunities 

  • Lead discovery with customers to understand quoting challenges, product complexity, approval workflows, and seller inefficiencies 

  • Provide strategic input during account planning by identifying CPQ, quoting automation, or CRM workflow modernization use cases 

  • Ensure recommendations into account strategy are aligned with Now Value principles, quantifying business impact, efficiency gains, and AI-powered selling outcomes 

  • Partner with SC & Specialist SC teams to define roadmap alignment and ensure product fit, capability validation, and competitive positioning 

  • Coach AEs, BDRs, and account teams on CPQ/CRM opportunity triggers, value messaging, and how to position workflow automation within the broader selling motion 

  • Lead the full sales cycle including qualification, value-based selling, demonstrations, business case development, and negotiation 

  • Customize your time to the needs of the territory and account team while celebrating wins across the organization 

  • Champion diversity and belonging to contribute to an open and inclusive environment 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have: 

  • Deep experience in specialist sales, preferably within a CRM / CPQ/ Customer engagement/Customer Service Management / CX / CPaaS / CCaaS / SOM vendor 

  • 8+ years of sales experience within complex software or platform solutions, selling CPQ, CRM, or Revenue/Sales Operations-related solutions 

  • An understanding of the CRM, CX, CSM, or CPQ  solution-related business processes 

  • Technical fluency to be able to present, demo and lead credible discovery, value positioning, and use case identification with executives, ServiceNow sellers, and CRM leaders.  

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry. 

  • Experience leading virtual or matrixed teams 

  • Ability to understand broad, macro-level business IT needs for a prospective client 

  • Experience establishing trusted relationships with current and prospective clients and other teams 

  • Ability to produce new business, negotiate deals, and maintain healthy C-Level relationships 

  • Able to thrive in a fast paced, growing, deadline driven environment 

  • Willingness to go above and beyond to win in the market against stiff competition 

  • Ability to communicate complex issues in simple terms via written and oral media, to a variety of different audiences 

  • Ability to forge strong business relationships and connect with both C-level execs at customers as well as with individuals in ServiceNow internal and external eco-system 

  • Excellent communication and polished presentation skills 

  • Regional travel required, office in Amsterdam with regular attendance expected 

  • Fluency in English essential, Dutch preferable

Additional Information

descriptionHtml:

Job Description

About the Team

The Agentic Engineering organization at ServiceNow is the customer-obsessed engineering group that builds a conversational AI experience that turns enterprise intent into completed work. We advance how enterprise AI reasons, remembers, and executes.

The Agent Orchestration team — the team you'll join — owns the execution core: the agent harness, orchestration runtime, multi-agent coordination, memory management, and the evaluation frameworks that ensure agents behave correctly in production. Every autonomous action Otto promises depends on what this team ships.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of our AI transformation journey, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth environment. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business

What you get to do in this role:

As a Staff AI Engineer, you will own significant parts of the agent harness — the infrastructure layer that enables AI agents to reason over real enterprise data, take action across workflows, and run safely at Fortune 500 scale.

  • Harness engineering: Design and build the agent execution harness — the orchestration layer that routes inputs, manages context, invokes tools, handles retries, and surfaces execution state across multi-step agentic workflows
  • Reliability at scale: Own the runtime's fault tolerance, latency, and throughput; design for enterprise workflows that cannot fail silently or unpredictably
  • Observability: Instrument the harness with tracing, cost attribution, and latency visibility so the team can reason about agent behavior in production and catch failures before customers do
  • Prompt infrastructure: Build prompt management systems — versioning, templating, and systematic evaluation — that keep agent behavior stable across model updates and configuration changes
  • Eval engineering: Design and own evaluation frameworks (unit evals, integration evals, production monitors) that measure agent quality, catch regressions, and drive data-informed decisions
  • LLM integration: Integrate with and abstract over frontier LLMs, managing model routing, fallback strategies, cost, and latency trade - offs in production
  • Technical leadership: Set technical standards through architecture decisions, code reviews, and coaching — particularly on agentic design patterns and production AI discipline.
  • System boundary design: Define where agent logic lives — what's a tool call, a sub-agent, a hardcoded path, or a human escalation — and establish those design standards across the team

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • 7+ years building production software systems with a strong track record on reliability, performance, and scalability
  • Hands-on experience shipping generative AI products — not just integrating LLM APIs or building prototypes, but owning AI-powered features that production users depend on
  • Solid depth in how large language models work: failure modes, context constraints, and how prompt design shapes model behavior at scale
  • Python, Kubeflow,Experience with SageMaker, Vertex AI or AzureML, SQL
  • Practical prompt engineering experience: systematically designing, versioning, and evaluating prompts across model updates or A/B evaluation cycles
  • A real track record in eval engineering — not just familiarity, but a portfolio of evaluation suites designed, shipped, and used to drive quality decisions in production AI systems
  • Cost and efficiency awareness at the system level: experience reasoning about model routing, inference cost, and latency tradeoffs in production
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: distributed systems, API design, and testing discipline
  • Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous, startup-like AI product environments

Nice to Have

  • Experience with multi-agent coordination patterns (A2A, MCP)
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Prior experience shipping AI systems in enterprise software
  • Experience with AI observability tooling (tracing, cost tracking, LLM-specific monitoring)
  • Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure, service observability, logging, monitoring, reliability engineering, and production troubleshooting

title: Senior Staff Privacy Engineer - Moveworks
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Who we are

Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce. 

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.

Moveworks is trusted by over 5.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award. 

In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Moveworks’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business. 

Come join us!

ServiceNow

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

Our AI products rely on sensitive data to enable customers to get work done. With this in mind, privacy is a crucial part of ensuring that data is handled properly throughout the workflow, from what we collect and how we use it to the controls we apply across models, tools, logs and data pipelines. In this role, you will be a key privacy engineer, writing code and shaping the architecture and protections across our products. You will improve sensitive data detection and masking, assess the privacy risks of ML models, and own the implementation of customer data-use and retention controls. You will work with our Privacy, ML, Security, Product and Infrastructure teams from design through production.

This is a Senior Staff individual contributor role. You will be hands on, setting technical direction across teams and writing production code.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Assess, benchmark and select ML models and techniques that meet our privacy requirements. Build representative evaluation datasets and compare detection coverage, false positives, latency, cost and the impact on product quality.

  • Own the implementation of those models in our products, from prototype through production. Train or fine-tune where needed, build the surrounding services and APIs, and optimize inference performance and reliability.

  • Build and deploy sensitive data detection, masking, redaction and tokenization for structured and unstructured data across logs, traces, APIs, analytics and annotation tools. Implement consistent controls for when data is masked and who can access the unmasked content.

  • Build privacy evaluations for ML models and the systems around them, including memorization, training-data extraction, membership inference and sensitive data disclosure through retrieval or tool use. Implement mitigations and add regression tests to model and product release workflows.

  • Write and maintain code that enforces customer requirements for data use, access, retention and deletion across services and data stores, including the distinction between permitted inference, evaluation, annotation and training.

  • Prototype and implement privacy-preserving approaches to evaluation and synthetic data. Measure privacy risk and utility, validate the assumptions behind the approach, and integrate suitable solutions into our ML pipelines.

  • Conduct privacy design reviews with engineering, identify gaps in proposed data flows and architectures, and own or partner on the code changes needed to address them. Build reusable components and engineering standards that help teams apply these protections consistently.

  • Monitor privacy controls and models in production, investigate failures, and ship improvements. Use error analysis and production feedback to improve detection quality, address regressions and close customer-reported privacy issues.

What success looks like in your first year:

  • ML models selected and deployed for priority privacy use cases, with measured improvements in detection quality and acceptable production latency and cost.

  • Shared masking and data protection components integrated into the highest-priority product surfaces, with automated tests for coverage and access behavior.

  • Repeatable privacy evaluations running as part of model and product releases, with findings translated into shipped fixes.

  • Priority data-use, retention and deletion requirements implemented and verified in production, with monitoring that identifies failures.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Typically 7+ or more years building production software, including substantial experience in privacy engineering and applied ML.

  • Strong Python skills and experience with Go, Java, C++ or another production systems language. You have shipped, tested and operated production software.

  • Hands-on experience evaluating, selecting and deploying ML models, including dataset curation, model adaptation or fine-tuning, error analysis and model serving.

  • Experience building sensitive data detection and masking systems, including their accuracy, performance and integration tradeoffs.

  • Experience assessing privacy risks in ML and LLM systems and implementing mitigations. You can explain what your tests establish and where uncertainty remains.

  • Deep understanding of data minimization, pseudonymization, anonymization and re-identification risk, including the limits of removing direct identifiers.

  • Experience building data protection and lifecycle controls in distributed cloud systems.

  • A record of taking ambiguous engineering problems from design through delivery, setting technical direction across teams and mentoring engineers.

Preferred experience:

  • Applying differential privacy or other privacy-enhancing technologies, including evaluating their assumptions and privacy-utility tradeoffs.

  • Privacy engineering for agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings or synthetic datasets.

  • Experience in enterprise, multi-tenant or regulated environments, and translating privacy requirements such as GDPR and CCPA into technical controls.

Job Description

About the Role 

This individual contributor role sits at the intersection of analysis and narrative within the thought leadership research team. You translate complex research data into compelling stories that drive executive decisions. You own the hypothesis-to-narrative process for research reports, from designing research survey instruments that test specific ideas to analyzing findings and shaping them into original, C-suite-ready research insights. 

Key Responsibilities 

Research design and methodology 

Validate ideas before they scale. Conduct desk research to stress-test hypotheses and identify blind spots before committing to full survey instrument design.  

  • Manage survey design and methodology for assigned research projects, including sample sizing, weighting, screening, and regional representation 

  • Design survey instruments in partnership with research firms to test hypotheses with rigor before fielding 

  • Bring emerging methodologies into the program mix, such as AI-moderated qualitative research with consumers, to add depth to large-scale customer experience studies 

Data synthesis and narrative storyboarding 

Conduct data analysis directly. Run segment cuts, crosstabs, and breakdowns that surface patterns. Build narrative frameworks from analytics. This is where analysis becomes storytelling. 

  • Analyze and interpret both quantitative and qualitative data from various sources 

  • Work with complex data to shape original and impactful storylines  

  • Translate data into actionable insights into actionable for executive audiences 

Research content development 

You turn research findings into reports and assets that executives read and act on, leveraging data to inform a point of view. 

  • Write and storyboard thought leadership research reports from research findings, with a clear argument and editorial voice 

  • Ground claims in data, ensuring the evidence informs the story 

  • Collaborate with editorial team on derivative content for assigned programs 

Key Deliverables 

  • Validated hypotheses with supporting desk research 

  • Survey instruments and methodology specifications 

  • Narrative frameworks  

  • Segment and crosstab analysis 

  • Derivative content recommendations 

  • Research report and derivative assets  

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • 7+ years of experience in market research, thought leadership, management consulting, or a similar analytical and editorial discipline  
  • Experience designing quantitative survey instruments and qualitative research frameworks that test specific hypotheses  
  • Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience running segment cuts, crosstabs, and statistical analysis  
  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate research and analysis, with the judgment to verity outputs and protect methodological rigor 
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into compelling narratives that resonate with C-suite audiences  
  • Excellent writing and editorial judgment, with a portfolio of research-backed content  
  • Experience partnering with external research firms on survey design, fielding, and analysis  
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to move fast on rapid research without sacrificing methodological rigor

Job Description

ServiceNow's Advanced Technology Group is a customer-focused innovation team building intelligent software and AI-powered work experiences. We combine AI workers, workflows, chat, knowledge, and integrations to make complex enterprise operations accessible to everyday users. 

Our researchers, applied scientists, engineers, designers, and product managers have a dual mission: build end-to-end products for customers while experimenting with and de-risking the technologies that will shape how people work. 

The role 

We are looking for an experienced frontend engineer who cares deeply about product quality. You will turn complex, nondeterministic AI behavior into fast, clear, and trustworthy user experiences across our web application and embedded enterprise surfaces. 

You will help shape what we build and take features from idea to production. We look for people who move fast, ask good questions, care about users, and take pride in their work. 

What you will do 

  • Build AI-native experiences for chat, workflows, integrations, approvals, and knowledge. 

  • Own customer-facing features from product definition through implementation, testing, release, and iteration. 

  • Create scalable components and shared product capabilities across our main application and ServiceNow experience. 

  • Design reliable realtime and asynchronous interfaces, including streaming, partial results, retries, interruptions, and failures. 

  • Own frontend foundations such as shared packages, build tooling, dependency upgrades, and CI. 

  • Keep the frontend healthy over time by improving architecture, performance, developer experience, and maintainability. 

  • Improve accessibility, responsiveness, performance, observability, and product polish. 

  • Work closely with product, design, backend, and AI engineers while independently driving execution. 

  • Help evolve our engineering practices as AI changes how software is designed and built. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Strong React and TypeScript fundamentals with experience building high-quality customer-facing products. 

  • A track record of driving meaningful features end to end, not only incremental changes. 

  • Strong product judgment: you care about clarity, speed, accessibility, and details, and speak up when an experience is not good enough. 

  • Experience with asynchronous server state, typed APIs, complex forms, realtime events, and failure handling. 

  • Ability to design maintainable boundaries between applications, shared features, UI primitives, and API clients. 

  • Experience maintaining frontend infrastructure, package ecosystems, build pipelines, and large codebases. 

  • Experience with automated testing and confidence in owning production outcomes. 

  • Comfort working with autonomy in a fast-moving environment with limited process overhead. 

AI Development Lifecycle 

Hands-on ADLC experience is mandatory. You must have shipped software using AI across discovery, design, implementation, testing, review, documentation, and production debugging—not only used a coding assistant occasionally. 

You know how to validate AI-generated work, define evaluations and regression criteria, manage context, and account for nondeterminism, hallucinations, latency, cost, privacy, and security. You retain human ownership of the architecture, code, and customer outcome. 

For product development, you understand prompts, tool calls, structured outputs, approvals, and model failure modes well enough to design trustworthy AI user experiences. 

Our technology 

React, TypeScript, Vite, Nx, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Socket.IO, TipTap, SCSS Modules, i18next, Vitest, Playwright, Sentry, JSON Schema, Cursor, and Linear. 

Our platform runs on AWS and Kubernetes. You do not need to be an infrastructure expert, but you should be comfortable working with cloud-based systems. 

Experience with every technology is not required. Experience with rich-text editors, design systems, Web Components, Shadow DOM, ServiceNow, or AI automation products is a plus.

As an Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM Workflows for the German market, you are the technical face of a fundamentally different way of selling. Rather than leading with slideware and scripted demos, you embed alongside the customer, run deep Discovery to isolate one high-value problem, and then prove value in the open — building a working Proof of Value (POV) on the customer’s own data using our Agentic workflow capabilities.

You partner with Sales, Product Management, and Executive Leadership to turn a single, well-chosen use case into undeniable, data-backed proof that earns the next phase of the relationship. This role blends the consultative instincts of a Sr. Advisory Solution Consultant with the hands-on, build-it-in-the-field engineering of a forward-deployed engineer: someone who works inside the customer’s own environment, configuring and proving solutions on their live data rather than presenting finished products from the outside. 

The Embedded Approach 

The Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM Workflows inverts the traditional pre-sales motion. Product demonstration is deliberately minimal — just enough to establish credibility and unlock the real work. The center of gravity is the POV: a short, focused cycle where we get access to a slice of the customer’s data, stand up an Agentic workflow against a problem they genuinely care about, and let the outcome speak for itself. Your job is to earn the right to that POV through rigorous Discovery, then deliver it as an embedded engineer, not a presenter. 

What You’ll Do 

As the Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM Workflows, you will lead a Discovery-first, POV-centric engagement model — using your technical depth and Agentic workflow expertise to convert customer data into proven outcomes, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. 

Key responsibilities include: 

  • Partner with Sales as the embedded technical lead — someone who wins on proof, not presentation — to drive transformational CRM opportunities. 
  • Lead rigorous Discovery to isolate a single, high-value problem worth solving, mapping the customer’s data, systems, and desired outcome before any product is shown.
