  • Build and deliver the POV as an embedded engineer — configuring Agentic workflows against the customer’s environment and producing measurable, data-backed results.

  • Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. 
  • Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. 
  • Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks, and Agentic workflow patterns so the embedded POV motion scales across the team. 
  • Represent the company at enterprise events, technology forums, and leadership summits as a credible, hands-on technical voice for the embedded POV approach. 

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For 

To succeed in this role, you should bring: 

  • Builder Mindset: A builder’s instinct — comfortable getting hands on with a customer’s data and environment to prove value directly, rather than relying on canned demonstrations. 
  • POV-Centric Selling: Proven ability to scope, sell, and deliver Proof-of-Value engagements that convert a single problem into quantified, data-backed outcomes. 
  • Discovery Rigor: Exceptional discovery skills to quickly isolate the one problem worth solving and secure customer commitment to a POV. 
  • Agentic & AI Fluency: Deep, practical understanding of Agentic workflows and AI-driven automation, and how to apply them to CRM problems on live customer data. 
  • CRM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in CRM and customer experience, with strong knowledge of service, sales, lead & opportunity management. 
  • Enterprise Experience: Proven track record engaging large organizations and earning executive sponsorship for hands-on, data-driven engagements. 
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to translate technical POV results into clear, business-oriented value stories for senior enterprise stakeholders. 
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global teams spanning Sales, Product, and delivery. 

Qualifications 

  • Demonstrated experience building or delivering POVs, prototypes, or hands-on technical engagements — a hands-on track record of proving value on real customer data, not just presenting it. 
  • Hands-on experience applying AI and Agentic workflow capabilities to solve business problems — automating workflows, orchestrating AI agents, and analyzing AI-driven outcomes within CRM or adjacent enterprise contexts.

Job Description

The Customer Success Executive is accountable for the strategic leadership and execution of post-sales activities within our most valuable accounts. This position plays a crucial role in driving ServiceNow’s long-term value by accelerating customers’ journey to success, ensuring predictable renewals, and maximizing the impact of ServiceNow across their business transformation initiatives.

As a trusted advisor, you’ll partner with C-level executives, guide seamless delivery of business transformation, and foster collaboration with ServiceNow’s teams and strategic partners.

What You Get to Do in This Role:

  • Drive Post-Sales Success: Own and lead the customer’s post-sales transformation, aligning ServiceNow’s offerings to customer goals, and bringing relevant industry thought-leadership to the table. Foster strong relationships with C-Level executives to deliver on business outcomes.
  • Collaborate Strategically: Partner with Account Executives to create and execute integrated pre- and post-sales strategies, delivering long-term value for both the customer and ServiceNow. Leverage the right resources at the right time to ensure success.
  • Mitigate Risks and Drive Value: Proactively identify potential risks to success and work with the customer and internal teams to develop strategies to overcome them, ensuring a smooth path toward value realization.
  • Focus on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Guide and inspire the Customer Success team to meet critical operational KPIs—adoption, technical health, renewals, customer satisfaction, and expansion. Work closely with customers to align their roadmap and drive new revenue opportunities.
  • Foster Strategic Alignment: Build relationships with ServiceNow leaders and consistently incorporate customer feedback to drive continuous improvement. Align business transformation insights with organizational goals to ensure long-term success.
  • Advocate for Innovation and Continuous Learning: As a strategic thought leader, drive innovative solutions for our customers, always looking for opportunities to help them achieve their long-term goals. Foster a culture of agility and calculated risk-taking within the team.
  • Set Success Metrics and Milestones: Establish clear, measurable success metrics with the customer, and regularly review progress. Refine business transformation plans as needed to ensure milestones are met and value is realized.


    The ideal candidate will have extensive experience leading large-scale digital business transformations, acting as a trusted advisor to both internal and C-level customer executives. You will be an expert in governance, strategy, and execution across cross-functional teams and have a track record of delivering scalable, repeatable success. Your passion for driving customer success at an enterprise scale and your ability to work in complex, dynamic environments will be key to your success in this role.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you will need:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
  • Experience in Delivery and understanding large scale implementations in the public sector.
  • Educational Background: BA/BS or equivalent required, Master’s degree preferred.
  • Experience: A minimum of 12 years in a management consulting or leadership role at a top-tier consulting firm, solution consulting, or similar positions focused on technology-enabled business transformations (Digital/SaaS/Enterprise Software).
  • Leadership Expertise: Demonstrated success in running large-scale, strategic accounts and exceeding business objectives. Proven track record in building and leading high-performing Customer Success or Consulting teams.
  • Business Acumen: Strong experience in identifying and solving complex business problems and aligning solutions with customer business objectives.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: A history of working across multiple functions and driving alignment in large, matrixed environments.
  • C-Level Relationships: Strong experience building relationships and influencing with C-level business leaders, including within some of the world’s largest enterprises.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in rapidly changing environments, adapting strategies to new challenges and opportunities.
  • Execution Focus: Ability to create repeatable processes for scalable execution while maintaining a hands-on approach to ensure critical tasks are completed efficiently.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Excellent communicator and influencer, with the ability to work effectively across a global organization and foster collaboration at all levels.
  • Customer Focus: Deep understanding of customer needs, challenges, and motivations, with a keen ability to address concerns and ensure satisfaction.

What you get to do in this role: 

The Senior CRM Account Executive for CPQ leads the full sales cycle for our CPQ and CRM Sales products, partnering closely with Solution Consulting, Product, and GTM teams. Responsibilities and activities may vary depending on territory, industry coverage, or account segmentation. 

• Support territory strategy and planning by aligning CPQ/CRM capabilities to account priorities, whitespace, and revenue opportunities 
• Lead discovery with customers to understand quoting challenges, product complexity, approval workflows, and seller inefficiencies

• Champion diversity and belonging to contribute to an open and inclusive environment 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Deep experience in specialist sales, preferably within a CRM / CPQ/ Customer engagement/Customer Service Management / CX / CPaaS / CCaaS / SOM vendor 

  • 8+ years of sales experience within complex software or platform solutions, selling CPQ, CRM, or Revenue/Sales Operations-related solutions 

  • An understanding of the CRM, CX, CSM, or CPQ  solution-related business processes 

  • Familiarity with the Manufacturing industries 

  • Technical fluency to be able to present, demo and lead credible discovery, value positioning, and use case identification with executives, ServiceNow sellers, and CRM leaders.  

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry. 

  • Experience leading virtual or matrixed teams 

  • Ability to understand broad, macro-level business IT needs for a prospective client

title: Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

As an Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI for the Switzerland market, you are the technical face of a fundamentally different way of selling. Rather than leading with slideware and scripted demos, you embed alongside the customer, run deep Discovery to isolate one high-value problem, and then prove value in the open — building a working Proof of Value (POV) on the customer’s own data using our Agentic workflow capabilities.

You partner with Sales, Product Management, and Executive Leadership to turn a single, well-chosen use case into undeniable, data-backed proof that earns the next phase of the relationship. This role blends the consultative instincts of a Sr. Advisory Solution Consultant with the hands-on, build-it-in-the-field engineering of a forward-deployed engineer: someone who works inside the customer’s own environment, configuring and proving solutions on their live data rather than presenting finished products from the outside. 

The Embedded Approach 

The Advisory Solution Consultant inverts the traditional pre-sales motion. Product demonstration is deliberately minimal — just enough to establish credibility and unlock the real work. The center of gravity is the POV: a short, focused cycle where we get access to a slice of the customer’s data, stand up an Agentic workflow against a problem they genuinely care about, and let the outcome speak for itself. Your job is to earn the right to that POV through rigorous Discovery, then deliver it as an embedded engineer, not a presenter. 

What You’ll Do 

As the Advisory Solution Consultant, you will lead a Discovery-first, POV-centric engagement model — using your technical depth and Agentic workflow expertise to convert customer data into proven outcomes, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. 

Key responsibilities include: 

  • Partner with Sales as the embedded technical lead — someone who wins on proof, not presentation — to drive transformational CRM opportunities. 
  • Lead rigorous Discovery to isolate a single, high-value problem worth solving, mapping the customer’s data, systems, and desired outcome before any product is shown. 
  • Keep product demonstration minimal and purposeful — use it only to establish credibility and to set up the POV, never as a substitute for proving value on real data. 
  • Secure and scope a POV: earn customer sponsorship to engage in a hands-on cycle where we use their data to solve the identified problem with our Agentic workflow capabilities. 
  • Build and deliver the POV as an embedded engineer — configuring Agentic workflows against the customer’s environment and producing measurable, data-backed results. 
  • Translate POV outcomes into an executive value narrative that quantifies impact and defines the path from a single proven use case to enterprise-wide adoption. 
  • Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. 
  • Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. 
  • Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks, and Agentic workflow patterns so the embedded POV motion scales across the team. 
  • Represent the company at enterprise events, technology forums, and leadership summits as a credible, hands-on technical voice for the embedded POV approach. 

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For 

To succeed in this role, you should bring: 

  • Builder Mindset: A builder’s instinct — comfortable getting hands on with a customer’s data and environment to prove value directly, rather than relying on canned demonstrations. 
  • POV-Centric Selling: Proven ability to scope, sell, and deliver Proof-of-Value engagements that convert a single problem into quantified, data-backed outcomes. 
  • Discovery Rigor: Exceptional discovery skills to quickly isolate the one problem worth solving and secure customer commitment to a POV. 
  • Agentic & AI Fluency: Deep, practical understanding of Agentic workflows and AI-driven automation, and how to apply them to CRM problems on live customer data. 
  • CRM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in CRM and customer experience, with strong knowledge of service, sales, lead & opportunity management. 
  • Enterprise Experience: Proven track record engaging large organizations and earning executive sponsorship for hands-on, data-driven engagements. 
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to translate technical POV results into clear, business-oriented value stories for senior enterprise stakeholders. 
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global teams spanning Sales, Product, and delivery. 

Qualifications 

  • Demonstrated experience building or delivering POVs, prototypes, or hands-on technical engagements — a hands-on track record of proving value on real customer data, not just presenting it. 
  • Hands-on experience applying AI and Agentic workflow capabilities to solve business problems — automating workflows, orchestrating AI agents, and analyzing AI-driven outcomes within CRM or adjacent enterprise contexts. 
  • 10+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience, with a clear shift toward Discovery-led, proof-based selling. 
  • Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or strong technical expertise with cloud software solutions. 
  • Experience working collaboratively with product management, product marketing, partners, and professional services. 
  • Track record of working with a Sales counterpart to promote execution excellence and advance transformational opportunities.

Job Description

The Data & Analytics Solution Sales Executive (SSE) is a sales role built for experienced data and analytics sellers who have the curiosity, confidence, and technical acumen to transform a customer’s business through AI, Data and Analytics. You will play a pivotal role in shaping ServiceNow’s D&A business and work on exciting and transformational use cases with Data & Analytics to deliver Insight to Action on the ServiceNow AI Platform. People who excel at this job can lead discovery sessions, leverage value-based selling, and deliver measurable business outcomes through customer specific priorities and use cases.   • Lead end-to-end D&A sales cycles as a co-prime with the core account executive, from opportunity creation through close and ongoing adoption. 
  • Own and sell the full D&A portfolio (Workflow Data Fabric, RaptorDB Pro, Data Apps, and Autonomous Data Analytics) across your assigned accounts.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and build features across Customer service workflows, including case and work order management and guided agent experiences.

You will own complex components end to end, working closely with product, design, and adjacent platform teams to ship workflows that agents and customers rely on every day. You will bring strong engineering fundamentals, a bias for quality at scale, and a drive to make customer-facing processes faster and more intelligent with AI.

What you will do:

  • Build high-quality, scalable, clean, and reusable applications and integration solutions using ServiceNow platform and related technologies. 
  • Partner with the product owners to understand detailed requirements and own your code from design, implementation, test automation and delivery of high-quality products to our users.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Job Description

About the Role:

You track culture before it surfaces in a brief. You have strong opinions about what makes content work on a platform, and you understand how audiences truly behave—how they form communities, participate in conversations, and move between discovery and action. You bring craft to strategy: your briefs sharpen the problem, your frameworks drive execution, and your thinking gives creative and community teams somewhere real to go. 

ServiceNow's social presence is where we reach enterprise buyers across the platforms where they're actually present—Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, X, and emerging channels. We're building an always-on social program rooted in authentic storytelling, cultural relevance, and genuine community engagement—one that proves B2B tech can be creative, insightful, and genuinely interesting. 

This role owns the strategic vision for ServiceNow's social and content program across all platforms and partners with creative teams, product marketing, editorial leadership, and community managers to bring that strategy to life with excellence and intention. You'll define what our brand sounds like and stands for in social spaces. You'll identify where to expand and evolve our content approach based on audience behaviors and insights. You'll tap into and activate our community to find moments that drive buzz and cultural relevance.  

You'll report to the Director of Social Media with direct accountability for building brand awareness, credibility, and relevance across social channels. 

What You'll Do:

  • Own Social Strategy Across Social Platforms: Define the strategic vision and positioning for ServiceNow across Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, X, and emerging channels. Develop a forward-looking roadmap aligned to our editorial calendar, product launches, thought leadership moments, and cultural opportunities. Identify opportunities to expand into new content pillars and evolve existing pillars based on audience behaviors, engagement patterns, and strategic insights. Establish clear audience targets and platform-specific strategies that reflect how to reach enterprise buyers organically across each channel. 
  • Build Content Architecture: Develop integrated content strategies and always-on programming architectures that translate ServiceNow's positioning into scalable, channel-native programs. Serve as steward of the brand across social, ensuring all content reflects our visual standards, tone, and perspective. Partner closely with creative teams to brief, concept, and execute channel-right content across photo, video, thought leadership, and community-generated content. Write creative briefs and social strategies that give creative teams a genuine problem to solve, framing the strategic challenge with precision, clear point of view, and useful constraints. Test content formats and creative approaches to optimize for engagement, reach, and audience connection. 
  • Cultivate & Activate Community: Tap into and activate ServiceNow's community of practitioners, builders, and decision-makers to uncover insights and identify moments of cultural relevance. Mine community conversations and user-generated content for signals that inform new strategic challenges and social moments. Develop community-first campaigns and activations that drive buzz, engagement, and strengthen brand perception. Build a community-first mindset into the always-on program that strengthens brand perception and creates space for authentic dialogue. 
  • Leverage Performance & Insights: Use performance data and audience insights to refine content strategy, optimize for emerging opportunities, and identify moments worth amplifying. Translate analytics and learning into strategic recommendations that inform content evolution and platform investment. Make the case for strategic pivots and new directions backed by evidence and cultural insight. 
  • Lead Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with product marketing to identify moments to integrate ServiceNow products and narratives into social storytelling. Collaborate with editorial and brand strategy teams to ensure social strategy aligns with broader brand positioning and messaging. Work with customer marketing and proof teams to bring customer success stories and proof points to life on social—identifying authentic moments and opportunities to amplify customer advocacy. Work with paid media and performance teams to identify amplification opportunities and ensure social content gets the media support it deserves. Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across creative, product, data, and marketing disciplines.

Job Description

About Flow by ServiceNow

Flow is a product and a new business unit in ServiceNow staffed by a team of 0-1 builders. We’re creating Flow, an AI-native conversational experience for natural language automation and enterprise service management. Flow is built on a new tech stack with new ways of working. We challenge established practices and are defining a new product and GTM playbook for ServiceNow. Flow puts what we build in front of the largest possible audience. You’ll have real ownership of the work, the freedom to move fast, and the resources of a global technology leader behind you. If you have a point of view on building and want to start from the beginning again, we want to talk to you, wherever you are.

Plenty of people can ship an AI prototype this year. Few get to build a product that runs enterprise work at global scale. Join us.

Job Description

We are hiring a Senior Staff Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer to be the most senior technical authority for Flow customers, guiding strategic and enterprise accounts from first demo and trial to long-term, expanding success. You will lead the hardest customer deployments, architect solutions that go beyond what the product does today, and turn what you learn in the field into product strategy. You will also raise the bar for the entire forward deployed team by setting technical standards, building repeatable playbooks, and mentoring other engineers. The role combines deep technical implementation, strategic customer partnership, and cross-functional leadership.

Ready to turn “we’re stuck” into “we’re live” for the most complex enterprise environments? You will own outcomes across multiple strategic customers, influence the Flow roadmap, and define how ServiceNow deploys AI-native products in the field.

What You Will Do

Technical Solutions and Architecture

  • Lead technical design and delivery for strategic enterprise deployments, including SSO and identity architecture, multi-system integrations, and security and compliance reviews with customer IT and security leadership.
  • Architect and build complex, production-grade automations and workflows with Flow’s natural-language builder across tools such as Okta, Microsoft Teams, Slack, Jira, Workday, Zoom, Microsoft 365, and ServiceNow.
  • Design knowledge and retrieval strategies across document sources such as SharePoint, Google Drive, Box, Notion, and the ServiceNow knowledge base, so the AI returns accurate, sourced answers at enterprise scale.
  • Solve problems the product does not yet handle by designing and documenting scalable workarounds, and convert them into reusable patterns, reference architectures, and product capabilities.
  • Lead proof-of-concept and strategic evaluation efforts, partnering with sales and executive stakeholders to demonstrate value and win competitive engagements.

Customer Success and Strategic Adoption

  • Define and continuously improve the onboarding and implementation motion so new customers set up and enable Flow in a few hours and reach production in one day.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to customer IT directors and executives, aligning Flow with their broader IT and operations strategy and ServiceNow’s plans.
  • Use Flow analytics on usage, conversation allowances, and automation results to build business cases, demonstrate value, and drive expansion from an initial use case to a full self-service service desk.
  • Own multi-account health and adoption outcomes, identifying risks early and driving executive-level resolution when needed.

Product Influence and Technical Leadership

  • Translate patterns across customers into clear product requirements and strategy, and partner with product management and engineering to prioritize and shepherd them through delivery.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer in roadmap, architecture, and go-to-market discussions, shaping how Flow is positioned, packaged, and priced.
  • Establish technical standards, playbooks, and tooling for the forward deployed function, and scale them across teams.
  • Mentor and coach solutions engineers at IC3 and IC4 levels and act as an escalation point for the most difficult issues.

Support and Reliability

  • Serve as the final technical escalation for critical customer issues such as API timeouts, sync errors, payment-related questions, and failed automations, and drive them from diagnosis to durable resolution.
  • Reproduce bugs, isolate root causes, and work directly with core engineers to resolve them, including systemic issues affecting multiple customers.
  • Use Flow health, audit, and activity logs to diagnose complex issues, identify outages, and define monitoring and triage practices that improve reliability for all customers.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in customer-facing technical roles, such as forward deployed, solutions, or implementation engineering, in enterprise software, including experience leading strategic, multi-system deployments.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with REST APIs, scripting, automations, and webhooks, with the ability to design integration architectures and debug them at depth.
  • Expert knowledge of single sign-on and identity architectures, including SAML, OAuth, Okta, and Entra ID, and of enterprise security and compliance requirements.
  • Extensive experience with enterprise service management or collaboration platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira, Slack, or Microsoft Teams.
  • Strong understanding of AI and workflow automation, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented approaches, and evaluating the quality and accuracy of AI answers.
  • Proven ability to communicate and influence from system administrators and security engineers to IT directors and executives.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect customer outcomes to broader IT and operations strategy and to ServiceNow’s plans.
  • Track record of technical leadership and mentorship, and of influencing product direction and cross-functional teams without direct authority.

Preferred 

  • Experience with service desk offerings.
  • Experience with AI-native or cloud-native enterprise products.
  • Background in product-led growth or consumption-priced software.
  • Experience building an onboarding or implementation motion, playbooks, or a forward deployed function from scratch; startup experience is helpful but not required.

Job Description

Overview:
The Data Platform group builds highly scalable, high‑performance platform capabilities for data‑in‑motion and backend storage systems. Our customers operate at massive scale, pushing the boundaries of data volume, throughput, and concurrency. We are looking for a seasoned IC5 Senior Staff Engineer with deep expertise in distributed systems and Data Lake architectures to drive next‑generation platform innovation.

Role Summary
As an IC5 Senior Staff Engineer, you will architect and deliver large‑scale distributed platform components, lead complex technical initiatives, and define engineering best practices. You will bring strong leadership, hands-on engineering depth, and the ability to design and operate reliable, scalable, and high‑performance data systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and build high‑performance distributed systems and platform components.
  • Build distributed systems data ingestion solutions with strong emphasis on scalability, quality, and operational excellence.
  • Deliver high‑quality, clean, modular, and reusable code while enforcing engineering best practices (code reviews, unit testing, automation, design reviews).
  • Build foundational libraries, frameworks, and tools focused on modularity, extensibility, configurability, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate across engineering teams to refine requirements and deliver end‑to‑end solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership for projects with significant complexity and risk.
  • Research, evaluate, and adopt new technologies that enhance platform capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot and diagnose complex production issues across distributed systems.

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience 

Experience Level
  • 15–20 years of hands‑on engineering experience in distributed systems, data platforms, or large‑scale backend infrastructure.

Core Engineering Expertise

  • Strong fundamentals in distributed systems architecture, design patterns, and algorithms.
  • Deep programming expertise in Java, including JVM internals, memory models, and garbage collection.
  • Proven experience in JVM performance tuning, profiling, and diagnosing performance bottlenecks.
  • Strong understanding of concurrency, networking, sockets, OS internals, and performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating large‑scale distributed systems.
  • Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL. 

Distributed Systems Expertise

  • Experience with large‑scale deployments of distributed systems.
  • Deep knowledge of replication, fault-tolerant, and HA strategies.
  • Experience working in DevOps environments to operationalize distributed platforms.
  • Strong expertise in designing and architecting platforms using:
  • Kubernetes (workload deployments, upgrades, monitoring and maintenance)
  • Apache Iceberg (tables, catalogs, schema evolution, metadata management) is a plus
  • Apache Kafka (high‑scale clusters, topic/partition strategies, HA) is a plus
  • Apache Flink (stateful stream processing, exactly‑once semantics) is a plus
  • Apache Spark (batch & streaming jobs, optimization, partitioning) is a plus
  • Expertise in data formats such as Parquet, ORC, and Avro, along with compaction and governance strategies.
  • Ability to build scalable, fault‑tolerant ingestion and transformation workflows.
  • Experience integrating Data Lakes with analytics engines, query services, or ML platforms.

This role requires a blend of technical expertise, leadership skills, and the ability to foster a collaborative and innovative environment. We are looking for a Project Lead familiar with cloud-native and AI-native development practices. Our software is built around AI at its core—LLMs, agents, and retrieval systems—and runs on IaaS (Google Cloud/AWS/etc.), so familiarity with these environments and their managed AI services is a plus. Full ownership of your code will be encouraged, including deployment, testing, evaluation, and validation of both traditional and AI components. You will lead a team of software and AI engineers, coaching and mentoring them. Familiarity with CI/CD, test-driven development, and evaluation-driven development (eval harnesses for AI features) will be a benefit.

  • Develop intuitive AI-native software that meets and exceeds the needs of the company
  • Development of technical specifications and planning, including model selection, prompt/agent design, and data/retrieval architecture
  • Analyze and automate tests for software components prior to delivery, and build evaluation harnesses (accuracy, regression, and hallucination checks) for AI features

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Role summary 

The senior technical architect, infrastructure and cloud sets direction for how our corporate and cloud infrastructure evolves to support secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective business services. As part of the technical architecture team, this role connects infrastructure and cloud decisions to enterprise architecture and the broader technology roadmap. The role researches new technologies, advises on current solutions, and drives improvement, including upgrades, retirements, and replacements. This is a senior individual contributor role that sets direction through standards, roadmaps, guardrails, and architecture decisions. 

 What you get to do in this role:

  • Help define the current-state, transition-state, and target-state infrastructure and cloud architecture, with a multiyear roadmap tied to business priorities, risk, lifecycle, capacity, and cost. Help align that direction with enterprise architecture principles and the broader technology roadmap, and surface dependencies that affect enterprise plans. 

  • Establish reference architectures, principles, standards, and patterns across cloud, data center, networking, compute, storage, containers, and backup. Advise on infrastructure as code and policy as code, and support delivery teams in adopting them. 

  • Help define cloud governance, standards, and architectural guardrails for Azure and GCP, including account and subscription structure, landing zones, cost controls, and policy as code. Advise teams on operating within them, and surface where a guardrail needs to change. 

  • Lead infrastructure architecture reviews and provide architecture input on major technical decisions. Help scope proofs of concept and vendor evaluations. Evaluate options, document tradeoffs, risks, and value, fit, operability, and total cost, and help drive decisions to closure with accountable stakeholders. 

  • Recommend resilience and compliance requirements for high availability, disaster recovery, backup and recovery, and continuity, and help align recovery objectives with business criticality. 

  • Partner with Security Architecture on resilience, compliance, and zero-trust, so that security requirements are built into infrastructure and cloud standards from the start. 

  • Look ahead to AI and ML infrastructure needs, including compute capacity, specialized hardware, data storage, and hybrid hosting. Understand the agentic AI patterns, such as RAG, A2A, and MCP, that shape those needs. Research emerging technologies that could change how we build and run infrastructure, and advise on when to adopt them. 

  • Default to out-of-the-box capabilities. Recommend a documented case for any custom pattern or exception and advise on retiring custom solutions where a standard capability will do. 

  • Support and collaborate regularly with the DT Integration, Core Systems, and Product teams to align infrastructure needs, dependencies, and roadmaps. Advise these teams on the infrastructure implications of their integration, core system, and product decisions, and help plan changes that depend on shared infrastructure. 

  • Partner with finance and operations to inform infrastructure economics through capacity planning, lifecycle management, workload placement, and FinOps practices. Draw on incidents, capacity trends, audit findings, and resilience test results to inform standards and roadmaps. 

  • Represent infrastructure and cloud in the architecture team and its governance forums, including the Architecture Review Board. Build trusted relationships with senior technology and business leaders, and mentor architects and engineers. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure, cloud, platform engineering, or systems engineering, including substantial architecture responsibility for complex enterprise environments. 

  • Demonstrated success defining infrastructure and cloud strategy and roadmaps that span multiple technology domains and delivery teams. 

  • Deep expertise in several infrastructure domains, with enough breadth to make integrated decisions across cloud, network, compute, storage, resilience, and cost. 

  • Strong working knowledge of Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) architecture, including landing zones, connectivity, identity dependencies, workload placement, and shared-responsibility models. 

  • Solid understanding of agentic AI concepts and patterns, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent-to-agent (A2A) communication, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and related technologies. 

  • Experience integrating disparate systems, with a strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, such as APIs, messaging, and event-driven architecture. 

  • Experience defining cloud governance, guardrails, and standards in a large enterprise, and getting teams to adopt them. 

  • Experience creating and governing reference architectures, standards, and architecture decision records. 

  • Working knowledge of infrastructure as code and modern automation practices. 

  • Ability to evaluate architecture choices on business value, risk, cost, and operational evidence, not technology preference. 

  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and technical teams without relying on direct authority. 

  • Clear written and verbal communication for both engineering and executive audiences. 

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience. 

  • Preferred qualifications 

  • Experience in a large, global, regulated, or mission-critical environment. 

  • Familiarity with IT service management practices, including the IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL), and with configuration management database (CMDB) alignment for infrastructure configuration items. 

  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks, such as TOGAF or COBIT, or equivalent. 

  • Experience with release planning using Agile and Scrum practices.

Why This Role Matters:

Enterprises are raising the bar. AI initiatives must deliver business value—not just promise potential. That means taking cutting-edge LLM capabilities and turning them into resilient, secure, and scalable software. 

As a Forward Deployed Solution Engineer (FDSE), you act as the CTO of the build—owning everything from backend services to LLM pipelines and front-end integrations. Job Description

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Design System team, you will build and evolve the engineering surface of the design system: the theme system, the design tokens, and the tooling that lets engineers, designers, and product teams apply it correctly. You will work in close partnership with design and product counterparts, and your decisions will ripple across internal product teams and external customers, so systems thinking and a working command of accessibility are as important as your front-end craft. 

Roles and responsibilities 

  • Evolve the theme system and its design token architecture, covering token taxonomy, platform transforms, theming APIs, and the guardrails that keep themes accessible. 

  • Engineer tooling that makes the design system easy to adopt: theme builders, linting and audit rules, codemods, Figma to code workflows, and local development aids. 

  • Build AI skills and tooling that put the design system to work for engineers, designers, and product partners, so prototypes and production code generate on-system by default. 

  • Partner closely with design system designers and product managers, weighing design intent, customer need, and engineering cost in every decision rather than optimizing for one. 

  • Trace the downstream impact of every change across consuming teams and customer instances, and manage versioning, deprecation, and breaking-change communication accordingly. 

  • Hold the system to WCAG 2.2 Level AA, including contrast, forced colors, focus visibility, and reflow, and build automated checks that catch regressions before release. 

  • Collaborate with component authors and the component engine team on API contracts, token consumption, and release sequencing. 

  • Maintain the enablement surface for the system, including API documentation, usage guidance, and migration paths. 

  • Support adopters directly: triage issues, unblock teams, and feed recurring friction back into the roadmap. 

  • Raise the bar through technical design review, code review, and mentorship across the design system and consuming teams. 

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional front-end engineering experience, including significant time building or operating a design system used by multiple teams. 

  • Advanced TypeScript and modern JavaScript, with deep command of the browser platform: DOM, events, Custom Elements, and Shadow DOM. 

  • Hands-on experience with design tokens: schema design, transform pipelines such as Style Dictionary, and multi-platform or multi-brand distribution. 

  • Expert CSS, particularly theming at scale with custom properties, cascade layers, modern layout, container queries, and forced colors mode. 

  • Current working knowledge of WCAG 2.2 Level AA and how to apply it to tokens, themes, and components, with hands-on screen reader and keyboard testing. 

  • Fluency applying AI tooling in your own engineering practice, including agentic coding tools, and sound judgment about where generated output needs human review. 

  • Strong front-end build, release, and versioning skills across tooling such as Vite, Rollup, or Webpack, plus semantic versioning in a monorepo. 

  • Demonstrated systems thinking: you reason about cascading impact across dependent teams and customers, and you plan migrations instead of shipping surprises. 

  • Proven track record of collaborating as a peer with designers and product managers, and of influencing technical direction across teams without direct authority. 

  • Clear technical writing, with experience documenting APIs and guiding other engineers through adoption. 

Nice to have 

  • Experience building AI tooling for other engineers, designers, or product partners to use, such as agent skills, MCP servers, or prompt-driven UI generation. 

  • Experience building developer-facing documentation or enablement sites.

title: Sr. CRM Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Tout a commencé sous le soleil de San Diego, en Californie, en 2004, lorsqu’un ingénieur visionnaire, Fred Luddy, a vu le potentiel de transformer notre façon de travailler. Aujourd’hui, ServiceNow se présente comme un leader mondial du marché, apportant une technologie innovante améliorée par l’IA à plus de 8 100 clients, dont 85% des entreprises du Fortune 500®. Notre plateforme intelligente basée sur le nuage connecte de manière transparente les personnes, les systèmes et les processus pour permettre aux organisations de trouver des méthodes de travail plus intelligentes, plus rapides et meilleures. Mais ce n’est que le début de notre voyage. Joignez-vous à nous dans la poursuite de notre objectif de rendre le monde meilleur pour tous.

######

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

ServiceNow recherche un Directeur de Compte CRM senior. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le succès sur le marché et l’expansion des produits CRM et IA de nouvelle génération de ServiceNow, en les positionnant comme la colonne vertébrale essentielle de la transformation numérique à l’échelle de l’entreprise.

Nos produits CRM ne sont pas de simples outils autonomes : ils reposent sur notre plateforme de gestion des services, reconnue comme leader du marché, et créent une source unique et intelligente de vérité. Cette approche unifiée permet à des processus critiques et à grande échelle, allant de l’intégration client, des plaintes, de la gestion des fraudes et des litiges, jusqu’aux successions, aux exceptions commerciales, à la gestion des courtiers et des négociants en valeurs mobilières, etc., de s’appuyer sur une information uniforme, une IA prédictive et une efficacité opérationnelle inégalée.

Ce que vous piloterez : CRM et IA au service du succès stratégique

Votre mission consistera à transformer la complexité sectorielle en valeur d’affaires mesurable :

  • Stratégie et exécution à l’échelle de l’entreprise :
  • Gestion de comptes : Élaborer et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de territoire axée sur des cas d’usage à forte valeur. Apporter une contribution pointue, propre à chaque secteur, lors de la planification des comptes, en veillant à ce que les comptes cibles et les cas d’usage soient alignés sur le potentiel de retour sur investissement élevé de nos solutions CRM propulsées par l’IA.

  • Cibler et valider les occasions CRM et IA : Prospecter et développer le pipeline dans les comptes CRM et faire croître les partenariats CRM existants grâce à une vente consultative, incluant notamment des séances d’information pour dirigeants (EBC), des ateliers de découverte et des projets pilotes de cas d’usage.

  • Défendre la valeur transformationnelle : collaborer avec les équipes de comptes, les partenaires d’implantation de solutions et les revendeurs pour conclure de nouvelles ventes, afin d’aider les dirigeants d’entreprise à améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle et l’expérience client.
  • Soutien aux ventes et formation des équipes :

########

ServiceNow is looking for a seasoned CRM Account Executive to capitalize on your deep industry knowledge and proven sales record within East Canada. You will be instrumental in overseeing the market success and expansion of ServiceNow's next-generation CRM and AI products, positioning them as the essential backbone for enterprise-wide digital transformation. 

Our CRM products are not just stand-alone tools; they are built upon our market-leading Service Management platform, creating a single, intelligent source of truth. This unified approach allows mission-critical, enterprise-scale processes—from customer onboarding, complaints, fraud and disputes management to decedent, trade exceptions, broker/dealer servicing, etc —to execute uniform information, predictive AI, and unmatched operational efficiency. 

What You Will Drive: CRM & AI for Strategic Success 

Your focus will be on converting industry complexity into measurable business value: 

  • Enterprise Strategy & Execution: 
  • Account Management: Develop and execute a territory strategy focused on high-value use cases. Provide critical, industry-specific input during account planning, ensuring target accounts and use cases are aligned with the high-ROI potential of our AI-driven CRM solutions 
  • Target & Validate AI/CRM Opportunities: Prospect and grow pipeline in CRM greenfield accounts and grow existing CRM partnerships through consultative selling, including, but not limited to Executive Briefings (EBCs), Discovery Workshops and Use Case Pilots. 
  • Champion Transformational Value: Partner with account teams and Solutions Implementation partners and resellers to close net new sales opportunities to help Enterprise leaders drive operational efficiency and a superior customer experience. 
  • Sales & Team Enablement

    Qualifications

    Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous possédez :

    • Une résidence actuelle dans le Grand Montréal ou à Québec, au Canada
    • Une maîtrise professionnelle de l’anglais et du français
    • Plus de 7 ans d’expérience dans la vente de logiciels d’entreprise au sein d’une équipe de comptes importante et matricielle
    • Plus de 7 ans d’expérience à démontrer et articuler la valeur d’affaires et le retour sur investissement des solutions CRM pour remporter des transactions complexes

    • Une expérience de l’intégration de l’IA dans les processus de travail, la prise de décision ou la résolution de problèmes, ou une réflexion approfondie sur la manière de le faire. Cela peut inclure l’utilisation d’outils propulsés par l’IA, l’automatisation de flux de travail, l’analyse de données issues de l’IA, ou l’exploration de l’impact potentiel de l’IA sur la fonction ou sur le secteur

    • Possibilité de déplacement 30-50% du temps

    Qualifications

    To be successful in this role you have:

    • Currently based in Greater Montréal or Québec City, Canada
    • Professional fluency in English and French
    • 7+ years of experience selling enterprise software within a large, matrixed account team environment
    • 7+ years of experience building and articulating the business value and ROI of CRM solutions to win complex deals
    • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
    • Ability to travel 30–50%

Job Description

About The Role:

The Principal Platform Architect is a trusted advisor for enterprise platform strategy and governance. You define platform standards and guide technical decisions to ensure ServiceNow remains healthy, scalable, and aligned to customer goals.

Your purpose is to establish governance models, anticipate risks, and enable sustainable growth. You engage across CxO, enterprise architects, and platform teams to influence decisions and ensure consistency across the program.

What You Will Do:

  • Define and maintain platform vision and strategy aligned to enterprise IT and business objectives.
  • Establish platform health metrics and remediation strategies to manage technical debt, platform hygiene, upgrade readiness, and long-term maintainability.
  • Define reusable architecture patterns, standards, and reference architectures that accelerate delivery and reduce implementation risk.

  • Anticipate and mitigate platform risks (scalability, performance, technical debt).
  • Influence adoption of leading practices across customer, partner, and ServiceNow teams.
  • Provide structured feedback to ServiceNow product and engineering teams.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Platform operating model adopted and actively governing demand, releases, and technical standards.
  • Reduction in technical debt and improvement in platform health metrics.
  • Consistent architecture decisions across all implementation partners.
  • Increased adoption of strategic platform capabilities, including AI and automation.
  • Demonstrable alignment between platform roadmap and business outcomes.
  • ServiceNow is embedded as a strategic enterprise platform with clear governance models in place.
  • Platform standards are consistently applied across all delivery teams.
  • Technical risks are reduced, and scalability is maintained.

What Success Looks Like

The GAIL (Get AI Live) program deploys engineers directly into strategic customer engagements to drive real AI adoption and measurable value realization.

The GAIL Core Team is the permanent engine behind that program. It provides the stable foundation of institutional knowledge, tooling ownership, and senior expertise that makes every engagement, and every rotating engineer, better than the last.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the GAIL Core Team, you will own the hardest engagements, set the quality standard for the entire practice, and build the infrastructure that scales it. This is hands-on, customer-facing work, not theoretical process, and its impact compounds with every engagement you lead and every engineer you bring up behind you.

Working in the Japan Market

Japan brings market-specific requirements and tasks that need strong engineering knowledge to solve. Customers here expect depth, precision, and thorough follow-through. In this role, a mindset of helping the market succeed is critical. Engagements

Playbook and Quality

Tooling

  • Build, maintain, and push shared GAIL tooling across all engagements, reducing reinvention and raising the floor for every engineer in the rotation.

Mentoring and Knowledge

  • Mentor and ramp incoming GAIL engineers through structured onboarding, shadowing, and coaching on first customer interactions.

Job Description

Flow by ServiceNow is a standalone conversational AI service desk, with its own product and its own codebase. Employees ask for help wherever they already work — Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, or the browser. Flow answers from connected knowledge, handles the request, and runs automations the team publishes. AI is how the product works, and a person stays in control when the action is sensitive. 

Flow is a new company inside ServiceNow, reimagining every function from first principles. We hire builders with agency and curiosity who use AI as the default way to design, review, and operate. They challenge inherited ways of working and treat their work as craft. 

Flow runs on infrastructure this team owns end to end. You’ll own the AWS platform, the delivery pipeline that puts code on it, the durable-execution plane that runs customer automations in isolation, and the operational surface of an AI runtime — including what it costs and whether it is getting better. 

What you get to do in this role 

  • Own the AWS platform Flow runs on — containerized services, managed PostgreSQL, and an isolated execution plane for customer workloads — all defined as infrastructure as code. 
  • Own delivery end to end: the CI verification pipeline, release promotion, and gated rollouts with migrations, smoke verification and automatic rollback. 
  • Operate the production database: schema migrations, capacity planning, replication, backups and recovery. 
  • Write and test infrastructure, delivery and operational code in TypeScript, held to the same review and testing bar as product code. 
  • Own the security gates in the delivery pipeline and the least-privilege access that deploys run under. 
  • Operate the AI runtime: model routing and failover, credential management, cost attribution, and the eval pipelines that gate changes. 
  • Carry on-call with the rest of the team, and shape the SLOs and error budgets that come with scale. 
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of new products and features while also enhancing the existing product suite. 
  • Be a mentor for colleagues and help promote knowledge-sharing. 

Qualifications

We don’t expect anyone to match every line below. If most of it describes you, we’d like to hear from you. 

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry. 
  • Current, hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development. We expect you to work this way. 
  • Experience leveraging AI/ML in engineering and quality processes (e.g., automated testing, AI-driven insights, intelligent monitoring). 
  • 12+ years of experience in DevOps, platform or infrastructure engineering, with a track record of delivering high-quality products. 
  • Deep AWS experience, operating production platforms at scale. 
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript. 
  • Infrastructure as code in a general-purpose language — AWS CDK, Pulumi or similar. 
  • Experience running containerized services in production. 
  • Experience with software development lifecycle (SDLC) and automation — implementing automation, testing strategies, and CI/CD practices across delivery stages using GitHub for version control and GitHub Actions for automated build, test, and deployment workflows. 
  • Experience with PostgreSQL database management. 
  • Experience with AI/ML microservice integration. 
  • Experience operating inside an enterprise cloud-governance regime — service control policies, mandated naming and tagging, restricted IAM, region allowlists — and delivering within them. 

Why join us 

Flow is early enough that the platform’s patterns are still being set, and one engineer’s decisions carry. You’ll mature the delivery, reliability and cost practices a fast-growing AI product needs, inside a real enterprise governance regime — with ServiceNow’s customers, scrutiny and scale behind you.

This is a hands-on role with broad influence — you’ll make architectural calls, raise the engineering bar, and help the team move from AI-assisted development to AI-native delivery. 

What you’ll do 

  • Lead the design and delivery of complex, cross-functional features across the product, from architecture through production operations. 
  • Build AI-native capabilities: agent loops and the tools they call, prompt and context design, retrieval that grounds and cites its answers, and the eval harnesses that tell us whether a change actually made the product better — with reliability and governance built in. 
  • Define and drive how the team uses AI across the development lifecycle: code generation, test automation, review, triage, and documentation. Agentic coding is central to how this team ships. Measure the impact and share what works. 
  • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers and set standards for code quality, observability, and safe AI usage. 
  • Partner with product, UX, and other engineering leads to turn ambiguous problems into scoped, shippable plans. 
  • Own production quality for your area, including defect triage, release readiness, and gate reviews. 

Qualifications

What we’re looking for 

We don’t expect anyone to match every line below. Depth matters more to us than a match on any particular toolchain — be excellent in a modern typed stack and quick to pick up a new one. 

  • Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This includes current, hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development, and an opinion on where those tools help and where they don’t. 
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership at the staff level or equivalent.

The SRE team is a group of highly technical engineers who are tasked with maintaining and developing the reliability, scalability and performance of the ServiceNow infrastructure.   • Partner with product and engineering to surface field signal from customer engagements and close the feedback loop. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, ideally with a mix of enterprise product work and hands-on customer or field delivery.

Build the next growth business inside ServiceNow.

This is not a role where you inherit a mature territory and execute an established playbook.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial commercial leader to build and scale our CRM & CPQ business across Switzerland, Austria and Central & Eastern Europe.

At the heart of the opportunity is the AI-powered CPQ technology ServiceNow acquired with Logik.ai, designed to transform complex configuration, pricing and quoting and connect it with the broader opportunity-to-order-to-service lifecycle. [newsroom.s...icenow.com], [servicenow.com]

Build a $10M+ qualified business.

90 days: Material qualified pipeline with clear customer problems, compelling use cases and paths to value.

Logik.ai brought a modern, AI-powered and composable CPQ capability into ServiceNow's CRM portfolio, aimed at helping enterprises address complex configuration, pricing, manual quoting and disconnected approval processes. [newsroom.s...icenow.com]

As a Senior AI Full-Stack Product Engineer at ServiceNow, you will build AI-powered product experiences that solve meaningful Field Service Management customer problems. You will combine full-stack software engineering, product thinking, and hands-on AI development to deliver reliable, scalable production capabilities.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Own end-to-end development across user interfaces, backend services, AI capabilities, enterprise data, and integrations.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to understand customer needs and determine where AI delivers meaningful value.
  • Build applications using large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured outputs, tool calling, and agentic workflows.
  • Develop conversational and multimodal experiences across web, chat, and voice, with attention to usability, context, latency, and reliability.
  • Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise APIs, data, and business workflows while enforcing security, privacy, and access controls.
  • Design multi-step AI workflows with appropriate autonomy, human handoffs, exception handling, and recovery.
  • Develop and refine prompts, system instructions, and tool definitions using evaluations and production feedback.
  • Build scalable application services with testing, observability, error handling, and performance optimization.
  • Prototype rapidly and turn successful experiments into maintainable production software.
  • Use AI coding tools effectively while maintaining engineering quality and security.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and establish reusable development patterns.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you have:

  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • A strong track record of building and operating production software, including hands-on experience developing AI/LLM-powered applications.
  • Full-stack development experience spanning user-facing applications, backend services, APIs, and data models.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals in system design, distributed systems, testing, and production operations.
  • Practical knowledge of prompting, context management, RAG, structured outputs, tool calling, and agent orchestration.
  • Experience integrating applications with enterprise data, APIs, workflows, and external systems.
  • An understanding of AI application trade-offs, including latency, cost, reliability, hallucination, grounding, security, and data privacy.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Systems - Moveworks
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The Role

We're building the runtime infrastructure that powers Moveworks' AI agents — the systems that orchestrate, execute, and deliver agent responses to millions of enterprise users in real time. This is not an ML role. This is a distributed systems engineering role at the heart of the agentic AI wave.

Our AI agents can plan, execute multi-step workflows, call tools, wait on human input, and resume — all while maintaining correctness, observability, and low latency. The systems that make this possible are what you'll build and own.


What you get to do in this role:

  • Agent orchestration engine — A state machine that manages long-running agent sessions, coordinating planning, execution, and user interaction across multiple LLM calls and tool invocations
  • Distributed session management — Lease-based ownership using DynamoDB conditional writes, heartbeat protocols, and crash recovery via checkpointing
  • Event-driven message pipeline — SQS FIFO queues for ordered delivery, Kafka consumers for event processing, and real-time streaming via gRPC and Socket.IO
  • Structured concurrency — Python asyncio TaskGroups running multiple concurrent tasks per session (message polling, lease heartbeats, output publishing, orchestrator execution) with fail-fast semantics and graceful cancellation
  • Observability infrastructure — OpenTelemetry instrumentation, distributed trace context propagation across async boundaries, custom span lifecycle management for sessions that span minutes
  • Caching and state layers — Redis, DynamoDB KV stores with per-org/per-bot scoping, batch read optimization, and hot-reload configuration

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

You should have deep experience in at least 3 of these areas:

  • Distributed systems: consistency models, idempotency, exactly-once delivery, distributed locking/leasing
  • Concurrent/async programming: Python asyncio, Go goroutines, structured concurrency, cancellation handling
  • Event-driven architectures: message queues (SQS, Kafka), pub/sub, backpressure, delivery guarantees
  • Database systems for infrastructure: DynamoDB (conditional writes, transactions), Redis (connection pooling, pub/sub)
  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, span context propagation, Prometheus metrics
  • gRPC/protobuf: streaming RPCs, service interface design, error handling patterns

Required:

  • 10+ years building production backend/infrastructure systems
  • Strong in Python or Go (ideally both)
  • Experience designing and operating systems that handle real traffic at scale
  • Comfort with ambiguity — these are novel problems without textbook solutions

title: Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

** This role can be hired in either Zurich or Lausanne **

As an Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI for the Switzerland market, you are the technical face of a fundamentally different way of selling. Rather than leading with slideware and scripted demos, you embed alongside the customer, run deep Discovery to isolate one high-value problem, and then prove value in the open — building a working Proof of Value (POV) on the customer’s own data using our Agentic workflow capabilities.

You partner with Sales, Product Management, and Executive Leadership to turn a single, well-chosen use case into undeniable, data-backed proof that earns the next phase of the relationship. This role blends the consultative instincts of a Sr. Advisory Solution Consultant with the hands-on, build-it-in-the-field engineering of a forward-deployed engineer: someone who works inside the customer’s own environment, configuring and proving solutions on their live data rather than presenting finished products from the outside. 

The Embedded Approach 

The Advisory Solution Consultant inverts the traditional pre-sales motion. Product demonstration is deliberately minimal — just enough to establish credibility and unlock the real work. The center of gravity is the POV: a short, focused cycle where we get access to a slice of the customer’s data, stand up an Agentic workflow against a problem they genuinely care about, and let the outcome speak for itself. Your job is to earn the right to that POV through rigorous Discovery, then deliver it as an embedded engineer, not a presenter. 

What You’ll Do 

As the Advisory Solution Consultant, you will lead a Discovery-first, POV-centric engagement model — using your technical depth and Agentic workflow expertise to convert customer data into proven outcomes, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. 

Key responsibilities include: 

  • Partner with Sales as the embedded technical lead — someone who wins on proof, not presentation — to drive transformational CRM opportunities. 
  • Lead rigorous Discovery to isolate a single, high-value problem worth solving, mapping the customer’s data, systems, and desired outcome before any product is shown. 
  • Keep product demonstration minimal and purposeful — use it only to establish credibility and to set up the POV, never as a substitute for proving value on real data. 
  • Secure and scope a POV: earn customer sponsorship to engage in a hands-on cycle where we use their data to solve the identified problem with our Agentic workflow capabilities. 
  • Build and deliver the POV as an embedded engineer — configuring Agentic workflows against the customer’s environment and producing measurable, data-backed results. 
  • Translate POV outcomes into an executive value narrative that quantifies impact and defines the path from a single proven use case to enterprise-wide adoption. 
  • Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. 
  • Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. 
  • Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks, and Agentic workflow patterns so the embedded POV motion scales across the team. 
  • Represent the company at enterprise events, technology forums, and leadership summits as a credible, hands-on technical voice for the embedded POV approach. 

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For 

To succeed in this role, you should bring: 

  • Builder Mindset: A builder’s instinct — comfortable getting hands on with a customer’s data and environment to prove value directly, rather than relying on canned demonstrations. 
  • POV-Centric Selling: Proven ability to scope, sell, and deliver Proof-of-Value engagements that convert a single problem into quantified, data-backed outcomes. 
  • Discovery Rigor: Exceptional discovery skills to quickly isolate the one problem worth solving and secure customer commitment to a POV. 
  • Agentic & AI Fluency: Deep, practical understanding of Agentic workflows and AI-driven automation, and how to apply them to CRM problems on live customer data. 
  • CRM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in CRM and customer experience, with strong knowledge of service, sales, lead & opportunity management. 
  • Enterprise Experience: Proven track record engaging large organizations and earning executive sponsorship for hands-on, data-driven engagements. 
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to translate technical POV results into clear, business-oriented value stories for senior enterprise stakeholders. 
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global teams spanning Sales, Product, and delivery. 
  • Language: fluency in English and French/German 

Qualifications 

  • Demonstrated experience building or delivering POVs, prototypes, or hands-on technical engagements — a hands-on track record of proving value on real customer data, not just presenting it. 
  • Hands-on experience applying AI and Agentic workflow capabilities to solve business problems — automating workflows, orchestrating AI agents, and analyzing AI-driven outcomes within CRM or adjacent enterprise contexts. 
  • 10+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience, with a clear shift toward Discovery-led, proof-based selling. 
  • Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or strong technical expertise with cloud software solutions. 
  • Experience working collaboratively with product management, product marketing, partners, and professional services. 
  • Track record of working with a Sales counterpart to promote execution excellence and advance transformational opportunities.

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busy work so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

We are seeking a seasoned Staff Researcher to join the core product team for the rapidly growing Asset Management business unit to drive product decisions through user insights and data.  

Job Description

What you get to do in this role:

  • Understand customers’ unique needs for our products, including defining and synthesizing user needs, pain points, use cases, and specific product opportunities. 

  • Build trusted relationships across PM, Design, Engineering, and Support so research is brought into roadmap conversations early.  

  • Serve as a strategic partner to Product Managers, Designers, and other cross-functional team members to influence product strategy and roadmaps through actionable insights and data. 

  • Influence product decisions by presenting evidence that reframes problems, shifts priorities, or changes scope.  

  • Triangulate quant, qual, and telemetry data to formulate a strong perspective for the future state of the product and develop strategic and tactical insights with actionable recommendations. 

  • Translate complex research into clear, compelling narratives tailored to audiences from designers to executives. Champion the strategic value of research with senior leaders to expand its role in product decisions. 

  • Use advanced AI skills to enhance the execution and analysis phases to move fast. 

  • Provide mentorship to other members of the team and champion the discipline across the organization. 

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications (The must have):

  • Experience in leveraging how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. 

  • Proven track record in using qual and quant research methods in solving user problems.  

  • Extensive experience in applying customer-centered research techniques to product definition and designs. 

  • Expert knowledge in defining, planning and executing research studies including outlining objectives, goals, and timelines. This includes developing sample plans and determining the best data collection approach using quantitative and/or qualitative methods. 

  • Expert presentation skills to visualize and articulate technically complex topics and make them easy to understand with customers as well as product management and design stakeholders. 

  • A portfolio of work representing research that influenced product decisions. This includes examples of research goals, research methodologies used, the process followed, your involvement and role, data visualizations, and crisply articulated insights from the research that drove product and design decisions. 

Preferred Qualifications (The nice to have):

  • Experience in shipping enterprise software products for various user types. 

  • Experience in using analytics and telemetry as part of the data points.   

  • Experience with the execution of large-scale surveys as well as rich qualitative research techniques. 

  • The ability to learn new technical concepts quickly. 

  • Experience coaching and mentoring more junior team members, contributing to their growth
