Job Description

About the Program

The GAIL (Get AI Live) program deploys engineers directly into strategic customer engagements to drive real AI adoption and measurable value realization.

The GAIL Core Team is the permanent engine behind that program. It provides the stable foundation of institutional knowledge, tooling ownership, and senior expertise that makes every engagement, and every rotating engineer, better than the last.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the GAIL Core Team, you will own the hardest engagements, set the quality standard for the entire practice, and build the infrastructure that scales it. This is hands-on, customer-facing work, not theoretical process, and its impact compounds with every engagement you lead and every engineer you bring up behind you.

Working in the Japan Market

Japan brings market-specific requirements and tasks that need strong engineering knowledge to solve. These include local compliance and governance expectations, language and localization needs, and integration with established enterprise environments. Customers here expect depth, precision, and thorough follow-through. In this role, a mindset of helping the market succeed is critical. You will work through these Japan-specific challenges hands-on and turn what you learn into reusable assets for the wider GAIL practice.

What You Will Do

Engagements

  • Lead the most complex GAIL and Go-Live Support engagements, including large-scale enterprise deployments, escalations, and high-stakes go-lives where depth and experience matter most.

Playbook and Quality

  • Own and evolve the GAIL playbook, keeping deployment standards, required gates, and prescribed sequences current, accurate, and actionable across the program.
  • Drive quality standards across the GAIL practice by defining what great looks like and holding the line on it.

Tooling

  • Build, maintain, and push shared GAIL tooling across all engagements, reducing reinvention and raising the floor for every engineer in the rotation.

Mentoring and Knowledge

  • Mentor and ramp incoming GAIL engineers through structured onboarding, shadowing, and coaching on first customer interactions.
  • Capture patterns from complex deployments and feed them into the team’s knowledge base, turning hard-won lessons into reusable assets that uplift the whole team.

Product Partnership

  • Partner with product and engineering to surface field signal from customer engagements and close the feedback loop.

    Qualifications

    To be successful in this role you have

    • 6+ years of software engineering experience, ideally with a mix of enterprise product work and hands-on customer or field delivery.
    • Strong coding ability in JavaScript and one or more additional languages (Java, Python, or equivalent), witha track recordof building and shipping production-quality solutions.
    • Experience deploying or integrating AI features and GenAI models — including Now Assist, AI Agents, or equivalent platforms — in real customer environments.
      Familiarity with prompt engineering and the judgment to tune non-deterministic outputs for reliability and production-grade clarity.
    • A bias for standards over shortcuts — you know when a playbook gate applies, when it doesn’t, and you own that call with clear reasoning.
    • A builder’s instinct for shared tooling and reusable patterns — you don’t reinvent the wheel when you can build something the whole program can use.
    • The ability to mentor effectively — you raise the level of the engineers around you through direct coaching, not just example.
    • Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences, including customer-facing executive stakeholders.
    • Business-level English (required), with the ability to communicate fluently in written and spoken form with customers and global teams.
    • Business-level Japanese (nice to have), with the ability to engage Japanese-speaking customers and stakeholders in a professional setting.

This role offers the best of both worlds: the agility, rapid execution, and massive impact of a startup, fully backed by the robust Go-To-Market (GTM) engine of a highly established company.   • Communicate complex problems into easily understood requirements and provide solutions

  • Develop multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the needs of different audiences

  • Lead the promoting of efforts across different groups of team members, along with the ability to influence inside and outside of your team

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a strong background in the cybersecurity domain (e.g., deep security, vulnerability detection, and response)

Job Description

We’re looking for a motivated, and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join ServiceNow’s Global Business Acceleration team.

As a BDR, you’ll play a critical role in driving pipeline growth by identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers. Through strategic outreach, inbound lead follow-up and engagement with prospects from marketing campaigns, you’ll help connect organizations with solutions that address their business challenges.

In this role, you’ll engage prospective customers, uncover business needs, assess interest using established qualification criteria, and collaborate with Account Executives to advance qualified opportunities. You’ll develop foundational skills in communication, prospecting, and relationship building.

Whether you're launching your career or bringing experience from another industry, GBA is more than your first role at ServiceNow. It's an opportunity to discover your potential, accelerate your growth, and build a career with a company shaping the future of work.

We’re keen to hear from talented individuals interested in joining our talent pools for potential opportunities arising throughout 2027. While there is currently no immediate vacancy available, we’re looking to connect with strong candidates ahead of anticipated future business demand.

Hiring timelines will vary depending on business needs, and opportunities may arise at different stages throughout the year. By registering your interest, you’ll be considered for relevant opportunities as they become available. We’ll keep you informed of any potential opportunities and anticipated hiring timelines as the year progresses.

Please note that registering your interest does not relate to an active vacancy or guarantee an immediate opportunity to join the team

What you get to do in this role:

  • Generate new business pipeline through a combination of outbound prospecting, inbound lead qualification, and follow-up on marketing campaigns and events.

  • Engage current and prospective customers through phone, email, and social—and connect with key contacts using approved messaging and defined qualification criteria.

  • Research companies, industries, and business challenges to identify opportunities where ServiceNow can deliver value.

  • Apply basic problem-solving techniques to assess client needs and determine appropriate next steps based on defined criteria.

  • Qualify opportunities and partner with account executives to build strong sales pipeline.

  • Take ownership of individual performance goals, embrace coaching and feedback, and contribute to a collaborative, high-performing sales culture.

What you gain from this role:

  • An immersive four-week new hire training program designed to build your sales skills, confidence, and knowledge of the ServiceNow platform.

  • A collaborative global community that celebrates successes, encourages innovation, and invests in your future.

  • A strong foundation in technology sales, with real-world experience and ongoing development opportunities to help shape your career at ServiceNow.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent required

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to engage professionally and confidently with customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Demonstrate initiative, curiosity, and a results-oriented mindset, with a willingness to take ownership of goals and responsibilities.

  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.

  • Resilience, adaptability, and growth mindset.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Willingness to learn AI-native tools and innovate on how they’re used to enhance outreach, prioritization, and daily workflows.

  • A basic understanding of cloud computing and SaaS concepts, or the willingness to learn quickly.

  • Ability to participate in development simulations, in-person messaging activities, and meet defined performance and metrics expectations.

  • Commitment to full participation in Global Business Acceleration development tracks to launch an enduring career at ServiceNow within 48 months.

title: Senior Services Account Executive - Belgium
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

This role is part of the Go-To-Market team within the Customer Excellence Group. Our purpose is to accelerate platform adoption and drive customer business outcomes. We do this through a portfolio of services, delivered by world-class consultants, training and success professionals, our leading practices, methodologies, and tools, as well as our ecosystem of partners. 

What you get to do in this role:

As a Senior Services Account Executive - Belgium, you will be responsible for selling a portfolio of service offerings designed to help our customers successfully adopt the products they have purchased and ultimately achieve the business outcomes they expected from utilizing our products. These service offerings include our product implementation services. The Services Account Executive is well-versed in services and post-sales adoption strategies.  They are a trusted advisor to the account team and our customers for successful implementation, adoption, and value realization.

A quota carrying role, the Services Account Executive owns the Services sales strategy by proactively creating demand for new Services opportunities and partnering with the ServiceNow Sales team and our partners to develop and successfully execute Services sales opportunities for their assigned territory.

  • Collaborate with software sales account teams, Customer Outcomes team members, and our eco-system of delivery partners
  • Develop and execute a services sales strategy in the designated territory with a target account list
  • Proactively create new Services opportunities in both new and installed base customers
  • Create pipeline and manage end-to-end forecasting process for Services opportunities
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their existing and future digital transformation roadmap and driving the right mix of ServiceNow services to meet their needs
  • Arrange and conduct Executive and CxO services-related discussions in alignment with the account strategy
  • Lead extended team in solutioning and scoping, and proposal development
  • Execute value-based selling methodology for Implementation Services opportunities

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • Deep services sales experience gained within a SaaS software or solution sales organization (or reasonable equivalent)
  • Experience selling into both Public and Private sector customer organisations in Belgium
  • New account sales focus, operating independently to identify new opportunities
  • Existing relationships in large enterprise accounts a plus

Job Description

Internship Program Overview   

At ServiceNow, we’re looking for students who want to learn, grow, and take a giant step early in their careers, all while making a giant impact. We offer 12-week summer internship opportunities across various business functions.    

Interns will participate in executive speaker series, career development workshops, philanthropic efforts, and team-building activities. Additionally, interns will have access to online learnings and a dedicated summer coach to further grow their careers with us.   

If you want to make work, work better, we want you. To learn more, check out our Early Career Page!   

Product Team Overview 

We are looking for full-time MBA students to join our Product Management team at ServiceNow. As a Product Manager, you will work on complex high-tech problems by undertaking research, designing, and executing analysis, and helping frame and structure complex problems. You will work closely with other team members and stakeholders to accelerate our impact and directly contribute to our overall business strategy. This is an excellent opportunity if you are looking to get a taste of product management at a high-growth enterprise software company!      

Product Management is a team sport at ServiceNow. We have a unique organization structure in which multiple Product Management roles work together to contribute to a product’s success.   
  
We have two types of Product Managers within our teams: Inbound and Outbound  

For the application: If you’re interested in both Inbound and Outbound Product Manager roles, please apply to your top choice only. Your application will automatically be considered for both roles. You are welcome to include your thoughts during the hiring manager notes. 

For context: Inbound Product Managers plan for and develop new products and future releases of a product. They gather feedback to determine the problems we're trying to solve, then generate a product roadmap. They work with various teams such as release management, design, and engineering development.  

For this role: Outbound Product Managers enable Go-To-Market teams on product innovation and evangelize the product with customers and partners. Considered the product experts, they generally serve as the bridge between the inbound PM and the product marketing team to ensure the product gets to our customers.   

A few key responsibilities of Outbound PMs include:   

  • Enable our go to market partners  

  • Define pricing & packaging (in collaboration with our pricing team)  

  • Provide best practice content and guidance  

  • Package and deliver in-depth competitive analysis for go to market partners  

  • Drive customer usage and adoption programs  

  • Occasionally provide onboarding and renewal help  

Additional possible responsibilities include: 

  • Support senior program managers and/or product managers across the entire project lifecycle to deliver critical programs for Service Now initiatives.   

  • Work and collaborate directly with Product Managers, Product Design, & Development Teams to build new features and improve adoption on existing features.  

  • Build familiarity with scrum process and willingness to contribute to team deliverables.  

  • Understand product strategy that sets us up for success as we look to grow to $15B+ in revenue. 

  • Research and collect product requirements from key buyer audiences and end-users to determine areas of opportunity for product enhancements. 

  • Oversee the product or project timeline, deadlines, milestones as it is being built by development/engineering and communicate with stakeholders to keep them updated.  

  • Contribute to the complete product lifecycle, from researching market needs and competition, analyzing customer data, writing product requirements, and delivering product features to market. 

  • Understand the technical and business impacts of product decisions that inform tradeoff decisions to optimize against product delivery and customer value.  

Qualifications

Internship location may vary based on team growth strategies.

Required Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled full-time at an accredited university pursuing an MBA in Engineering, Business Management, Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Applied Sciences, or a related field.
  • Graduating May 2028 or later.
  • Available to work full-time for a 12-week summer internship.
  • 3–6 years of related experience.
  • Experience using or evaluating AI to improve workflows, decision-making, problem-solving, automation, or data-driven insights.
  • Experience defining product requirements and translating them into a product roadmap.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to balance customer desirability, business viability, and technical feasibility.
  • Strong prioritization, problem-solving, and analytical skills, with a data-driven and hypothesis-led approach.
  • Deep curiosity about customer needs and a passion for building relationships and delivering high-value solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Experience collaborating with developers and designers to create compelling customer experiences.
  • Demonstrated project management experience through internships, academic work, or personal projects.

Job Description

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO)  

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) delivers world-class, innovative security solutions to reduce risk and protect the company and our customers. We enable our customers to migrate their most sensitive data and workloads to the cloud, accelerating our business so that we are the most trusted SaaS provider. We create an environment where our employees are proud to work and can make a positive impact. 

ServiceNow runs mission-critical workflows for a large share of the world's enterprises. Cyber Defense Engineering protects ServiceNow and the platform our customers run on. Cyber defense doesn't scale through headcount alone. It scales when systems make defenders exponentially more effective. Data is how we get there. 

As Principal Software Engineer & Architect, you will own the technical direction of the data and platform systems behind detection, investigation, hunting, response, and AI-driven defense. Several engineering teams will build against your architecture, and your decisions will show up in measurable security outcomes.  

What You'll Do 

  • Own the architecture of our multi-system security data platform, from ingestion to access, including the data that powers detection, investigation, hunting and risk analytics. Decide what data lives where, weighing business value, performance, retention, and cost, and remove duplication across systems. 
  • Define shared schemas, data models, and data contracts so telemetry from different sources is consistent, trustworthy, and joinable for both people, automation and AI. 
  • Build the data foundation for applied AI in security operations: data and feature pipelines, model evaluation, retrieval, and governed data access for AI agents that investigate and respond to threats. 
  • Build access control, data protection, auditability, and compliance into the architecture so the platform is secure by design. 
  • Lead technical design across teams, resolve tradeoffs on shared platforms, and keep the architecture coherent as the organization grows. Drive major decisions to closure through design and decision documents. 
  • Set engineering standards for source control, CI/CD, testing, and observability. Mentor engineers through design and code review. 
  • Tie platform investments to measurable outcomes: detection coverage; time to detect, investigate, and mitigate; data quality and freshness; and more. 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a similar field. 
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 3+ years in a principal, staff, or architect role. 
  • Proven experience designing and operating large-scale cloud data platforms in production, including data modeling, data warehouse design, and high-volume streaming and batch telemetry pipelines across multiple systems. 
  • Hands-on ML/AI experience, including shipping ML or LLM-based systems to production, and working knowledge of how data quality, freshness, and lineage limit model performance. 
  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one general-purpose language (Python, Go, or Java). 
  • A record of setting technical direction across teams without formal authority. 
  • Clear, concise writing and a habit of documenting decisions and their rationale. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience applying ML and graph-based analysis to security problems, such as anomaly detection, entity correlation, incident investigations, or attack path analysis. 
  • Experience in security operations, such as SIEM platforms, security datalakes, detection engineering, or incident response. 
  • Knowledge of secure data access patterns such as RBAC/ABAC, masking, and policy-as-code. 
  • Advanced degree in machine learning, AI, or a related field.

descriptionHtml:

In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Moveworks’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business. Come join us!

ServiceNow: it all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

The Role

Moveworks' AI agents don't just generate text — they act. They plan, call tools, and change real state in enterprise systems on behalf of 5.5 million employees. Building agents is no longer the bottleneck. Improving them is: knowing whether a change made the agent better, why a conversation failed, and which part of the system should be fixed.

You'll build the loop that makes our agents improve themselves — finding failures in real use, deciding which part of the agent harness is responsible, checking every proposed fix on cases the fixer never saw, and turning each fixed failure into a permanent test. We improve the system around the model: instructions, tool descriptions, routing, knowledge and memory. We don't train the model itself.

The work is blend of ML and systems engineering. You'll decide whether a signal is trustworthy enough to act on, and build the infrastructure that produces that signal reproducibly across hundreds of customer organizations.

This isn't a model-training role, and it isn't a testing role. It's applied ML at a point where the methodology genuinely isn't settled: LLMs judging LLMs is an open research problem, and we're working it against agents that take real, irreversible actions in stateful, multi-tenant enterprise environments.


What you get to do in this role:

Judge design and calibration

  • A shared base judge with per-item rubrics expressed as configuration next to the dataset — so eval authors express intent, rather than forking a prompt per eval
  • Splitting the problem correctly: deterministic validators for checkable world state ("was the ticket created, with the right item, routed to the right approver?"), and an LLM judge for the parts that are genuinely fuzzy — was the clarifying question appropriate, was policy followed, was the path efficient
  • Scoring that reports its own confidence, so uncertain judgements route to a human instead of quietly becoming trusted signal
  • A standing calibration loop against human-labeled trajectories, run in partnership with our annotation team — they own the human labeling, you own the calibrated judge artifact. How consistently humans agree with each other sets the ceiling on how good any judge can be, so raising that ceiling is part of the job
  • Guarding against correlated blind spots: our user simulator and our judge are both LLMs, and they can be wrong in the same direction
  • Offline↔online divergence: when simulation and production disagree, being the person who can say why, and keeping the suite re-seeded from new production failures so it can't quietly overfit

Self-improving agent harness

This is where the pillar is headed, and a large part of why the seat exists. You'll build the components that let the agent harness get better from its own use, without changing the model underneath.

  • Finding what to improve: surfacing where the agent falls short in real use, including failures that look like success
  • Synthetic data and environments: generating scenarios and the seeded enterprise worlds they run in — with expected outcomes and checks — from real failures or ahead of what customers ask for, and making sure what gets generated is realistic, hard enough, and doesn't leak the answer
  • Deciding where a fix belongs: understanding why the agent failed and which part of the harness should change: its instructions, tools, routing, knowledge or memory
  • Proposing improvements: optimizing those components against simulation rather than against production traffic
  • Checking before anything ships: verifying every proposed change on cases it wasn't tuned on, catching regressions an average would hide, and keeping the part that proposes a change separate from the part that judges it
  • Evals that grow: every fixed failure becomes a permanent test, so the suite gets stronger the more the agent is used
  • Safe across many customers: learnings stay scoped to one organization where they must, and admins approve anything org-specific
  • The infrastructure that runs it: a loop that runs reproducibly, at scale, across hundreds of customer organizations
  • The guardrail that keeps it honest: end-state outcomes are what we hold the agent to

Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years in applied ML or ML-adjacent engineering, with systems you shipped, operated, and others relied on
  • Experience turning subjective human judgement into a measurement that holds up — one that a team gated decisions on, validated against human labels. This is the core of the job
  • You've improved a multi-component system through measurement — pipelines, retrieval, prompts, policies, or routing — not only by changing model weights
  • Strong applied ML fundamentals, and comfort treating LLMs as a component you evaluate and prompt rather than one you train
  • Strong Python and production engineering: services, data pipelines, and designs that make results reproducible (versioned data, deterministic replay, recorded inputs)
  • Ability to think and communicate clearly about complex problems — a large part of this job is convincing engineers that a number means what you say it means, and being right
  • A high degree of ownership and a bias toward shipping at startup pace
  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgement to know when a measurement is good enough to act on

Experience in at least 3 of these:

  • LLM-as-judge or automated evaluation design, and calibrating it against human judgement
  • Human annotation programs: rubric authoring, label quality, and annotator throughput as a real constraint
  • Experimentation rigor: held-out sets, decision rules set up front, variance and noise, regression detection
  • Failure analysis at scale: classifying, clustering, and attributing errors in logs or traces
  • Replay, simulation, or sandboxed test infrastructure
  • Synthetic data generation for evaluation: generated scenarios, seeded environments, and quality controls on what gets generated
  • Prompt and harness optimization as an engineering discipline — versioned, tested, and measured, not tuned by vibes
  • Search ranking, recsys, or online experimentation evaluation — golden-set staleness, offline/online divergence, side-by-side rater agreement
  • High-volume trace or event data pipelines

At the Staff level, additionally: you'd own the measurement architecture of the self-improving loop end to end — judging, deciding where fixes belong, and checking them — set the measurement standard the organization uses to decide whether a change ships, be the technical counterpart to the team that builds the agent, and mentor engineers across the team on evaluation methodology.

Bonus:

  • Evaluated LLM agents: multi-step trajectories, tool calls, actions in stateful environments
  • Generated complete agent environments — tasks, stateful worlds, and verifiers — automatically, at scale
  • Published or shipped evaluation methodology others adopted
  • Built eval tooling used by teams outside your own, or an eval product customers use
  • Worked on agentic systems that take actions, not just generate text

Job Description

The Role

We're building the runtime infrastructure that powers Moveworks' AI agents — the systems that orchestrate, execute, and deliver agent responses to millions of enterprise users in real time. This role sits where large language models meet distributed systems. You'll apply machine learning, LLM, and distributed systems expertise to make agents plan, reason, and use tools reliably, and you'll build the production systems that run those agents at enterprise scale.

Our AI agents can plan, execute multi-step workflows, call tools, wait on human input, and resume — all while maintaining correctness, observability, and low latency. The systems that make this possible are what you'll build and own.


What you get to do in this role:

  • Agent orchestration engine — A state machine that manages long-running agent sessions, coordinating planning, execution, and user interaction across multiple LLM calls and tool invocations
  • Model routing and adaptation — Choose, route between, and fine-tune or distill LLMs for specific agent tasks. Meet enterprise requirements such as granular permissions, data freshness, explainability, and preserving general knowledge.
  • Distributed session management — Lease-based ownership using conditional writes, heartbeat protocols, and crash recovery via checkpointing
  • Event-driven message pipeline — FIFO queues for ordered delivery, consumers for event processing, and real-time streaming via gRPC and Socket.IO
  • Structured concurrency — Running multiple concurrent tasks per session with fail-fast semantics and graceful cancellation
  • Observability infrastructure — OpenTelemetry instrumentation, distributed trace context propagation across async boundaries, custom span lifecycle management for sessions that span minutes
  • Caching and state layers — Redis, DynamoDB KV stores with per-org/per-bot scoping, batch read optimization, and hot-reload configuration
  • Tool and agent connectivity for LLMs: Build MCP and agent-to-agent (A2A) capabilities, including tool discovery, namespacing, and tool selection over large tool catalogs, so the LLM picks and calls the right tool from thousands of candidates.
  • Token efficiency and context engineering — Lower the agent's cost and latency through prompt and context discipline, caching, speculative and parallel model-call scheduling, and reducing tokens spent across multi-step LLM reasoning chains.
  • Open-weights model adoption and evaluation — Quickly stand up newly released open-weights LLMs at different quantization levels, run them in a test environment, and benchmark their accuracy, latency and cost on agent tasks. Use the results to decide which models reach production.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

You should have deep experience in at least 3 of these areas:

  • Distributed systems: consistency models, idempotency, exactly-once delivery, distributed locking/leasing
  • Concurrent/async programming: Python asyncio, Go goroutines, structured concurrency, cancellation handling
  • Event-driven architectures: message queues (SQS, Kafka), pub/sub, backpressure, delivery guarantees
  • Database systems for infrastructure: DynamoDB (conditional writes, transactions), Redis (connection pooling, pub/sub)
  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, span context propagation, Prometheus metrics
  • gRPC/protobuf: streaming RPCs, service interface design, error handling patterns
  • Machine learning: Large language models, natural language processing, LLM evaluation



Required:

  • 5+ years building production backend/infrastructure systems
  • Strong in Python or Go (ideally both)
  • Experience designing and operating systems that handle real traffic at scale
  • Hands-on experience building production systems that use LLMs or other ML models
  • Comfort with ambiguity — these are novel problems without textbook solutions



Relevant past experience:

  • Building and shipping products on large language models with techniques such as RAG, chain-of-thought, self-reflection, tool and function calling, and agentic reasoning.
  • Training, fine-tuning, or evaluating machine learning models on large datasets in production, especially for NLP, retrieval, or ranking.
  • Improving relevance or quality through careful experimentation: designing metrics, building evaluation datasets, and developing new features and signals for ranking or model selection.
  • Research or applied work in machine learning, LLMs, agentic systems, information retrieval, or ranking and relevance.

Job Description

Position overview:

A Regional Product Manager (RPM) connects global product strategy to execution in a specific market. Product managers build features and own the core roadmap with engineering teams. An RPM takes that roadmap into one market, adapts it to local customers, regulations, and buying patterns, and owns its commercial success there. At ServiceNow, RPM markets are defined by geography, industry, or customer segment. 

In this role, you will own one industry or customer segment in the CANADA and LATAM region. You will be the person responsible for how ServiceNow's AI products are positioned, sold, adopted, and improved in that market. This is an individual contributor (IC) role, reporting to the leader of Regional Product Management for the Americas. 

Key responsibilities:

Regional strategy and adaptation 

  • Translate the global AI product roadmap into a plan for your industry or segment 
  • Tailor use cases, solution packages, and messaging to the operational problems your customers care about most 
  • Account for industry regulations and compliance requirements in how solutions are positioned and deployed 
  • Track AI adoption trends in your market and adjust priorities as they shift 

Go-to-market and sales enablement 

  • Partner with sales, marketing, and channel partners to launch AI products into your market 
  • Run discovery on priority deals and shape buying criteria and deal sizing toward AI early in the sales cycle 
  • Build discovery guides, use case catalogs, demo stories, and value stories that sellers can reuse 
  • Make sure AI use cases go live after every win, working with customer success, professional services, and partners on success criteria, go-live dates, and adoption metrics 

Commercial strategy and financial targets

  • Set and own quarterly targets for deals in motion, AI attach, and discovery completed before close 
  • Work with pricing teams on packaging and discount guidance suited to your customers 

Voice of the customer

  • Gather customer feedback and turn repeated needs into solution requirements for product teams 
  • Test emerging AI ideas with customers and bring the ones with traction to the teams that build new products 
  • Represent ServiceNow with customer executives, at industry events, and in customer advisory sessions 

Competitive intelligence 

  • Monitor competitors selling AI into your market, including industry-specific vendors and horizontal AI platforms 
  • Analyze win/loss data to find patterns in why deals are won, lost, or stalled 
  • Equip sales teams with positioning and responses to competitor claims 

Qualifications

To excel as a Regional Product Manager (RPM), you need a unique blend of commercial acumen, cross-cultural leadership, and technical credibility. Because you sit between global development teams and local sales teams, your skillset must balance strategic thinking with ground-level execution. 

Commercial and strategic skills 

  • You design and run launch plans suited to how your market buys, including the partners, procurement processes, and executives involved 
  • You can set packaging and discount guidance and judge how deal structure affects margin 
  • You turn regulatory and compliance requirements into specific changes in how solutions are built, positioned, and deployed 

Relationship and communication skills 

  • You align product teams and field sellers on priorities without direct authority over either 
  • You understand how business and IT leaders in your market make decisions, and you adjust how you communicate with each 
  • You manage expectations with senior product and sales leaders while supporting account teams on high-stakes customer deals 

Analytical and technical skills 

  • You use sales data, win/loss results, and market share trends to decide where to focus 
  • You know enterprise AI and platform technology well enough to handle complex objections and train sellers 
  • You turn large volumes of customer feedback into a short, ranked list of requirements product teams can act on 

Experience 

  • 10+ years in product management, solution consulting, or go-to-market strategy in enterprise software 
  • Domain depth in at least one industry or customer segment, including its core systems, regulations, and buyers

Job Description

Our AI products rely on sensitive data to enable customers to get work done. With this in mind, privacy is a crucial part of ensuring that data is handled properly throughout the workflow, from what we collect and how we use it to the controls we apply across models, tools, logs and data pipelines. In this role, you will be a key privacy engineer, writing code and shaping the architecture and protections across our products. You will improve sensitive data detection and masking, assess the privacy risks of ML models, and own the implementation of customer data-use and retention controls. You will work with our Privacy, ML, Security, Product and Infrastructure teams from design through production.

This is a Senior Staff individual contributor role. You will be hands on, setting technical direction across teams and writing production code.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Assess, benchmark and select ML models and techniques that meet our privacy requirements. Build representative evaluation datasets and compare detection coverage, false positives, latency, cost and the impact on product quality.

  • Own the implementation of those models in our products, from prototype through production. Train or fine-tune where needed, build the surrounding services and APIs, and optimize inference performance and reliability.

  • Build and deploy sensitive data detection, masking, redaction and tokenization for structured and unstructured data across logs, traces, APIs, analytics and annotation tools. Implement consistent controls for when data is masked and who can access the unmasked content.

  • Build privacy evaluations for ML models and the systems around them, including memorization, training-data extraction, membership inference and sensitive data disclosure through retrieval or tool use. Implement mitigations and add regression tests to model and product release workflows.

  • Write and maintain code that enforces customer requirements for data use, access, retention and deletion across services and data stores, including the distinction between permitted inference, evaluation, annotation and training.

  • Prototype and implement privacy-preserving approaches to evaluation and synthetic data. Measure privacy risk and utility, validate the assumptions behind the approach, and integrate suitable solutions into our ML pipelines.

  • Conduct privacy design reviews with engineering, identify gaps in proposed data flows and architectures, and own or partner on the code changes needed to address them. Build reusable components and engineering standards that help teams apply these protections consistently.

  • Monitor privacy controls and models in production, investigate failures, and ship improvements. Use error analysis and production feedback to improve detection quality, address regressions and close customer-reported privacy issues.

What success looks like in your first year:

  • ML models selected and deployed for priority privacy use cases, with measured improvements in detection quality and acceptable production latency and cost.

  • Shared masking and data protection components integrated into the highest-priority product surfaces, with automated tests for coverage and access behavior.

  • Repeatable privacy evaluations running as part of model and product releases, with findings translated into shipped fixes.

  • Priority data-use, retention and deletion requirements implemented and verified in production, with monitoring that identifies failures.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Typically 7+ or more years building production software, including substantial experience in privacy engineering and applied ML.

  • Strong Python skills and experience with Go, Java, C++ or another production systems language. You have shipped, tested and operated production software.

  • Hands-on experience evaluating, selecting and deploying ML models, including dataset curation, model adaptation or fine-tuning, error analysis and model serving.

  • Experience building sensitive data detection and masking systems, including their accuracy, performance and integration tradeoffs.

  • Experience assessing privacy risks in ML and LLM systems and implementing mitigations. You can explain what your tests establish and where uncertainty remains.

  • Deep understanding of data minimization, pseudonymization, anonymization and re-identification risk, including the limits of removing direct identifiers.

  • Experience building data protection and lifecycle controls in distributed cloud systems.

  • A record of taking ambiguous engineering problems from design through delivery, setting technical direction across teams and mentoring engineers.

Preferred experience:

  • Applying differential privacy or other privacy-enhancing technologies, including evaluating their assumptions and privacy-utility tradeoffs.

  • Privacy engineering for agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings or synthetic datasets.

  • Experience in enterprise, multi-tenant or regulated environments, and translating privacy requirements such as GDPR and CCPA into technical controls.

Job Description

Internship Program Overview   

At ServiceNow, we’re looking for students who want to learn, grow, and take a giant step early in their careers, all while making a giant impact. We offer 12-week summer internship opportunities across various business functions.    

Interns will participate in executive speaker series, career development workshops, philanthropic efforts, and team-building activities. Additionally, interns will have access to online learnings and a dedicated summer coach to further grow their careers with us.   

If you want to make work, work better, we want you. To learn more, check out our Early Career Page!   

Product Team Overview 

We are looking for full-time MBA students to join our Product Management team at ServiceNow. As a Product Manager, you will work on complex high-tech problems by undertaking research, designing, and executing analysis, and helping frame and structure complex problems. You will work closely with other team members and stakeholders to accelerate our impact and directly contribute to our overall business strategy. This is an excellent opportunity if you are looking to get a taste of product management at a high-growth enterprise software company!      

Product Management is a team sport at ServiceNow. We have a unique organization structure in which multiple Product Management roles work together to contribute to a product’s success.   
  
We have two types of Product Managers within our teams: Inbound and Outbound  

For the application: If you’re interested in both Inbound and Outbound Product Manager roles, please apply to your top choice only. Your application will automatically be considered for both roles. You are welcome to include your thoughts during the hiring manager notes. 

For context: Inbound Product Managers plan for and develop new products and future releases of a product. They gather feedback to determine the problems we're trying to solve, then generate a product roadmap. They work with various teams such as release management, design, and engineering development.  

For this role: Outbound Product Managers enable Go-To-Market teams on product innovation and evangelize the product with customers and partners. Considered the product experts, they generally serve as the bridge between the inbound PM and the product marketing team to ensure the product gets to our customers.   

A few key responsibilities of Outbound PMs include:   

  • Enable our go to market partners  

  • Define pricing & packaging (in collaboration with our pricing team)  

  • Provide best practice content and guidance  

  • Package and deliver in-depth competitive analysis for go to market partners  

  • Drive customer usage and adoption programs  

  • Occasionally provide onboarding and renewal help  

Additional possible responsibilities include: 

  • Support senior program managers and/or product managers across the entire project lifecycle to deliver critical programs for Service Now initiatives.   

  • Work and collaborate directly with Product Managers, Product Design, & Development Teams to build new features and improve adoption on existing features.  

  • Build familiarity with scrum process and willingness to contribute to team deliverables.  

  • Understand product strategy that sets us up for success as we look to grow to $15B+ in revenue. 

  • Research and collect product requirements from key buyer audiences and end-users to determine areas of opportunity for product enhancements. 

  • Oversee the product or project timeline, deadlines, milestones as it is being built by development/engineering and communicate with stakeholders to keep them updated.  

  • Contribute to the complete product lifecycle, from researching market needs and competition, analyzing customer data, writing product requirements, and delivering product features to market. 

  • Understand the technical and business impacts of product decisions that inform tradeoff decisions to optimize against product delivery and customer value.  

Qualifications

Internship location may vary based on team growth strategies.

Required Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled full-time at an accredited university pursuing an MBA in Engineering, Business Management, Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Applied Sciences, or a related field.
  • Graduating May 2028 or later.
  • Available to work full-time for a 12-week summer internship.
  • 3–6 years of related experience.
  • Experience using or evaluating AI to improve workflows, decision-making, problem-solving, automation, or data-driven insights.
  • Experience defining product requirements and translating them into a product roadmap.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to balance customer desirability, business viability, and technical feasibility.
  • Strong prioritization, problem-solving, and analytical skills, with a data-driven and hypothesis-led approach.
  • Deep curiosity about customer needs and a passion for building relationships and delivering high-value solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).

title: CRMソリューションコンサルタント
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

ServiceNowは「ビジネス変革のためのAIコントロールタワー」として、あらゆるAI、あらゆるデータ、あらゆるワークフローをひとつにつなぐ「ServiceNow AIプラットフォーム」を提供し、Fortune 500企業の85%が、より賢く、より速く、より良く働くことを支援しています。すべては、エンジニアのフレッド・ラディが、同僚の面倒な作業を自動化するコードを書いたことから始まりました。この同僚は感激のあまり涙を流したといいます。この出来事をきっかけに、フレッドは「すべての人を煩雑な業務から解放し、意義のある仕事に集中できるようにする」会社をつくることを決意しました。 

私たちは、テクノロジーと人の力がともに発揮される「AIネイティブ」なカルチャーを築いており、その挑戦はまだ始まったばかりです。 AIを人のために活かす未来を、私たちと一緒に創りませんか。 

Job Description

ServiceNowのCRMは、問い合わせを記録するだけのCRMではありません。フロントからバックオフィスまでをひとつのプラットフォームとワークフローでつなぎ、問い合わせを最後まで解決するCRMです。AIが答えるだけでなく、実際に業務を動かして解決する。この点がAI時代のCRMに欠かせない条件だと、私たちは考えています。 

日本でも、幅広い業界の大企業で、顧客接点を担うミッションクリティカルなDXプロジェクトへの採用が続いています。この成長に合わせて、CRM Japanではソリューションコンサルタントを複数名、純増で採用します。 

ソリューションコンサルタントは、営業チームの一員としてお客様の課題を深く理解し、ServiceNowだからこそ実現できる価値を、提案とデモで形にする役割です。新しいことを素早く吸収し、自ら考えて動けるスタートアップのようなマインドを持つ方を歓迎します。 

この役割で担っていただくこと： 

  • CRMセールスエクゼクティブと一緒に案件の戦略を立て、ServiceNow CRMを選んでいただくための提案とデモをリードします 
  • お客様の課題に合わせて、ServiceNowならではの価値を、説得力のあるストーリーで伝えます 
  • CRMセールスエクゼクティブがCRMの価値を提案できるよう、社内のイネーブルメントを企画・支援します 
  • カスタマーサービス領域とソリューションのエキスパートとして、社内外で専門性を発揮します 
  • CRMの製品領域の拡大に合わせて、専門性の幅を広げていきます 
  • プロダクトマネジメントや開発チームと連携し、お客様のニーズを製品の強化につなげます 
  • 提案のノウハウや成功事例をチームで共有し、チーム全体の提案力を高めます 
  • 競合や市場のトレンドを常に把握し、提案に活かします 
  • 事業部門と情報システム部門、両方の意思決定者と対話します 
  • ユーザーカンファレンス、展示会、アナリスト向けデモ、ウェビナーなどのマーケティング活動を支援します 

Qualifications

この役割で成功するために必要なこと： 

  • 営業部門やカスタマーサービス部門が抱える課題とニーズへの深い理解 
  • CRMソリューション（Salesforce、Pega、Zendeskなど）でのソリューションコンサルティング経験が7年以上、またはServiceNowプラットフォームでの同等の経験 
  • お客様にとって重要な価値を見極め、印象に残る形で伝えられるプリセールススキル 
  • 自社ソリューションの魅力を、社内にも積極的に発信していく意欲 
  • 経営層、事業部門、技術部門のキーパーソンから信頼を得られる力 
  • 細かな指示がなくても、自分で仕事を進めて最後までやり遂げる力 
  • ServiceNowプラットフォームの知識、またはWeb技術の専門知識。新しい技術を素早く習得できること 
  • プロダクトマネジメント、プロダクトマーケティング、開発チームと連携して仕事を進めた経験 
  • ServiceNowの価値と競合との違いを、見込み顧客に分かりやすく伝えられること 
  • 高い熱意と行動力。頻繁な出張に対応できること（最大50%の国内出張の可能性があります） 
  • 柔軟な発想で課題を解決できる力 

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity,  veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

title: Solution Architect
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

A solution architect designs and validates how specific ServiceNow solutions will meet the customer’s business and industry requirements. The SA brings deep product and industry knowledge and translates the EA’s enterprise direction into workable solution designs for priority use cases.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Own solution design for key ServiceNow solutions, such as SecOps, TechOps, AI Control Tower, and Employee Works with HRSD or S2P within the customer’s enterprise architecture
  • Run technical discovery, solution workshops, and proof-of-value engagements, and produce solution architecture documents, integration designs, and reference architectures.
  • Validate technical feasibility, scalability, security, and data design with customer architects and engineering teams.
  • Align the ServiceNow platform strategy with the customer’s wider technology estate, including ERP, cloud, data platforms, and third-party AI.
  • Feed field learnings, customer patterns, and reusable assets back to the EA and product teams.

Working relationships:

  • Solution Consultants (SCs): Partner with SCs to shape the enterprise architecture narrative in pursuits, validate target-state recommendations, and align solution scope with the account strategy. The EA provides architectural direction and governance; the SC leads day-to-day solution positioning.
  • Specialists: Engage product and industry specialists to validate platform capabilities, roadmap alignment, and emerging AI and workflow offerings before they are included in target-state designs.
  • Account Sales Executives (AEs): Work with AEs to identify architecture-led opportunities, plan executive engagements, and sequence architecture decisions against deal timelines and buying cycles.
  • Customer stakeholders: Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, enterprise architects, and business sponsors. Facilitate design authority sessions, executive briefings, and architecture workshops that lead to shared decisions.

Industry focus: Each SA aligns to one or more priority industries(FSI, Telco, Public Sector) in Asia, building deep vertical expertise and reusable industry solution patterns.

Qualifications

 To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 7 or more years in solution architecture, technical solution consulting, or implementation delivery, with hands-on experience on enterprise ServiceNow or comparable workflow platforms/solutions
  • Experience designing solutions for at least one priority industry(FSI, Telco, Public sector), with a track record of reusable industry patterns or accelerators
  • Background in pre-sales or technical roles, including pursuit support, technical validation, and proof-of-value delivery
  • Certifications such as ServiceNow Certified Application Developer, Certified System Administrator, or Certified Implementation Specialist, where applicable, plus relevant cloud or integration credentials
  • Experience working across Asia markets, with the ability to engage both regional and local customer teams
  • Deep product expertise across the ServiceNow portfolio, including workflow automation, AI, and platform capabilities
  • Solution design, integration architecture, and API-based integration patterns
  • Industry business process knowledge in one or more priority verticals
  • Technical discovery, solution workshops, and requirements translation
  • Proof-of-value design, delivery oversight, and success measurement
  • Demo and presentation skills for technical and business audiences
  • Competitive positioning and technical objection handling

title: Senior Research Scientist, Agent Evaluation
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Job Description

We build the evaluation layer that validates AI agents before they reach customers — an automated system that scores across large volumes of agent traces.
You'll own core parts of that platform: the pipeline that runs traces through model-based judges at scale, and the scoring logic that turns raw output into results teams can act on.

What you'll do

  • Design evaluation methodologies and benchmarks for agent reasoning, planning, tool use, reliability, and safety — across LLM-as-a-Judge, trajectory-based, and human evaluation
  • Take problems from research question to prototype to shipped feature, owning them end to end
  • Build and harden the pipelines and scoring logic behind customer-facing evaluation
  • Curate synthetic and real-world datasets; measure the evaluator itself for consistency and agreement with human labels

Qualifications

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in ML, applied AI,  prompt engineering, agentic AI, including shipping something real to users
  • Strong Python skills
  • Practical depth in agentic AI and context engineering: planning, reasoning, memory, tool use, retrieval, long-context
  • Experience designing evaluation methodologies, not just running evaluations
  • Hands-on production work with LLM APIs — prompt engineering, structured output, cost and latency tradeoffs
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences
  • Good to have Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude code, Windsurf, or similar)

CRMセールスエグゼクティブは、ServiceNowのCRMの市場での成功を牽引する営業職です。これらの製品は、ServiceNow AI Platform上に構築された営業管理、CPQ、オーダー管理、カスタマーサービス管理、フィールドサービス管理といった広範な業務機能を有しています。「CRM built to finish the work」というスローガンのもと、AIネイティブで、あらゆる顧客の要望や問い合わせを「解決」することができる、強力なワークフロー製品群です。
担当アカウントおよび/またはテリトリーにおける四半期・年間の売上目標の達成に向けて、以下の業務を担当いただきます。 

  • 担当テリトリーにおける営業戦略の策定(ターゲット企業リストの作成、営業計画の立案を含む) 
  • 経営層・CxOとのエグゼクティブミーティングの設定・実施。ソリューションコンサルタントおよび関連チームと緊密に連携し、ServiceNowのCRMソリューションを示すデモンストレーションを提供 
  • お客様の現在および将来のCX/営業・サービス変革のロードマップを深く理解し、信頼されるアドバイザーとしてServiceNowプラットフォームの活用を推進 
  • コアセールスチーム(アカウントエグゼクティブ、ソリューションコンサルタント、リーダーシップ)および他のソリューションエリアと緊密に連携し、お客様や見込み顧客にCRMのソリューションを提供 
  • 担当アカウントエグゼクティブおよびソリューションコンサルタントと協力し、CRM ソリューションの提案を、見込み顧客、既存のお客様、パートナー、業界イベントやセミナーで直接実施
  • 担当テリトリーのServiceNowパートナーチャネルを支援し、お客様にとって最適な体験を実現 
  • カスタマーサクセスのための戦略を顧客担当チームに共有し、プラットフォームのプレゼンテーションやバリュープロポジションの標準化・効率化を推進 
  • セールスおよびパートナーエコシステム向けのセールスイネーブルメント 
  • インサイドセールスからの支援が限られた環境での、見込み顧客の選定と新規商談・継続的な収益源の創出

descriptionHtml:

Armis from ServiceNow, protects the entire attack surface and manages an organization’s cyber risk exposure in real time. Combined with ServiceNow’s Security and Risk capabilities, as well as Identity Security capabilities from Veza, we bring together all critical capabilities to secure every asset, every identity - incl. AI Agents - across all environments with the right level of context - security, operational and business - to build the first of its kind autonomous defense platform for the Agentic Enterprise.

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join the AppSec engineering team in Armis R&D. 

The team builds Armis Centrix for Application Security, an AI-native AppSec product built from the ground up over the past year and now growing into a core product line. You get the best of both worlds: a small, autonomous team that owns its product end to end, backed by the data, expertise, and stability of Armis and ServiceNow engineering. If you love taking a product from its first customers to enterprise scale, own outcomes end to end, and raise the bar for the people around you, this is for you. 

What You'll Do 

  • Own Your Area: Take complex, open-ended problems from design through production, hands-on in architecture, design, and the critical paths of the codebase, with the accountability that comes with it. 
  • Build Agentic AppSec: Design and build LLM-based agents and pipelines that analyze real-world codebases at scale: orchestration, tool use, context engineering, and the deterministic components that do what models shouldn't. 
  • Make AI Trustworthy: Practice evaluation-driven development: the evaluation harness, golden datasets, regression gates in CI, and cost and latency tracking, so every pipeline change is measured before it ships. 
  • Own the Backend & AI Architecture: Design robust, multi-tenant microservice cloud environments with security by design as the default. 
  • Deliver on Commitments: Design, estimate, and deliver your work as clear, estimated tasks you own end to end. 
  • Raise the Bar: Review designs and code, mentor engineers around you, and help set the team's engineering standards. 
  • Engage Beyond the Code: Work directly with product, customers, support, and R&D architecture to gather real-world insight, unblock fast, and align technical direction with the business. 
  • Collaborate Globally: Work closely with engineers and stakeholders across Israel, North America, and India. 

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of deep backend/systems experience, strong Python, and real production experience in a multi-tenant microservice cloud environment. 

  • Strong advantage: hands-on experience building LLM-based agents or agentic pipelines in production, and evaluating them: golden datasets, benchmark, regression gates, cost and latency at scale. 

  • A track record of owning outcomes end to end, including a commitment that went wrong and what you did about it. 

  • A security engineering mindset: tenant isolation, access control, and secure design are non-negotiable to you. 

  •  An All-Around Player: independent, execution-focused, and happy to build whatever it takes. 

Excellent English for working effectively across time zones.

descriptionHtml:

Job Description

  • Independently lead a major workstream in agent learning and recursive self-improvement.
  • Design and execute end-to-end research projects that improve long-horizon enterprise agents across planning, reasoning, memory, tool use, retrieval, computer use, multi-agent coordination, and verification. 
  • Research model post-training methods such as continued pretraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), RL, DPO/GRPO, reward modeling, and distillation. 
  • Research harness-level optimization across prompts and task framing, tool and schema design, skills, MCP-backed providers, subagents, context and memory management, agent-loop policy, and reliable verifiers. 
  • Build improvement flywheels that mine trajectories and production-safe signals, identify recurring failure modes, generate or curate data, propose interventions, and measure generalization before promotion. 
  • Create realistic, stateful training environments and benchmarks for enterprise workflows, with programmatic verifiers and calibrated human or model-based graders where deterministic grading is not possible. 
  • Run rigorous ablations and scaling experiments; reason explicitly about variance, contamination, reward hacking, distribution shift, cross-model transfer, cost, and latency. 
  • Develop capabilities across one or more modalities - language, documents, images/video, and speech/audio - and across multilingual or cross-lingual settings. 
  • Build reproducible distributed pipelines for training, rollout generation, evaluation, and inference; profile and resolve bottlenecks that only appear at scale. 
  • Partner with other researchers, engineering, and product teams to move validated methods into reliable enterprise systems. 
  • Communicate results through research reviews, technical reports, publications, patents, open-source contributions, and decision-ready recommendations

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of relevant ML/AI research or engineering experience, or equivalent evidence of research depth and impact. A PhD or other advanced degree is required. 
  • A track record of independently taking ambiguous research questions from hypothesis through implementation, experiment, analysis, and measurable outcome. 
  • Research and production experience in multimodal, document AI, computer vision, speech/audio, multilingual, or cross-lingual modeling. 
  • Experience with enterprise agents, stateful workflows, browser/computer use, MCP or similar tool protocols, simulation environments. 
  • Experience with synthetic data, model-generated feedback, proposer/critic/verifier systems, automated experimentation, or evolutionary/search-based optimization. 
  • Experience operating GPU clusters and experiment platforms using Ray, Kubernetes, Slurm, cloud accelerators, or comparable systems. 
  • Evidence of research impact through shipped capabilities, high-quality publications, patents, benchmarks, or substantive open-source contributions.  Publications at top-tier venues (ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, EMNLP, AAAI).

Together, we identify high-value opportunities, accelerate business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that advance the Now AI Platform. 

Our mission: We partner deeply with our customers to build intelligent, scalable AI solutions that solve their most mission-critical challenges. By embedding in real-world complexity, we deliver fast, iterate with purpose, and transform every success into reusable patterns that accelerate transformation across the Now Platform and the broader enterprise. 

Why This Role Matters:

Enterprises are raising the bar. AI initiatives must deliver business value—not just promise potential. That means taking cutting-edge LLM capabilities and turning them into resilient, secure, and scalable software. 

As a Forward Deployed Solution Engineer (FDSE), you act as the CTO of the build—owning everything from backend services to LLM pipelines and front-end integrations. You partner with customers in the field to design, implement, and deliver solution-ready builds in agile sprints. Your software becomes the reference implementation for scalable GenAI in the enterprise. You codify patterns, shape internal tooling, and accelerate innovation—delivering systems that are battle-tested in production and scalable across industries. 

Who You Are:

You are a systems-minded, AI-native engineer who ships real software. You own the full stack—and are equally motivated by elegant APIs, intuitive UIs, and scalable orchestration pipelines. You think like a product-minded CTO, balancing creativity with pragmatism to deliver impact. 

You embed deeply with customer teams, diagnose root problems, and architect AI-powered workflows that run at scale. You don’t just debug code—you debug systems, context, and customer pain points. 

You will: 

  • Build solution-ready LLM-enabled applications that span backend logic, data orchestration, and front-end UI 
  • Operate in the field, working side-by-side with customers to adapt, deploy, and iterate in live environments 
  • Codify reusable assets—libraries, prompts, scaffolds—to accelerate future engagements 
  • Shape developer experience by sharing feedback with platform and product teams  

What You’ll Do: 

  • Deliver Production - ready solution in agile end-to-end sprints
  • Engineer with versatility: APIs, orchestration pipelines, vector DBs, LLM frameworks, UI components 
  • Operate with agility: integrate with legacy systems, navigate ambiguity, ship safely at speed 
  • Codify patterns: build scaffolds, SDKs, and documentation to scale success across customers 
  • Influence platform: inform product strategy through field-tested insights and extensible code 

What Success Looks Like:

  • Production-grade delivery: Your solution builds consistently convert to scaled deployments in production environments 
  • Reusable impact: You author libraries, prompts, and scaffolds that power multiple deployments and projects 
  • Platform influence: Your work shapes internal tooling and is integrated into platform roadmap and primitives 
  • Velocity and precision: You move fast without breaking things—shaping resilient, secure systems in high-stakes contexts 
  • Engineering leadership: You are trusted by architects, PMs, and customer teams to lead implementation from zero to one 

Qualifications

What You Bring:

  • Experience: In leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry
  • Relevant Experience: 10+ years of software engineering, including 2+ years building systems in customer-facing or embedded roles 
  • System architecture: Proven ability to design and implement AI-native software in production environments 
  • Engineering depth: Strength in backend (Python, Node.js, Java), frontend (React, Angular), APIs (REST/GraphQL) 
  • Machine Learning: Foundations of MLflow, Weights & Biases, LoRA, PEFT, SageMaker, Vertex AI, AzureML, Kubeflow, Airflow, Prefect, TorchServe, Triton, vLLM, SHAP, LIME, pandas, Spark, SQL
  • LLM tooling: Familiarity with LangChain, Semantic Kernel, prompt chaining, vector search, and context management 
  • Performance & observability: Skilled in debugging distributed systems, tuning for latency, and implementing monitoring 
  • Platform mindset: Can contribute to shared SDKs and tools, raising engineering velocity for the whole org 
  • Product sensibility: Prioritize for user value, MVP iteration, and long-term scale 
  • DevOps fluency: Experience deploying in AWS, Azure, or GCP with CI/CD, containers, and infra-as-code 
  • Field readiness: Able to travel up to 30% to embed onsite and deliver where it matters

title: Business Development Representative
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

We’re looking for a motivated, and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join ServiceNow’s Global Business Acceleration team.  

As a BDR, you’ll play a critical role in driving pipeline growth by identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers. Through strategic outreach, inbound lead follow-up and engagement with prospects from marketing campaigns, you’ll help connect organizations with solutions that address their business challenges.  

In this role, you’ll engage prospective customers, uncover business needs, assess interest using established qualification criteria, and collaborate with Account Executives to advance qualified opportunities. You’ll develop foundational skills in communication, prospecting, and relationship building.  

Whether you're launching your career or bringing experience from another industry, GBA is more than your first role at ServiceNow. It's an opportunity to discover your potential, accelerate your growth, and build a career with a company shaping the future of work. 

What you get to do in this role: 

  • Generate new business pipeline through a combination of outbound prospecting, inbound lead qualification, and follow-up on marketing campaigns and events.  

  • Engage current and prospective customers through phone, email, and social—and connect with key contacts using approved messaging and defined qualification criteria. 

  • Research companies, industries, and business challenges to identify opportunities where ServiceNow can deliver value.  

  • Apply basic problem-solving techniques to assess client needs and determine appropriate next steps based on defined criteria. 

  • Qualify opportunities and partner with account executives to build strong sales pipeline.  

  • Take ownership of individual performance goals, embrace coaching and feedback, and contribute to a collaborative, high-performing sales culture. 

What you gain from this role: 

  • An immersive four-week new hire training program designed to build your sales skills, confidence, and knowledge of the ServiceNow platform.  

  • A collaborative global community that celebrates successes, encourages innovation, and invests in your future.  

  • A strong foundation in technology sales, with real-world experience and ongoing development opportunities to help shape your career at ServiceNow.  

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have: 

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent required 

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to engage professionally and confidently with customers and internal stakeholders.  

  • Demonstrate initiative, curiosity, and a results-oriented mindset, with a willingness to take ownership of goals and responsibilities. 

  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.  

  • Resilience, adaptability, and growth mindset.  

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.  

  • Willingness to learn AI-native tools and innovate on how they’re used to enhance outreach, prioritization, and daily workflows. 

  • A basic understanding of cloud computing and SaaS concepts, or the willingness to learn quickly. 

  • Ability to participate in development simulations, in-person messaging activities, and meet defined performance and metrics expectations. 

  •  Commitment to full participation in Global Business Acceleration development tracks to launch an enduring career at ServiceNow within 48 months.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Team bio 

ServiceNow’s Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team is where bold ideas meet real-world impact. We work with our most strategic customers to shape the future of enterprise AI. We find high-value opportunities, speed up business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that make the ServiceNow AI Platform even better. 

Why this internship matters 

Enterprises want AI that delivers real value, not just potential. Our Associate FDEs turn the latest LLM capabilities into secure, scalable software that customers rely on. As an Associate FDE Intern, you’ll learn how that happens by doing it. You’ll join a live delivery team, build real features, and see how great engineers take an idea from whiteboard to working solution. 

Who you are 

You’re a curious, hands-on builder who likes making things work. You’ve experimented with LLMs, APIs, or AI tools in class projects, hackathons, or on your own time. You enjoy solving messy problems, you ask good questions, and you want to understand why something matters to the people using it, not just how it works. 

Location: Expectations to be hybrid in office - either Santa Clara, CA or New York, NY

What you’ll do 

  • Build and test components of LLM-enabled applications, including backend services, data pipelines, prompts, and UI elements, under the guidance of senior FDSEs 

  • Join customer working sessions to see how FDEs uncover problems, scope solutions, and iterate quickly 

  • Help create reusable assets such as code samples, prompt libraries, scaffolds, and documentation that speed up future projects 

  • Prototype and evaluate new AI techniques (retrieval, agents, prompt chaining) and share what you learn with the team 

  • Work in agile sprints, with code reviews, stand-ups, and demos

  • Identify opportunities to streamline and automate recurring processes, improving efficiency and scalability for a growing global organization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or above.

  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytics and visualization tools, or strong analytical skills (such as advanced Excel or SQL) and a desire to build on them. Power BI experience is preferred.

Company Description

Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce.

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.

Moveworks is trusted by over 5.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Come join us!
