Job Description

Many companies are deciding right now how AI agents will work with their customers and service teams. These decisions will shape their customer experience for years — and in this role, you help Germany's largest enterprises make them well. 

As an Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI for the German market, you are the senior technical advisor in our most strategic CRM opportunities across Customer Service, Field Service and Sales & Order Management. You lead the solution strategy of large, complex and highly visible accounts together with the Account Executive, earn the trust of C-level stakeholders, and prove value with Agentic AI on the customer's own data rather than on slides. 

You join a team of CRM specialists from Retail, Telco, Financial Services and Tech who learn a lot from each other — and you help shape how the market sees Agentic AI in CRM. 

The Embedded Approach 

The Advisory Solution Consultant wins on proof, not presentation. Demos are minimal and purposeful. The center of gravity is a focused Proof of Value (POV): rigorous Discovery isolates the one problem worth solving, an Agentic workflow is built on a slice of the customer's data, and the outcome becomes a quantified business case for executive decision-makers. 

What You'll Do 

As an Advisory Solution Consultant, you lead the technical and value strategy in strategic CRM accounts — using your technical depth, Agentic AI expertise and business acumen to turn proven outcomes into executive decisions, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. 

Key responsibilities include: 

  • Lead the technical and solution strategy of strategic CRM accounts together with the Account Executive, owning customer meetings and account activities that move the opportunity forward. 
  • Act as trusted advisor to C-level stakeholders such as CCOs, COOs and Heads of Customer Service. 
  • Run rigorous Discovery to isolate the one high-value problem worth solving before any product is shown. 
  • Scope and secure a POV with executive sponsorship, then build it hands-on with our Agentic workflow capabilities on the customer's data. 
  • Build and refine ROI and business cases that turn POV results into a clear path from one proven use case to enterprise-wide adoption. 
  • Coordinate Solution Consultants, specialists, value consultants and partners in complex pursuits. 
  • Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. 
  • Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. 
  • Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks and Agentic AI patterns that scale across the team. 
  • Represent ServiceNow as a credible voice for Agentic AI in CRM at executive events, customer roundtables and our Munich Innovation Center. 

Qualifications

What We're Looking For 

To succeed in this role, you should bring: 

  • Strategic Account Leadership: You lead complex enterprise opportunities and earn executive sponsorship for data-driven engagements. 
  • Agentic & AI Fluency: Deep, practical experience applying AI and Agentic workflows to real business problems — you have built it, not just presented it. 
  • Builder Mindset: A builder's instinct — comfortable getting hands-on with a customer's data and environment to prove value directly. 
  • Discovery Rigor: Exceptional discovery skills to quickly isolate the one problem worth solving and secure customer commitment. 
  • Business Value: You build business cases and translate technical results into clear value stories for senior stakeholders. 
  • CRM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in CRM and customer experience across service, field service, sales, lead & opportunity management. 
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams spanning Sales, Product, partners and delivery. 

Qualifications 

  • 8+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience for CRM/CX solutions, at a software vendor or a leading consultancy. 
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, strategic enterprise opportunities with C-level stakeholders. 
  • Hands-on experience applying AI and Agentic workflow capabilities to solve business problems — automating workflows, orchestrating AI agents, and analyzing AI-driven outcomes within CRM or adjacent enterprise contexts. 
  • Experience building ROI and business cases for enterprise decision-makers. 
  • Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or strong technical expertise with comparable cloud CRM solutions. 
  • Experience working collaboratively with product management, product marketing, partners, and professional services.

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) 

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) delivers world-class, innovative security solutions to reduce risk and protect the company and our customers. We enable our customers to migrate their most sensitive data and workloads to the cloud, accelerating our business so that we are the most trusted SaaS provider. We create an environment where our employees are proud to work and can make a positive impact

We employ the brightest and most forward-thinking Security Professionals on the planet. We have offices around the world and work as a global team.  Come join the Office of the CISO and help set the bar for cloud security!

What you get to do in this role:

ServiceNow’s Office of the CISO team leverages its diverse security background and expertise to help enhance ServiceNow’s security and communicate ServiceNow’s security features to the world. The team works closely with various departments in ServiceNow’s security organization and with sales, legal, IT, and product teams on security-related topics. Most importantly, the Office of the CISO team works with prospects, customers, and partners to address questions related to the security of ServiceNow’s cloud-based service. 

This team values integrity, quality, expertise, precision, communication, and efficiency and is looking for a Cloud Security Professional with a broad security background and excellent communication skills.  

You will be a member of the AMS team of the Office of the CISO in English and French-speaking countries.  

As a valued member of our esteemed team, you will assume the pivotal role of a Cloud Security Professional. Your mission encompasses ensuring unwavering support for the Sales Team in both pre- and post-sales endeavors. You will expertly navigate questionnaires and address customer inquiries. Your proactive engagement will extend to driving impactful security meetings with customers and delivering compelling presentations at conferences, both internal and external. 

As a leader in security conversations, you will skillfully rebut cloud and AI technology myths and provide invaluable support during Security Incidents and Investigations. Collaborating seamlessly with internal teams, you will be key in resolving security issues arising from investigations and conducting thorough postmortems to guarantee comprehensive remediation. Should the need arise, you will spearhead structural or design changes, propelling the security posture of our cloud environment and elevating the subscription service to new heights. Your expertise and dedication will be instrumental in safeguarding the integrity and excellence of our cloud security initiatives. 

This role may require access to a Protected B cloud environment. The successful candidate must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Government of Canada Reliability Status under PSPC's Contract Security Program. Clearance is a condition of employment in this function. The company will sponsor and support the screening process through its designated Company Security Officer. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead multifaceted security conversations, primarily focused on Canada Finserv customers and prospects. 
  • Understanding security concerns associated with Artificial Intelligence solution implementations involving Agentic AI and GenAI. 
  • Support ServiceNow’s Sales Teams in Pre- and Post-Sales efforts 
  • Respond to prospect and customer questions related to security. 
  • Conduct security calls with customers  
  • Respond to security questionnaires 
  • Present and evangelize on AI and cloud adoption & assurance. 
  • Contribute to the overall messaging and positioning of the Security Office 
  • Coordinate and manage end-to-end customer cloud security experience. 
  • Active participation in Security Industry forums, communities, and standards organizations 
  • Participation in discussions & presentations with Partners and Customers 
  • Investigate and understand cloud and AI threats. 
  • Escalation point for Security Incidents & investigations 
  • Work with internal teams to resolve security issues arising from investigations and incidents and conduct post mortem’s to ensure issues are properly remediated 
  • Propose & develop structural/design changes to advance the security posture of ServiceNow (Voice of the Customer). 
  • Lead cross-functional teams to accomplish your goals. 
  • Contribute to contract negotiations related to security terms. 

Qualifications

Requirements: 

  • Minimum 8+ years experience in IT & 5 years in Cloud Security Candidate must be eligible to obtain and hold a reliability status in Canada. 
  • Solid understanding of security concerns associated with Artificial Intelligence solution implementations involving Agentic AI and GenAI. 
  • Expertise in Financial Services security and regulations desired. 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills (i.e. strong interpersonal and customer-facing skills) 
  • Experience with Cloud Operations (either as a customer or provider) is required. 
  • Expertise in enterprise cyber defense techniques  
  • Desired Industry Certifications: CISSP, CISM, CSSP, CEH or equivalent 
  • A general understanding of ITIL and ITSM. 
  • Understanding of the sales life cycle. 
  • Expertise in Threat analysis and enterprise cyber defense techniques 
  • Deep understanding of Security Operations. 
  • Ability to articulate complex issues to executives and customers. 
  • Strong interpersonal skills. 
  • Self-motivated and driven; ability to perform and excel with little supervision. 
  • Able to serve as an authoritative source on security.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. Job Description

ServiceNow's legal team runs on ServiceNow. NDAs, procurement contracts, conflict checks, and requests for legal advice all move through our own platform.  

You'll own a portfolio of AI and platform initiatives for our legal technology team within the Global Business Services Experience team. The goal: give attorneys and legal professionals their time back. Fewer routine requests land on their desks. The ones that do get answered faster. And legal data is structured so AI agents can do useful work with it. 

You won't hand requirements to engineering and move on. You'll prototype with AI, prove what works, and partner with our Product organization to turn the best of what we build into features our customers use. This is where we put AI to work for people, starting with our own. 

What you get to do in this role: 

Own the roadmap 

  • Own a multi-quarter roadmap for legal AI and platform initiatives across Contract Management Pro, Legal Service Delivery, and connected systems 
  • Plan each quarter in epics, then deliver through iterative development, testing, and production release 
  • Write epics, user stories, technical spikes, acceptance criteria, and solution approach documents that engineers can build from 
  • Prioritize a busy backlog with clear tradeoffs, and say no when it matters 
  • Lead discovery with legal and business teams, identify opportunities to improve workflows, and translate them into prioritized product requirements and measurable outcomes 

Build AI agents legal teams trust 

  • Design and deliver AI agents for legal work, such as advice and counsel recommendations, contract redlining against our standard terms, request intake and triage, and contract review 
  • Decide how agents retrieve knowledge, when people review their output, and how feedback improves them over time 
  • Use out-of-the-box and Now Assist capabilities first, and build custom only when the platform can't do the job 
  • Build quick prototypes to test AI performance and get stakeholder agreement before committing to a full build 
  • Make sure anything headed to production gets engineering review and hardening 
  • Prove it works 
  • Define evaluation criteria, test sets, and pass thresholds before any AI feature reaches production 
  • Run model and vendor evaluations without locking into a single model or provider 
  • Build and own value models (hours saved, request volume, cycle time) and report AI impact to senior leadership monthly and quarterly 
  • Establish baselines and measure adoption, cycle time, quality, and realized productivity improvements after launch 

Partner across ServiceNow 

  • Partner with our Product organization to co-develop and validate enhancements for potential inclusion in customer-facing platform releases 
  • Bring feedback from our own legal team into product roadmaps 
  • Align Legal, Procurement, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and Digital Technology stakeholders on shared priorities 
  • Work alongside business process managers and engineers in a shared delivery model 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • 5+ years in technical product management, including ownership of a multi-quarter roadmap 
  • Experience with enterprise workflow platforms 
  • Experience shipping generative or agentic AI features, including LLM behavior, retrieval, and prompt design 
  • Experience defining evaluation methods for AI applications, including output quality, groundedness, task completion, and appropriate human review 
  • Experience on agile teams writing epics and user stories that engineers build from 
  • Clear executive communication: you can sum up portfolio status, value, and risk in a few slides 
  • Strong stakeholder management across legal, business, and technical teams 

Preferred 

  • Experience with ServiceNow Contract Management Pro or Legal Service Delivery 
  • Experience with legal, contract, or procurement workflows 
  • Hands-on experience with Now Assist or ServiceNow AI Agents 
  • Experience with other contract lifecycle management or legal AI platforms 
  • Experience co-developing with a product organization or serving as a design partner for a software product

Enterprise Security is hiring a Technical Program Manager to bring delivery discipline to three connected programs: Vulnerability Management, Configuration Management, and Attack Surface Management. You will manage the OKR and epic portfolio, keep priorities current, and make sure committed work is loaded into each engineering team's agile backlog, so delivery dates will hold.

These programs span many teams and stay active for multiple quarters. Dependencies, shifting priorities, and unclear ownership can stall critical work.   • Produce executive-ready status, risk, and progress reporting for the whole portfolio. 
  • Run gate reviews and go/no-go checkpoints for major milestones. 
  • Model team capacity against competing priorities and raise conflicts early. 
  • Build repeatable standards, such as OKR governance and intake and planning templates, that scale across teams. 

Qualifications 

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry. 
  • 12+ years of program or project management experience in software, security, or infrastructure organizations. OR similar experience with education. 
  • A track record of managing multi-team programs with competing priorities and dependencies. 
  • Strong working knowledge of agile delivery, including backlog, epic, and sprint planning in enterprise tools (such as ServiceNow Agile). 
  • Experience managing OKRs and tying delivery to measurable outcomes. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive-level reporting. 
  • The ability to influence and align teams without direct authority. 

Qualifications

  • Familiarity with regulated or government environments, such as FedRAMP and federal directives.

  • Experience with capacity planning and portfolio-level road mapping.

Enterprise leaders aren’t just experimenting with AI—they’re demanding outcomes. As a Strategic Partnerships Technical Program Manager, you operate on the frontlines of transformation. You will support ServiceNow’s cross-functional Strategic Partnership teams in organizational direction and structure, build partnerships, unblock delivery challenges, and ensure scalability. Your leadership accelerates innovation and drives repeatable success across industries. You shape internal tooling, build internal relationships, manage the customer portfolio, and cultivate a culture of excellence and impact.   

Who You Are:  

You are a dynamic and innovative problem-solver who thrives in complex, fast-paced environments. You have a strong analytical mindset while keeping focus on the bigger picture. You have a background managing SDLC processes and a portfolio of projects while keeping a customer-first mentality. You have a passion for AI and scaling innovation. You are curious and knowledgeable on the ecosystem of platforms. You excel at transforming ambiguity into clarity and have hands on experience driving projects/programs end to end.   

What You’ll Do:  

Manage the Partner Build Portfolio

Establish and Maintain Product & Engineering Partnerships + Feedback Loops 

  • Serve as central liaison between Strategic Partnerships, Applied AI FDE, Product, Engineering, Experience (UI/UX) and supporting orgs. 
  • Define and operationalize a structured model for engaging Strategic partnership team and broader APEX org. 
  • Work with Strategic Partnership leaders to translate engagement insights and patterns into actionable product feedback, influencing and tracking engagement to platform innovation progress. 
  • Develop standardized intake templates, RACIs, and collaboration playbooks.  

Drive Build Scale & Repeatability  

  • Capture lessons from early engagements (Phase 0 setup through rollout) and codify best practices. 
  • Implement tools, dashboards, and automation to streamline delivery and accelerate engagement impact and velocity. 
  • Drive process improvements and create documentation to promote best practices using automation to replace repeatable, operational tasks. 

Create Communication, Visibility & Governance Structure  

  • Centralize and manage all Strategic Partnerships documentation, resources, and operational structure. 
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure clarity and execution. 
  • Establish consistent reporting cadence for engagement status, metrics, and risks.  
  • Create executive-ready dashboards and summaries for leadership visibility. 
  • Drive internal storytelling on product adoption, innovation velocity, and customer value. 
  • Reinforce transparency, learning, and disciplined scale across the program. 
  • Seek to continuously grow by proactively seeking and embracing constructive feedback, as well as provide feedback to colleagues to encourage an open and collaborative culture.  

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of portfolio/program management experience in mid/large-size software development companies. 
  • A solid understanding of SDLC and release management practices in cloud-based SaaS product organizations.   
  • Prior work delivering AI or intelligent workflow solutions at scale, with proven success in deploying AI solutions that delivered tangible customer impact. 
  • Familiarity with AI governance, compliance, and enterprise security practices.  
  • Up to 25% travel required (Customer Onsite). 

Preferred Qualifications:  

  • Demonstrated competence in key AI/ML software engineering program management best practices: program planning, schedule construction and management; risk assessment & mitigation, dependency management, change management, and predictive metrics. 
  • Outstanding collaboration and communication skills - clearly communicate changes, requests, and deadlines to the teams and risks, status, progress, and decisions to a variety of audiences including executives. 
  • Passion for working with people in technical and innovative environments, with the ability to work well with many different types of personalities in various functions.

title: Software Engineer, Agentic Systems - Moveworks
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Who we are

Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce. 

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.

Moveworks is trusted by over 5.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award. 

In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Moveworks’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business. 

Come join us!

ServiceNow

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

The Role

We're building the runtime infrastructure that powers Moveworks' AI agents — the systems that orchestrate, execute, and deliver agent responses to millions of enterprise users in real time. This is not an ML role. This is a distributed systems engineering role at the heart of the agentic AI wave.

Our AI agents can plan, execute multi-step workflows, call tools, wait on human input, and resume — all while maintaining correctness, observability, and low latency. The systems that make this possible are what you'll build and own.


What you get to do in this role:

  • Agent orchestration engine — A state machine that manages long-running agent sessions, coordinating planning, execution, and user interaction across multiple LLM calls and tool invocations
  • Distributed session management — Lease-based ownership using DynamoDB conditional writes, heartbeat protocols, and crash recovery via checkpointing
  • Event-driven message pipeline — SQS FIFO queues for ordered delivery, Kafka consumers for event processing, and real-time streaming via gRPC and Socket.IO
  • Structured concurrency — Python asyncio TaskGroups running multiple concurrent tasks per session (message polling, lease heartbeats, output publishing, orchestrator execution) with fail-fast semantics and graceful cancellation
  • Observability infrastructure — OpenTelemetry instrumentation, distributed trace context propagation across async boundaries, custom span lifecycle management for sessions that span minutes
  • Caching and state layers — Redis, DynamoDB KV stores with per-org/per-bot scoping, batch read optimization, and hot-reload configuration

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

You should have deep experience in at least 3 of these areas:

  • Distributed systems: consistency models, idempotency, exactly-once delivery, distributed locking/leasing
  • Concurrent/async programming: Python asyncio, Go goroutines, structured concurrency, cancellation handling
  • Event-driven architectures: message queues (SQS, Kafka), pub/sub, backpressure, delivery guarantees
  • Database systems for infrastructure: DynamoDB (conditional writes, transactions), Redis (connection pooling, pub/sub)
  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, span context propagation, Prometheus metrics
  • gRPC/protobuf: streaming RPCs, service interface design, error handling patterns

Required:

  • 0-2+ years building production backend/infrastructure systems
  • Strong in Python or Go (ideally both)
  • Experience designing and operating systems that handle real traffic at scale
  • Comfort with ambiguity — these are novel problems without textbook solutions

descriptionHtml:

Job Description

About the team

We are the Workplace engineering pillar in ServiceNow’s CRM & Industry Workflows organisation, building Workplace Service Delivery and its integrations with CSM and FSM. AI is the new baseline for how we build: it changes how engineers work and what “done” means.

The role

You will build features across the stack, working AI-native: breaking tasks into small pieces, giving AI agents the context they need, and verifying everything you ship. You own the stories you take on from implementation to production, including their correctness. There is no separate QE team to hand off to.

You will work with moderate guidance from senior engineers, with more detailed direction on new areas.

What you get to do

Build and own your work

  • Turn well-defined requirements into working, tested features, and ask good questions when they are not well-defined.
  • Build features across the stack (UI, APIs, data model, integrations) and the AI layer (agents, prompts, tools, and the context they run on), with guidance from senior engineers. Learn the parts that are new to you as you go.
  • Explain your work clearly: write PR descriptions and short design notes that a reviewer can follow, and demo what you built in sprint reviews.

Use AI tools effectively

  • Use agentic coding tools as your default way of working: give them clear context, review output critically, and never ship code you can’t explain.
  • Use and improve the instruction files and documentation that help agents work well in our codebase.
  • Keep up with AI tools and techniques, and share what you learn with your team.

Own correctness, with no handoff

  • Write your own unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, including edge cases and failure modes.
  • Follow your work through release and fix what breaks.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of experience building and shipping software, or an advanced degree, or equivalent work experience.
  • Strong in at least one programming language, with solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design.
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn new layers of the stack: front end, back end, data, integrations, and AI (agents, prompts, evaluation). You don’t need to know our technologies on day one, but you should pick up unfamiliar ones quickly, with AI tools as part of how you learn.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding tools in real work, and the discipline to verify their output through tests and review.
  • An understanding of how LLMs behave (context, hallucination) and their risks.
  • Initiative, good judgment within established practices, and clear written and verbal communication.

Even better if you have

  • A project where you built something with LLMs, agents, or RAG.
  • Exposure to the ServiceNow platform.
  • Experience with enterprise or multi-tenant SaaS products.

We are seeking a motivated and experienced lawyer specialized in Employment Law to join our Global Employment Law team to support the continued growth of ServiceNow across Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA). The role will report to the Senior Director, Global Employment Law.    

We are open to hiring this role in any of our major hubs across Europe. 

The Director, Global Employment Law, EMEA will be primarily responsible for providing legal counsel and partnership to the Global People Organization and other key internal stakeholders globally on employment law matters.  This is a unique opportunity to play a pivotal role in ServiceNow’s expanding legal team and to work on challenging legal issues in an exciting, fast-paced environment.

Deliver business oriented, risk-based advice and counsel on the full range of employment law issues including: hiring, separations and dismissals, employee relations issues, restructurings, works councils and collective consultation, compensation and benefits, leaves of absence, global workforce innovation and culture, workplace investigations and employee relations, and employee privacy matters. descriptionHtml:

Job Description

Lead ServiceNow’s global Government Affairs & Public Policy organization and shape the political and policy environment in which the company operates. Build trusted relationships with governments and policymakers, influence policy outcomes, strengthen ServiceNow’s voice on the issues defining the future of technology, and translate external developments into opportunities for innovation, market access and growth.

The Opportunity

ServiceNow is entering its next era at a moment when technology, public policy, geopolitics and business strategy are increasingly intertwined. AI, cybersecurity, digital sovereignty, privacy and data protection, workforce transformation and public-sector modernization are no longer simply regulatory issues. They increasingly shape how companies innovate, where they can operate, how governments buy technology and whether customers have the confidence to adopt it at scale.

Within Legal, Societal, and Global Affairs (LSGA), we are building a unified Trust Engine designed to help ServiceNow navigate that complexity, shape the environment in which we operate and earn trust at scale. That strategy recognizes that a regulatory issue can become a revenue issue, a policy decision can affect market access, and trust can determine whether innovation advances or stalls.

We are seeking an exceptional executive to lead our global Government Affairs & Public Policy organization. Anchored in Washington, D.C., this leader will guide a geographically distributed team and advance a three-part mission: shape policy, earn credibility and grow the business across key markets worldwide.

This leader will set ServiceNow’s global government affairs strategy and establish the company as a credible, constructive and influential voice with governments around the world. They will advance a three-part mission: shape policy through direct advocacy, submissions and consultations; earn credibility through trusted government relationships and a substantive, non-commercial voice; and grow the business by opening markets, helping secure agency budget priorities, and influencing pipeline. They will anticipate political and policy shifts, determine where ServiceNow should engage and lead, and convert policy insight into action across the enterprise.

What You Will Lead

  • Set the global government affairs strategy. Define and execute a focused global government affairs and public policy strategy aligned to ServiceNow’s business, technology and growth priorities. Establish clear global policy priorities and translate them into regional and country strategies with measurable outcomes. Identify where ServiceNow should lead, influence, partner, prepare or selectively engage across emerging political and policy issues.
  • Shape policy and protect the business. Advance ServiceNow’s priorities through direct advocacy, submissions, consultations, coalitions and associations. Shape legislation, policy, government programs, procurement frameworks, standards and budgets while addressing developments that could constrain innovation, adoption or growth.
  • Earn credibility and strengthen ServiceNow’s voice. Build durable government relationships and position ServiceNow as a practical, non-commercial voice through clear policy positions, thought leadership and executive engagement.
  • Turn policy intelligence into enterprise advantage. Identify political and policy shifts early, advise senior leaders on business implications and connect government insight to product strategy, market access, go-to-market planning and customer priorities.
  • Partner across the Trust Engine. Lead political strategy, government relationships and broader public policy positions, partnering with Regulatory Strategy & Enablement on substantive regulatory strategy and enterprise readiness. Together, anticipate change, shape outcomes and drive enterprise action.
  • Connect external insight to enterprise action. Connect policymakers, customers and external partners with Public Sector and go-to-market leaders, Global Strategic Relations, Community Engagement, Social Impact and other internal teams so external insight informs company strategy, and ServiceNow’s capabilities inform policy conversations.
  • Turn influence into business impact. Help create the conditions for public-sector growth, stronger market access and strategic opportunities, connecting government engagement and policy influence to ServiceNow’s broader business priorities.
  • Lead a world-class global organization. Develop a geographically distributed team with strong regional ownership, shared intelligence, disciplined execution and a culture of transparency, trust, curiosity and One Team.
  • Build the operating model. Establish clear mechanisms for policy prioritization, stakeholder engagement, executive support, submissions, consultants and associations, deploying resources where ServiceNow can have the greatest impact.

What Success Looks Like

  • ServiceNow has a focused, globally coordinated government affairs and public policy strategy.
  • Policymakers see ServiceNow as a trusted, constructive and credible non-commercial voice.
  • The company anticipates political, regulatory and market developments and influences policy before positions become fixed.
  • Engagement contributes demonstrably to agency budget priorities, pipeline influenced, stronger market access, customer trust and risk reduction.
  • Public Sector and go-to-market leaders, Global Strategic Relations, Community Engagement, Social Impact and other partners coordinate effectively around shared priorities.
  • Priorities gathered across the organization inform policy initiatives that reflect business needs and strategic opportunities.

Qualifications

  • A globally respected government affairs, public policy or public-sector leader with significant experience at the intersection of technology, government and business.
  • A compelling thought leader and public advocate who can help define a distinctive ServiceNow policy voice, shape debate on issues important to the company and credibly represent ServiceNow with policymakers, industry and influential external audiences.
  • Credible with senior policymakers and government leaders across major markets, with a track record of shaping policy outcomes and building durable institutional relationships.
  • Deeply fluent in geopolitical, legislative and emerging technology policy, including AI, cybersecurity, digital sovereignty and data, and able to translate developments into business implications and executive decisions.
  • Experienced in leading distributed teams and building effective coalitions across associations, partners, allies and advisers.
  • A leader with exceptional political and business judgment who can navigate complex internal and external stakeholder environments while understanding the important distinction between political and public policy leadership and substantive regulatory strategy.
  • A collaborative leader who combines strategic ambition with operational discipline, builds trust and influence across the business and demonstrates the value of the function through measurable outcomes and impact.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Job Description

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) delivers world-class, innovative security solutions to reduce risk and protect the company and our customers. We enable our customers to migrate their most sensitive data and workloads to the cloud, accelerating our business so that we are the most trusted SaaS provider. We create an environment where our employees are proud to work and can make a positive impact. 

ServiceNow runs mission-critical workflows for a large share of the world's enterprises. Cyber Defense Engineering protects ServiceNow and the platform our customers run on. Cyber defense doesn't scale through headcount alone. It scales when systems make defenders exponentially more effective. Data is how we get there. You'll build the data and AI foundation that lets our defenders, and the AI agents working alongside them, detect and stop threats at enterprise scale.

As Principal Software Engineer & Architect, you will own the technical direction of the data and platform systems behind detection, investigation, hunting, response, and AI-driven defense. The entire Cyber Defense Engineering org will build against your architecture, and your decisions will show up in measurable security outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Own the architecture of our multi-system security data platform, from ingestion to access, including the data that powers detection, investigation, hunting and risk analytics. Decide what data lives where, weighing business value, performance, retention, and cost, and remove duplication across systems.
  • Define shared schemas, data models, and data contracts so telemetry from different sources is consistent, trustworthy, and joinable for people, automation, and AI.
  • Build the data foundation for applied AI in security operations: data and feature pipelines, model evaluation, retrieval, and governed data access for AI agents that investigate and respond to threats.
  • Build access control, data protection, auditability, and compliance into the architecture so the platform is secure by design.
  • Lead technical design across teams, resolve tradeoffs on shared platforms, and keep the architecture coherent as the organization grows. Drive major decisions to closure through design and decision documents.
  • Partner closely with detection, investigation, and response teams to build trust and turn their needs into platform priorities.
  • Set engineering standards for source control, CI/CD, testing, and observability. Coach senior engineers through design and code review until they can lead architecture decisions on their own.
  • Tie platform investments to measurable outcomes: detection coverage; time to detect, investigate, and mitigate; and data quality and freshness.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a similar field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 3+ years in a principal, staff, or architect role.
  • Proven experience designing and operating large-scale cloud data platforms in production, including data modeling, data warehouse design, and high-volume streaming and batch telemetry pipelines across multiple systems.
  • Hands-on ML/AI experience, including shipping ML or LLM-based systems to production, and working knowledge of how data quality, freshness, and lineage limit model performance.
  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one general-purpose language (Python, Go, or Java).
  • A record of setting technical direction across teams without formal authority.
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and balancing competing team priorities.
  • Clear, concise writing and a habit of documenting decisions and their rationale.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience applying ML and graph-based analysis to security problems, such as anomaly detection, entity correlation, incident investigations, or attack path analysis.

Job Description

ServiceNow is seeking a Senior Labour Relations Manager to lead our Works Council and employee representation engagement across Germany and Austria. This is a newly created role that sits within our EMEA People organisation, requiring expertise in complex labour regulation, stakeholder management, and a commitment to protecting both employee voice and business continuity. 

You will report directly to the VP of HR EMEA and will be the primary point of contact for Works Council and statutory employee representation relationships in Germany and Austria. Based in Munich.

Key Responsibilities 

Relationship Management & Strategic Partnership 

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with Works Council representatives, employee delegates, Trade Unions and other external bodies 

  • Serve as the primary liaison between ServiceNow leadership and the Works Council(s), ensuring clear and consistent communication 

  • In partnership with the Senior Employee & Labour Relations Manager, develop and execute proactive engagement strategies that balance business needs with employee representation 

  • Support stakeholder alignment across HR, Legal, Communications, and business leadership both within EMEA and Globally on labour relations matters 

Statutory Compliance & Consultation 

  • Ensure compliance with labour law and Works Council requirements across Germany and Austria 

  • Negotiate Works Council agreements and employment-related initiatives that align with enterprise strategic objectives and employee interests 

  • Lead and manage formal consultation processes and collective engagement initiatives, including the negotiation of collective agreements and works council agreements in applicable jurisdictions 

  • Partner with Legal to assess employment law impacts and mitigate legal risk in labour relations matters 

Organisational Change & Restructuring 

  • Lead Works Council engagement and formal consultation on significant organisational changes, restructurings, and workforce decisions 

  • Develop communication strategies and consultation plans that are legally compliant and respectful of employee voice 

  • Provide labour relations counsel to HRBPs and business leaders navigating complex people decisions across Germany and Austria. 

Policy & Process Development 

  • In partnership with the Senior Employee & Labour Relations Manager, develop and maintain labour relations policies, processes, and frameworks aligned with applicable legal requirements

  • Provide guidance on employee relations best practice and escalation protocols 

  • Continuously improve processes and drive consistency in our approach to social dialogue and employee representation 

  • Provide training and support to managers and other stakeholders on labor relations policies, procedures, and practices to ensure consistency and compliance across the organization 

  • Support the implementation of new or updated people programs, policies, and practices 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications & Experience 

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

  • 7+ years of progressive labour relations, employee relations, or HR experience 

  • Deep expertise in Works Council laws and practice in Germany and Austria 

  • Demonstrated experience leading large-scale organisational change and restructuring consultation processes 

  • Strong understanding of collective bargaining, statutory consultation, and German (and Austrian) employment law 

  • Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with ability to build trust across contentious issues 

  • Fluency in English and German is essential; additional European languages are an advantage 

  • Track record of advising senior leadership and HRBPs through complex labour relations challenges 

Desirable Qualifications 

  • Law degree or postgraduate qualification in labour law or human resources 

  • Experience in multinational or matrix organisations with complex governance 

  • Experience in technology or high-growth companies with USA headquarters 

  • Certification in labour relations or HR (CIPD, SHRM equivalent) 

Core Competencies 

  • Strategic Thinking and Business Acumen: Ability to connect labour relations strategy to broader business objectives 

  • Judgment & Decision Making: Ability to navigate ambiguity and make sound decisions under pressure 

  • Relationship Management: Genuine interest in understanding different perspectives and building credible partnerships 

  • Communication: Clear, direct communication with ability to translate complex issues for different audiences

  • Team Player: Ability to build strong relationships across HR and the business to be able to influence and advise and drive to the right outcomes

This role reports directly to the VP of HR EMEA and will work closely with:

locations: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Role summary
DT is in continuous transformation that impacts how 1,100+ people power the company, grow and thrive.  This role is the connective tissue that keeps that transformation coherent and make sure the people side of DT moves as fast as the technology side.  It builds the strategic muscle DT already has on financial planning and applies it to how DT operates, how its managers grow, and how its people experience change.

Scope of impact
Enterprise level. This role connects and operates across the full extended management team (DT ELT, including DTLT and their direct reports). It drives momentum for transformation work happening across every DT sub-function, represents DT’s workforce needs directly to HR leadership, and holds the connective view that keeps management development and engagement work grounded in what’s happening in the organization.

The six scope pillars

  • Curate, activate and maintain the health of the DT operating model: owns the ongoing evolution of DT’s operating model as a living strategic asset rather than a periodic deliverable. Drives the conversations that keep DT’s structure, ways of working, and talent strategy ahead of where the business is going, anticipating the organizational implications of AI, human-machine teaming, and the continued compression of the line between technology delivery and business execution.
  • DTLT and extended management team maturity: in partnership with GP (HRBP, GLD, and more), designs and runs programs that close the gap between what DTLT commits to at the strategy table and what managers and teams do in the field.
  • Transformation intelligence and translation: maintains a live, interpreted view of every active transformation across DT and translates what’s changing into what managers and individual contributors need to do differently.
  • HR representation for DT: acts as DT’s “business” voice into HR. Defines what programs, policies, and support DT needs based on its operating model and transformation portfolio, and ensures they are both operational and effective. Strategic guide to lead HR partnership.
  • Culture and employee engagement strategy: owns recognition, town halls, and events as tools that reinforce the operating model and culture shift, not as standalone activities.
  • Communications as output: uses communications to activate and align people around the five pillars above.

Key responsibilities

Curate, activate and maintain the health of the DT operating model

  • Own DT’s operating model as a living document: maintain it, pressure-test it against what’s happening in the organization, and drive the leadership conversations that evolve it.
  • Anticipate the organizational implications of evolving technologies and external market shifts. Bring those implications into DT’s planning conversations before they become reactive ones.
  • Partner with Strategy and Operations to ensure the operating model is reflected in AOP design, OKR construction, and workforce planning, not treated as a separate workstream.

DTLT and extended management team maturity

  • In partnership with GP, HRBP, GLD, and others, design and run management development programs that build durable capability, not episodic event exposure, for DTLT and their full set of directs.
  • In partnership with HR, define what management maturity means specifically in DT’s context: the behaviors, judgment patterns, and operating norms our operating model calls for, not a generic framework imported from elsewhere.
  • Close the gap between what DTLT commits to at the strategy table and what managers and supervisors execute in the field, diagnosing where that gap lives and building programs that address the root cause.
  • Hold HR and GLD accountable to DT’s requirements rather than accepting standard offerings. This role sets the agenda for that partnership.

Transformation intelligence and translation

  • Maintain a current, interpreted view of every active transformation across DT. This is not a status tracker but an organizational read that informs what leaders need to know and do.
  • Translate what’s changing across DT into specific behavior changes for managers and ICs, naming those behaviors explicitly rather than communicating at the level of themes or priorities.
  • Advise DTLT on where transformation fatigue, change saturation, or misalignment between parallel workstreams is creating risk, before it surfaces as an engagement or performance problem.
  • Keep management development and culture activation work calibrated to real transformation conditions rather than a generic calendar.

HR representation for DT

  • Act as DT’s requirements owner with HR, defining what DT needs from programs, policies, and support based on its operating model and transformation portfolio, not reacting to what HR proposes.
  • Identify gaps between what HR offers and what DT’s operating rhythm actually demands, and close those gaps by specifying requirements clearly enough that HR can act on them.
  • Own the DT-HR partnership cadence so it runs on DT’s planning cycle, ensuring HR programs land when DT needs them, not when HR schedules them.
  • Represent DT’s workforce needs at the HR leadership level with enough authority and context to influence program design, not just adoption.

Culture and employee engagement strategy

  • Own recognition programs, town halls, and events, and connect each to a specific culture or operating model goal.
  • Use communications to build alignment around the operating model and management priorities, positioning communications as a delivery mechanism.

What this role is not

  • A communications role that occasionally touches strategy.
  • An HR/GLD liaison who accepts standard offerings and schedules them for DT.
  • A calendar owner for events and town halls with no explicit tie to DT’s operating model or culture goals.
  • A PMO function that tracks transformation data without interpreting it or translating it into action.
  • A role that waits for the operating model to be handed to it. This person shapes it.
  • A support function to DTLT. A strategic partner to it.

Qualifications

This role requires someone who has done the hard version of each of these things, not someone who has been adjacent to them.

  • Has owned an operating model evolution in a large, matrixed technology organization, not as a consultant who recommended changes, but as the person accountable for making them stick.
  • Can read an organization: walk into a management team, identify where the stated operating model and the lived operating model diverge, and name the gap without waiting to be told.
  • Has designed and run management development programs for VP and SVP-level audiences, starting from a diagnosis of what capability actually needs to change.
  • Has operated with genuine authority at the VP and SVP level, shaping decisions and preparing materials for others to decide with.
  • Has built something from scratch in a matrixed environment without a fully defined mandate, pre-cleared budget, or stable organizational context.
  • Has held an HR partnership with enough confidence to define requirements rather than accept offerings, and has the organizational credibility to make that posture land.
  • Understands the organizational implications of AI-driven work transformation, not at the level of talking points, but well enough to advise senior leaders on what it means for structure, roles, and capability development.
  • Has managed parallel, evolving transformation workstreams simultaneously, and has demonstrated the judgment to know when to push and when to pause.
  • Communicates at the executive level as a native capability, not as a skill they apply when needed, but as the default mode they operate in.

Great ideas don't win Enterprise deals. Great ideas you can see working do.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

ServiceNow is the fastest growing enterprise cloud software company in the world — and it's our people who keep us there. We hire carefully, we hire the best, and we celebrate our talent. Come join our Sales A-team.

We're looking for a highly driven Commercial Growth AE to join our expanding team. In this role, you'll be responsible for strategically prospecting into new accounts, driving expansion within our existing customer base, and ensuring customers continue to realise value from the NOW Platform.

You'll bring a demonstrable track record in new business pipeline generation, ideally in a B2B environment, and you'll collaborate closely with Sales Specialists, Solution Consultants, Renewal Sales and more to exceed quota and help build the future of ServiceNow's sales talent.

What you’ll do in this role: 

  • Drive growth across the customer base. Own and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets by winning new logos, expanding share of wallet within existing Small, Mid-Market, and Commercial accounts, and protecting renewals. 

  • Build trusted relationships with economic buyers. Engage influential decision-makers and executives, earning a seat at the table as a strategic adviser on their priorities, not just a vendor. 

  • Diagnose the customer’s business. Go deep on each organisation’s strategic goals, financial drivers, operational challenges, and competitive pressures. Translate those insights into a clear, quantified case for how ServiceNow moves the needle. 

  • Create demand through targeted prospecting. Build a pipeline in key verticals through research-led outreach, account-based campaigns, and high-value prospect meetings, going after the accounts where ServiceNow can deliver the greatest impact. 

  • Sell with Value Selling discipline. Use the methodology to qualify rigorously, build compelling business cases, and co-create value with customers from first conversation through to renewal and expansion. 

  • Orchestrate the full team to win. Bring in Solution Consultants, Customer Success, and Partners at the right moments to accelerate deals, strengthen executive alignment, and expand the footprint within each account. 

  • Expand accounts continuously. Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities early, anticipate renewal timing, and plan multi-year, multi-product growth with each customer. 

  • Forecast with precision and plan with intent. Deliver accurate forecasts, territory plans, and strategic account plans that give leadership confidence and show clear paths to growth. 

  • Hit the daily, monthly, and quarterly drivers. Consistently deliver on new prospect meetings, pipeline generation, ACV bookings, and renewal rates, the activity and outcomes that fuel commercial growth. 

  • Travel when it counts. Occasional travel for training, customer meetings, and key internal events may be required. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • To be successful in this role, you’ll bring 4+ years of sales experience and:

title: CRM Solution Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

ServiceNowは「ビジネス変革のためのAIコントロールタワー」として、あらゆるAI、あらゆるデータ、あらゆるワークフローをひとつにつなぐ「ServiceNow AIプラットフォーム」を提供し、Fortune 500企業の85%が、より賢く、より速く、より良く働くことを支援しています。すべては、エンジニアのフレッド・ラディが、同僚の面倒な作業を自動化するコードを書いたことから始まりました。この同僚は感激のあまり涙を流したといいます。この出来事をきっかけに、フレッドは「すべての人を煩雑な業務から解放し、意義のある仕事に集中できるようにする」会社をつくることを決意しました。 

私たちは、テクノロジーと人の力がともに発揮される「AIネイティブ」なカルチャーを築いており、その挑戦はまだ始まったばかりです。 AIを人のために活かす未来を、私たちと一緒に創りませんか。 

Job Description

ServiceNowのCRMは、問い合わせを記録するだけのCRMではありません。フロントからバックオフィスまでをひとつのプラットフォームとワークフローでつなぎ、問い合わせを最後まで解決するCRMです。AIが答えるだけでなく、実際に業務を動かして解決する。この点がAI時代のCRMに欠かせない条件だと、私たちは考えています。 

日本でも、幅広い業界の大企業で、顧客接点を担うミッションクリティカルなDXプロジェクトへの採用が続いています。この成長に合わせて、CRM Japanではソリューションコンサルタントを複数名、純増で採用します。 

ソリューションコンサルタントは、営業チームの一員としてお客様の課題を深く理解し、ServiceNowだからこそ実現できる価値を、提案とデモで形にする役割です。新しいことを素早く吸収し、自ら考えて動けるスタートアップのようなマインドを持つ方を歓迎します。 

この役割で担っていただくこと： 

  • CRMセールスエクゼクティブと一緒に案件の戦略を立て、ServiceNow CRMを選んでいただくための提案とデモをリードします 
  • お客様の課題に合わせて、ServiceNowならではの価値を、説得力のあるストーリーで伝えます 
  • CRMセールスエクゼクティブがCRMの価値を提案できるよう、社内のイネーブルメントを企画・支援します 
  • カスタマーサービス領域とソリューションのエキスパートとして、社内外で専門性を発揮します 
  • CRMの製品領域の拡大に合わせて、専門性の幅を広げていきます 
  • プロダクトマネジメントや開発チームと連携し、お客様のニーズを製品の強化につなげます 
  • 提案のノウハウや成功事例をチームで共有し、チーム全体の提案力を高めます 
  • 競合や市場のトレンドを常に把握し、提案に活かします 
  • 事業部門と情報システム部門、両方の意思決定者と対話します 
  • ユーザーカンファレンス、展示会、アナリスト向けデモ、ウェビナーなどのマーケティング活動を支援します 

Qualifications

この役割で成功するために必要なこと： 

  • 業務プロセスや意思決定、課題解決にAIを活用した経験、またはAIの活用可能性について具体的に検討した経験。AIを活用したツールの利用、ワークフローの自動化、AIによるインサイトの分析、担当領域や業界にAIが与える影響の検討などを含みます 
  • 営業部門やカスタマーサービス部門が抱える課題とニーズへの深い理解 
  • CRMソリューション（Salesforce、Pega、Zendeskなど）でのソリューションコンサルティング経験が7年以上、またはServiceNowプラットフォームでの同等の経験 
  • お客様にとって重要な価値を見極め、印象に残る形で伝えられるプリセールススキル 
  • 自社ソリューションの魅力を、社内にも積極的に発信していく意欲 
  • 経営層、事業部門、技術部門のキーパーソンから信頼を得られる力 
  • 細かな指示がなくても、自分で仕事を進めて最後までやり遂げる力 
  • ServiceNowプラットフォームの知識、またはWeb技術の専門知識。新しい技術を素早く習得できること 
  • プロダクトマネジメント、プロダクトマーケティング、開発チームと連携して仕事を進めた経験 
  • ServiceNowの価値と競合との違いを、見込み顧客に分かりやすく伝えられること 
  • 高い熱意と行動力。頻繁な出張に対応できること（最大50%の国内出張の可能性があります） 
  • 柔軟な発想で課題を解決できる力

Job Description

About the Role

As a Sr. Staff SRE at Armis, you’ll set the reliability and infrastructure direction for a high-scale, security-first platform. You’ll own uptime, scalability, and security across our microservices, data stores, and cloud environments, and you’ll lead the technical strategy that shapes how we run them. You’ll have the autonomy to evaluate and adopt new technologies, and you’ll raise the bar for reliability across several engineering teams, not just your own.

What You’ll Do

  • Set reliability strategy across multiple teams. Define SLOs, error budgets, and reliability standards for critical services, and drive adoption through technical influence rather than direct authority.

  • Design resilient, multi-region infrastructure. Architect highly available, scalable production systems across cloud environments, and lead design reviews for changes that affect platform-wide stability.

  • Lead observability and alerting. Drive system-wide alerting and monitoring strategy across infrastructure and database layers, and reduce alert noise through better signal design and automated triage.

  • Own large-scale database reliability. Lead DBRE efforts across distributed data stores, including capacity planning, failover design, backup and recovery validation, and performance tuning.

  • Lead incident response and postmortems. Serve as a senior escalation point during incidents, and ensure postmortems produce systemic fixes rather than one-off patches.

  • Build security and compliance into the SDLC. Partner with Security and Compliance to embed FedRAMP, SOC 2, and related controls into infrastructure design, pipelines, and change management.

  • Evaluate and lead POCs. Assess new tools and services for performance, cost, and security posture, and make build-versus-buy recommendations to leadership.

  • Advance Infrastructure as Code. Set standards for Terraform and/or CloudFormation across teams, including module design, policy validation, and review practices.

  • Mentor and raise the bar. Coach senior and mid-level engineers, lead technical design reviews, and contribute to hiring and engineering standards.

  • Document and communicate. Maintain clear runbooks, architecture documentation, and reliability reports for engineering, product, and executive audiences.

Qualifications

  • U.S. citizenship

  • 7+ years managing Linux servers in global, cloud-based environments

  • 5+ years of hands-on AWS infrastructure experience

  • 5+ years of Python and Kubernetes in production, including troubleshooting cluster performance, auto-scaling, and service reliability

  • Demonstrated experience leading reliability for large-scale systems, including DBRE

  • Deep networking knowledge (routing, service mesh, CNI)

  • 5+ years with IaC tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation

  • Strong grounding in automated alerting, incident triage, and monitoring practice

  • Track record of leading cross-team technical initiatives and influencing without direct authority

Preferred

  • Experience with AI Ops platforms, ML-driven observability, or resource optimization

  • Hands-on experience with security incident response

  • Familiarity with LLM-based infrastructure automation for IaC policy validation or documentation generation

  • Experience on government-related projects requiring U.S. citizenship

  • Background in FedRAMP, SOC 2, GDPR, or similar frameworks

  • Experience in restricted environments (FIPS, SELinux, air-gapped)

  • Prior focus on database reliability engineering

title: Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

** This role can be hired in either Zurich or Lausanne **

As an Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI for the Switzerland market, you are the technical face of a fundamentally different way of selling. Rather than leading with slideware and scripted demos, you embed alongside the customer, run deep Discovery to isolate one high-value problem, and then prove value in the open — building a working Proof of Value (POV) on the customer’s own data using our Agentic workflow capabilities.

You partner with Sales, Product Management, and Executive Leadership to turn a single, well-chosen use case into undeniable, data-backed proof that earns the next phase of the relationship. This role blends the consultative instincts of a Sr. Advisory Solution Consultant with the hands-on, build-it-in-the-field engineering of a forward-deployed engineer: someone who works inside the customer’s own environment, configuring and proving solutions on their live data rather than presenting finished products from the outside. 

The Embedded Approach 

The Advisory Solution Consultant inverts the traditional pre-sales motion. Product demonstration is deliberately minimal — just enough to establish credibility and unlock the real work. The center of gravity is the POV: a short, focused cycle where we get access to a slice of the customer’s data, stand up an Agentic workflow against a problem they genuinely care about, and let the outcome speak for itself. Your job is to earn the right to that POV through rigorous Discovery, then deliver it as an embedded engineer, not a presenter. 

What You’ll Do 

As the Advisory Solution Consultant, you will lead a Discovery-first, POV-centric engagement model — using your technical depth and Agentic workflow expertise to convert customer data into proven outcomes, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. 

Key responsibilities include: 

  • Partner with Sales as the embedded technical lead — someone who wins on proof, not presentation — to drive transformational CRM opportunities. 
  • Lead rigorous Discovery to isolate a single, high-value problem worth solving, mapping the customer’s data, systems, and desired outcome before any product is shown. 
  • Keep product demonstration minimal and purposeful — use it only to establish credibility and to set up the POV, never as a substitute for proving value on real data. 
  • Secure and scope a POV: earn customer sponsorship to engage in a hands-on cycle where we use their data to solve the identified problem with our Agentic workflow capabilities. 
  • Build and deliver the POV as an embedded engineer — configuring Agentic workflows against the customer’s environment and producing measurable, data-backed results. 
  • Translate POV outcomes into an executive value narrative that quantifies impact and defines the path from a single proven use case to enterprise-wide adoption. 
  • Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. 
  • Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. 
  • Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks, and Agentic workflow patterns so the embedded POV motion scales across the team. 
  • Represent the company at enterprise events, technology forums, and leadership summits as a credible, hands-on technical voice for the embedded POV approach. 

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For 

To succeed in this role, you should bring: 

  • Builder Mindset: A builder’s instinct — comfortable getting hands on with a customer’s data and environment to prove value directly, rather than relying on canned demonstrations. 
  • POV-Centric Selling: Proven ability to scope, sell, and deliver Proof-of-Value engagements that convert a single problem into quantified, data-backed outcomes. 
  • Discovery Rigor: Exceptional discovery skills to quickly isolate the one problem worth solving and secure customer commitment to a POV. 
  • Agentic & AI Fluency: Deep, practical understanding of Agentic workflows and AI-driven automation, and how to apply them to CRM problems on live customer data. 
  • CRM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in CRM and customer experience, with strong knowledge of service, sales, lead & opportunity management. 
  • Enterprise Experience: Proven track record engaging large organizations and earning executive sponsorship for hands-on, data-driven engagements. 
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to translate technical POV results into clear, business-oriented value stories for senior enterprise stakeholders. 
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global teams spanning Sales, Product, and delivery. 
  • Language: fluency in English and French/German 

Qualifications 

  • Demonstrated experience building or delivering POVs, prototypes, or hands-on technical engagements — a hands-on track record of proving value on real customer data, not just presenting it. 
  • Hands-on experience applying AI and Agentic workflow capabilities to solve business problems — automating workflows, orchestrating AI agents, and analyzing AI-driven outcomes within CRM or adjacent enterprise contexts. 
  • 10+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience, with a clear shift toward Discovery-led, proof-based selling. 
  • Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or strong technical expertise with cloud software solutions. 
  • Experience working collaboratively with product management, product marketing, partners, and professional services. 
  • Track record of working with a Sales counterpart to promote execution excellence and advance transformational opportunities.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. Job Description

As an Associate Accessibility Engineer Intern, you’ll partner with senior engineers on our accessibility engineering team to build the tooling and automation that help product teams across the company ship accessible software. We provide accessibility coverage for engineering teams and embed accessibility checks directly into their CI/CD pipelines. You’ll write well-tested, maintainable code across the stack, take part in code reviews, and use AI coding assistants to accelerate delivery while critically evaluating AI-generated output for correctness and security. You’ll also collaborate with product engineering teams, product managers, and designers to make accessibility a default part of how software gets built.

What you do

  • Accessibility Automation & Tooling
    • Build and maintain the internal tools, frameworks, scanners, and dashboards the team uses to scale accessibility testing and reporting across many engineering teams
    • Develop automated accessibility test suites using tools such as axe-core and Playwright, and help improve signal quality by tuning rules and reducing false positives
  • CI/CD Pipeline Integration
    • Help integrate accessibility gates and scans into partner teams’ CI/CD pipelines, so defects surface at build time rather than in audits
    • Use and help maintain pipelines and infrastructure-as-code; learn to monitor scan health in production and support triage when checks break
  • Accessibility Coverage & Audits
    • Support accessibility audits across the product portfolio — evaluating interfaces with screen readers (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver), keyboard-only navigation, and zoom/magnification against WCAG 2.2 and ARIA authoring practices
    • Help triage findings, write clear and reproducible defects, and track accessibility coverage across teams
  • System Design & Architecture
    • Take part in design discussions for our tooling: learn how the team evaluates trade-offs and help define data models, API contracts, and cloud-native persistence approaches
  • Code Quality & Review
    • Write comprehensive tests, follow coding standards, and review code — including AI-generated code — for security, performance, maintainability, and accessibility
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Technical Communication
    • Partner with product engineering teams, product managers, designers, and platform teams to roll out tooling, document how to use it, and explain accessibility findings and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences

Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, with a graduation date no earlier than July 2028
  • Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
  • Full-stack development skills: exposure through coursework, personal projects, internships, or hackathons to front-end frameworks (React/Angular/Vue), back-end languages (Node.js, Python, Java, Go), databases, REST/GraphQL APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), plus comfort adopting emerging AI/ML tools
  • Working knowledge of semantic HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and an interest in accessible user interfaces

Preferred Qualifications

  • Accessibility foundations: exposure to WCAG, ARIA, assistive technologies, or accessibility testing tools through coursework, projects, or prior work

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will independently lead the design, development, and delivery of complex, high-impact AI-native and cloud-native systems. The IC4 engineer takes ownership of critical components or features, sets technical direction within their domain, and serves as a technical resource to peers and junior engineers. They combine deep software engineering fundamentals with hands-on expertise in AI/ML integration, cloud architecture, and production systems. This role requires the ability to balance technical depth with organizational impact, working across teams to solve ambiguous problems and drive platform improvements.

What you get to do in this role:

Responsibility Area: Technical Leadership & Architecture
•    Lead the design and architecture of complex, production-critical AI-native systems, including LLM integrations, agentic workflows, retrieval pipelines, and inference services
•    Own end-to-end delivery of medium-to-large features or systems, including specification, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring
•    Make informed architectural and technical trade-off decisions between latency, cost, scalability, reliability, and model quality
•    Establish evaluation frameworks, testing strategies, and production monitoring for AI-driven features; drive adoption of eval-driven development practices
•    Design and optimize high-performance data pipelines, embedding systems, and vector stores handling millions of rows and complex retrieval scenarios
•    Champion security best practices, including prompt-injection defense, data privacy, PII handling, responsible AI guardrails, and compliance with regulatory requirements
•    Participate in architectural reviews across teams and contribute to platform-level technical decisions
•    Stay current with emerging AI/ML frameworks, services, and techniques; evaluate and recommend adoption where applicable

Responsibility Area: Mentorship & Technical Influence
•    Mentor junior and mid-level engineers (IC2/IC3) through pair programming, design reviews, architecture discussions, and hands-on coaching
•    Conduct thorough code reviews, including evaluation of prompts, agent logic, retrieval strategies, and AI/model behavior validation
•    Identify technical debt and improvement opportunities; advocate for and lead initiatives to address them
