•    Contribute to hiring and interview processes; provide technical assessment and feedback on engineering candidates
•    Model best practices in software craftsmanship, testing discipline, and debugging methodology
•    Support onboarding of new team members and ensure knowledge transfer across projects

Responsibility Area: Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication
•    Work closely with product management, domain specialists, and other engineering teams to define requirements and technical specifications
•    Translate complex technical concepts and AI trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders (product, leadership, customers)
•    Lead root cause analysis for customer-reported issues, including those involving model behavior, hallucinations, retrieval quality, and distributed system complexity
•    Participate in design reviews, technical planning sessions, and retrospectives; contribute perspectives on technical feasibility and risk
•    Communicate clearly about design decisions, implementation challenges, AI limitations, and production incidents
•    Build and maintain relationships with adjacent teams and external partners where applicable
•    Proactively identify opportunities to improve development processes, tooling, and team efficiency

Responsibility Area: Software Development Excellence
•    Develop robust, maintainable, and well-tested AI-native software using Python, Java, and JavaScript as appropriate
•    Build comprehensive unit tests, integration tests, and AI evaluation harnesses (accuracy, regression, hallucination detection)
•    Troubleshoot complex issues in distributed systems, probabilistic models, and cloud infrastructure; isolate root causes efficiently
•    Implement secure coding practices and responsible AI guardrails throughout the development lifecycle
•    Manage deployment, monitoring, and iteration of features in production; respond to performance issues and model drift
•    Work with cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), managed AI services (Bedrock, Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI), Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
•    Contribute to code and architecture standards; ensure adherence to established best practices

Responsibility Area: ServiceNow Platform Development
•    Design and develop custom applications, extensions, and integrations on the ServiceNow platform
•    Develop workflows, business rules, and automation using ServiceNow scripting (JavaScript, GlideScript, REST APIs)
•    Build data models, forms, and dashboards for ServiceNow applications; optimize database queries for performance
•    Integrate third-party AI/ML services and custom APIs with ServiceNow platform services
•    Contribute to and maintain ServiceNow plugin and app architecture; follow ServiceNow best practices and coding standards
•    Participate in ServiceNow upgrades and configuration management; ensure compatibility with platform updates
•    Mentor junior engineers on ServiceNow platform capabilities and development patterns

Responsibility Area: Customer Support & Product Excellence
•    Participate in customer issue triage and root cause analysis for production ServiceNow application issues
•    Work closely with customer success and support teams to understand and resolve complex technical issues
•    Provide technical guidance to customers on application usage, configuration, and troubleshooting
•    Identify patterns in customer issues and drive improvements to prevent recurrence
•    Contribute to customer documentation and internal knowledge bases
•    Support customer escalations; provide timely resolutions to critical issues affecting customer operations
•    Gather customer feedback and communicate product improvement opportunities back to product management

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • 8+ years of software development experience with a Bachelor's degree; OR 6+ years with a Master's degree; OR 3+ years with a PhD; OR equivalent work experience.
  • Practical software development experience, with 5+ years working with modern cloud-native and AI-native systems
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with LLM prompt engineering, agent design, and retrieval systems (RAG, semantic search, knowledge bases)
  • 3+ years of demonstrated experience integrating third-party AI/ML services and platform APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, etc.)
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience developing applications and extensions on the ServiceNow platform
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/GlideScript, Python, and Java; familiarity with ServiceNow scripting patterns and APIs
  • Solid understanding of ServiceNow data model, form/workflow design, and business process automation
  • Solid understanding of microservices architecture, REST/streaming APIs, and modern backend frameworks (Spring Boot, FastAPI, etc.)

Job Description

About the team

Corporate Strategy helps ServiceNow’s leadership work through the biggest questions facing the company, especially those that shape our long-term growth. Which new markets should we enter? Where will the next wave of growth come from? What has to be true to get there? Our work supports the executive leadership team, the Board of Directors, and leaders across the company.

We sit in the Office of the Chief Strategy Officer within the CFO organization, alongside Corporate Development, Corporate Development Integration, ServiceNow Ventures, and Customer Experience Strategy. Product and go-to-market strategy are owned by those functions. Our focus is the enterprise as a whole.

About the role

This is an MBA summer internship on a small, flat team. You’ll own a well-scoped workstream with a high degree of independence and work directly with senior leaders throughout the summer. 

What you’ll do

Own a strategic project. Scope the question, build the fact base, and develop a recommendation on a topic that matters to the company. Examples include evaluating a potential new market, assessing a growth area, or analyzing an industry shift that could change where ServiceNow competes.

Size and structure markets. Build market size, share, and growth analyses from primary and third-party sources. Be clear about what the numbers can and can’t tell us.

Study the competitive landscape. Look at how established players and new entrants are positioning and investing, and work out what that means for our choices.

Contribute to live work. Add analysis and synthesis to the team’s ongoing projects, including work done with Corporate Development.

Make the complex simple. Turn your analysis into concise written and slide-based material for senior audiences.

Qualifications

  • Pre-MBA experience in management consulting, investment banking, or corporate strategy. We also welcome strong candidates from operating roles who bring the skills below.
  • Strong quantitative skills, including building financial models from scratch

Job Description

Staff Software Engineer – AI Native Development

AI Security Incubation & Innovation

Security and Risk Engineering

About the team

The Security and Risk Engineering organization builds scalable, AI-powered security solutions that reduce risk and protect ServiceNow and its customers. We value AI-first thinking, clean architecture, intuitive experiences, and a culture of continuous learning.

This is a zero-to-one incubation. We’re building a new class of exposure analysis that ranks security work by exploitability—where an attacker could realistically get in—rather than raw severity. The architecture is evolving, and this role helps define what good looks like.

The Role

As a Staff Software Engineer – AI Native Development, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for the architecture, design, delivery, and evolution of major AI-powered software systems and subsystems.

You will combine deep full-stack software engineering expertise with strong AI/ML-native development skills to solve complex, ambiguous problems and build production-grade systems at scale. You will own significant technical areas end-to-end—from user experiences and APIs to distributed services, data and retrieval systems, AI/ML capabilities, and cloud infrastructure.

Beyond your individual contributions, you will provide technical direction across a broader engineering area, make critical architecture and design decisions, establish engineering standards, and influence multiple engineers and teams. You will help shape how we build AI-native products and establish the technical foundation for the next generation of intelligent enterprise applications.

This is a role for an engineer who can operate effectively at both architectural altitude and implementation depth—someone who can define the direction, make the difficult technical decisions, and still dive into the code when needed.

What You'll Own

  • A major product or technical subsystem end-to-end, including its architecture, design, implementation, scalability, reliability, security, and ongoing evolution.
  • The technical vision and architecture for your area, including key design decisions and interfaces with other systems and teams.
  • The quality and business/technical outcomes of your subsystem, with measurable targets for reliability, performance, AI quality, latency, cost, and customer impact.
  • The architecture and engineering practices required to build AI-native applications at production scale.
  • Technical direction for engineers working within your area, providing guidance through architecture, design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on technical leadership.
  • The evolution of AI/ML capabilities such as agentic workflows, retrieval, model integration, evaluation, and intelligent automation within your product area.
  • The technical strategy for balancing AI capability, engineering complexity, reliability, security, latency, and cost.

What You'll Do

Technical & Architectural Leadership

  • Take highly ambiguous and complex problems and turn them into clear technical strategies, architectures, and executable plans.
  • Own the architecture of major systems or subsystems and drive them from concept through production at scale.
  • Make sound technical decisions under uncertainty and clearly articulate architectural trade-offs.
  • Define system boundaries, interfaces, APIs, data flows, and integration patterns across multiple services and teams.
  • Drive architecture and design reviews and establish a high engineering bar for scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and performance.
  • Identify architectural risks and technical debt and drive long-term improvements across your area.
  • Influence technical direction beyond your immediate team through strong technical judgment and collaboration.

Full-Stack Engineering

  • Remain hands-on in building complex software across the stack, from frontend experiences and APIs to backend services, data systems, AI services, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Design scalable full-stack architectures using technologies such as React, TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, and modern cloud-native platforms.
  • Build distributed services, event-driven systems, APIs, databases, caching, messaging, and scalable data pipelines.
  • Ensure systems are observable, resilient, secure, and operationally excellent in production.
  • Lead by example through high-quality implementation, testing, debugging, code reviews, and engineering practices.

AI/ML-Native Development

  • Define and drive the adoption of AI-native architectures and engineering patterns across your technical area.
  • Design and build production-grade LLM and agentic systems, including:
    • Multi-agent orchestration
    • Tool and function calling
    • Planning and reasoning loops
    • Context and memory management
    • Retrieval and grounding
    • Failure recovery and resilience
    • Human-in-the-loop workflows
  • Integrate frontier models from providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or equivalent platforms, making informed decisions around model capability, cost, latency, and reliability.
  • Design RAG and retrieval systems using embeddings, vector search, hybrid search, semantic retrieval, re-ranking, and enterprise data sources.
  • Establish robust AI evaluation strategies and measurable quality metrics for AI-powered functionality.
  • Drive AI observability covering model quality, latency, cost, failures, hallucination/error rates, and system behavior.
  • Establish appropriate AI safety, security, governance, privacy, and guardrail mechanisms for production systems.
  • Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and determine how and where they can create meaningful product or engineering value.

Technical Leadership & Influence

  • Provide technical direction and mentorship to engineers across the workstream.
  • Lead complex engineering initiatives through influence rather than organizational authority.
  • Mentor senior and emerging engineers on architecture, system design, full-stack development, and production AI practices.
  • Partner closely with product, design, platform, data, security, and other engineering organizations to translate customer problems into scalable technical solutions.
  • Facilitate technical alignment across teams and resolve architectural disagreements through data, experimentation, and sound engineering judgment.
  • Establish reusable patterns, frameworks, libraries, and engineering practices that improve productivity across teams.
  • Help define the organization's approach to AI-native software development and AI-assisted engineering.

AI-Assisted Development

  • Champion effective use of AI coding agents and development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, or equivalent technologies.
  • Establish engineering practices for using AI to accelerate development while maintaining code quality, security, testing, and accountability.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI across the software development lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and code review.
  • Share learnings and establish best practices that enable teams to become more effective AI-native engineering organizations.

What You Bring

  • A strong track record of owning significant software systems or subsystems end-to-end in production.
  • Deep full-stack engineering expertise with the ability to work across frontend, backend, APIs, data, AI services, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Hands-on experience designing and delivering AI/ML-powered production systems.
  • Strong practical knowledge of modern AI technologies including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, agentic workflows, tool calling, model evaluation, and AI observability.

title: Director, Solution Consulting - CRM Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Why This Role Matters

You will lead one of  ServiceNow’s fastest-growing markets — and this team will be at the center of that momentum.

You’ll shape how we go to market, how we sell value, and how we build the next generation of Solution Consulting talent.

Job Description

As the Director, North CRM Solution Consulting, you run the day-to-day pre-sales engine for CRM across the Nordics, Benelux, Sweden, and adjacent markets. You lead first-line Solution Consulting managers and  individual contributors, and you are the leader closest to the deals.

You know what each team is working on, what is landing with customers, and what is stalling. Your job is to remove the blockers, keep the team focused and motivated, and make sure Solution Consulting moves in step with its CRM selling peers. This is an execution role at heart: you make the engine go fast.

You report to the AVP, EMEA CRM Solution Consulting, who sets regional strategy and direction.

What you'll do...

Own the number -- deliver CRM NNACV for EMEA North

  • Carry accountability, with your first-line managers, for EMEA North CRM NNACV targets and contribute to the EMEA goal of double-digit ACV growth.
  • Forecast technical win rates and deal-by-deal readiness, and raise risk to the AVP early rather than late.
  • Work with EMEA North CRM sales leaders to focus Solution Consulting time on the opportunities, use cases, and industries where CRM wins fastest.

Know the deals on the ground

  • Maintain a detailed, current view of what each team is working on: active opportunities, technical stage, proof-of-value status, and next steps.
  • Know what is working and what is not, and act on it in the weekly deal and pipeline rhythms rather than in a quarterly review.
  • Join key customer, POV, and escalation discussions where technical credibility or senior air cover is needed.

Remove blockers and keep the team focused

  • Be the first escalation point for anything that slows a deal: environment access, resourcing conflicts, unclear scope, product gaps, or competing demands.
  • Protect the team's time by clearing distractions, cutting low-value requests, and making sure ICs spend their time on the deals that matter most.
  • Make sure every IC knows what good looks like on their deals and has what they need to deliver it.

Lead and develop first-line leaders and ICs

  • Coach first-line managers on deal reviews, technical strategy, and POV execution, and hold them to consistent motions and communication rhythms.
  • Recruit, develop, and retain strong technical talent, and build a bench of ready-now first-line leaders.
  • Give direct, regular feedback to ICs and managers, and address performance issues early.

Keep the team motivated and aligned to selling peers

  • Recognize wins visibly and often, and build a team rhythm that keeps morale and momentum high.
  • Run joint pipeline and deal reviews with CRM sales, value, partner, and product counterparts so Solution Consulting and selling teams operate as one engine.
  • Agree coverage, account plans, and proof strategy with the AEs before they reach the customer.

Drive the shift to POV-centric selling and the FDE model

  • Make working proof-of-value the default way the team earns technical trust, and help ICs move toward the Forward Deployed Engineer model of building alongside customers.
  • Use AI automation tools and standard POV frameworks to speed up demos, environment provisioning, and repeatable assets.

Connect the field to CRM product

  • Channel technical wins, losses, and product gaps from your team to the AVP and CRM product leaders, using specific, deal-level examples.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • 6+ years in a leadership role in Solution Consulting or a comparable pre-sales or technical sales function, including managing first-line leaders and individual contributors.
  • Still credible on the deals: you can scope a POV, work through an architecture question, or join a customer call without losing the thread.
  • A consistent record of owning and delivering against ACV / NNACV or equivalent revenue-tied targets in a software or SaaS environment.
  • Experience leading distributed teams across the Nordics, Benelux, Sweden, and adjacent markets and operating effectively across cultures, languages, and time zones.
  • A working understanding of the CRM market and how AI and agentic automation are changing it.
  • Fluency with AI and automation tools and a bias toward using them to simplify how work gets done.
  • Experience moving a team from demo-centric to POV / proof-of-value-centric selling.
  • Clear, direct communication, and the ability to set a standard and hold first-line leaders to it.
  • Good operating judgement: knows when to escalate, when to decide, and when to get out of the way.
  • A talent-focused leader who can recruit, develop, and retain strong technical leaders and ICs.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or business field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Expected to travel up to 40% of the time on average, including across the Nordics, Benelux, Sweden, and adjacent markets.

Job Description

As a Cyber Security & Risk Account Executive, you are a hunter who will drive net-new SaaS license revenue across UK and European territories by expanding ServiceNow Armis, security, and identity solutions. You will prospect directly into target enterprises and verticals, qualify and own your opportunities end to end, and build the executive relationships that turn a single win into a sustained cyber and risk franchise. 

What You Will Do 

  • Generate pipeline independently: prospect directly to target customers and partners, qualify opportunities, and create new business without requiring AE introduction or inside sales support. 

  • Own the cyber strategy and portfolio opportunity for your territory across ServiceNow Armis, security, and identity solutions. 

  • Build trusted relationships with CISOs, CIOs, CROs, and CFOs, positioning ServiceNow as a strategic partner in reducing cyber risk and strengthening resilience. 

  • Articulate how ServiceNow addresses regulatory requirements, including DORA, NIS2, the EU AI Act, and the Cyber Resilience Act, across security, GRC, third-party risk, and operational resilience. 

  • Lead executive discovery and outcome-focused demonstrations in the context of each customer’s threat landscape, compliance obligations, and IT roadmap. 

  • Build compelling business cases with Inspire Value teams, including ROI models, value roadmaps, and cost-efficiency analyses. 

  • Own deal execution: solution design, commercial negotiation, contract structuring, and closure, maintaining accurate forecasts and CRM hygiene throughout. 

  • Orchestrate the ecosystem: lead virtual teams including Solution Consultants, Security Specialists, Customer Success, Partners (GSIs and boutiques), Outbound Product Management, Professional Services, and Marketing. 

  • Partner in lockstep with Core Account Executives to integrate cyber and risk workflows into broader enterprise platform strategies. 

  • Map buying groups across security, IT, risk, and business stakeholders. 

  • Serve as the executive point of accountability for cyber pipeline, forecasting, and account health in your territory. 

Qualifications

Qualifications 

  • 10+ years of enterprise software or platform sales experience, with consistent quota attainment through self-sourced pipeline generation. 

  • Proven track record of quota overachievement on enterprise deals, with quota references in local currency for each territory. 

  • Deep domain expertise in security, identity, GRC, third-party risk, or operational resilience, including regulatory compliance frameworks and their technology implications. 

  • Demonstrated experience articulating the value of AI-driven security automation and workflow insights to CISO and executive buyers. 

  • Strong alignment with enterprise sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, Value Selling, Challenger). 

  • Executive presence to operate as a peer with C-suite buyers. 

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and cross-functional leadership skills. 

  • Fluency in English and the local language of your assigned territory or territories. 

  • Regional travel required. 

Nice to Have 

  • Certifications such as CRISC, CISM, CISSP, or similar. 

  • Experience in financial services, insurance, healthcare, or other highly regulated industries. 

  • Technical implementation or solution consulting background.

Job Description

Product Team Overview

We are looking for full-time students to join our Product Management team at ServiceNow in Ireland as an Outbound Product Manager Intern. You will work on complex, high-tech problems by researching markets and customers, designing and executing analysis, and helping frame and structure how our products are positioned and taken to market. You will work closely with product, marketing, sales, and partner teams to accelerate our impact and directly contribute to our overall business strategy. This is an excellent opportunity if you want a taste of product management at a high-growth enterprise software company.

Product Management is a team sport at ServiceNow. Our structure has multiple Product Management roles working together on a product’s success. Inbound Product Managers focus on what we build. Outbound Product Managers focus on how it reaches, resonates with, and succeeds for our customers.

About the Outbound Product Manager Role

Outbound Product Managers enable Go-To-Market teams on product innovation and evangelize the product with customers, partners, and the broader market. As product experts, they serve as the bridge between inbound product management, product marketing, and the field, so that what we build lands with customers and delivers value.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Enable our go-to-market teams and partners through training, demos, and field-ready content
  • Shape product positioning and messaging for key buyer personas, in collaboration with product marketing
  • Define pricing and packaging, in collaboration with our pricing team
  • Research, package, and deliver in-depth competitive analysis for go-to-market teams
  • Provide best-practice content and guidance for customers and partners
  • Support product launches and release readiness, so the field is prepared to sell new capabilities
  • Engage directly with customers and partners through briefings, workshops, and events to understand their needs and share product direction
  • Drive customer usage and adoption programs
  • Capture market, customer, and field feedback and bring it back to inbound product management to inform roadmap priorities
  • Contribute to analyst and industry engagement, such as analyst briefings and evaluation responses
  • Occasionally provide onboarding and renewal support

You will also build an understanding of the product strategy that positions ServiceNow for success as we grow to $15B+ in revenue, and of the technical and business impacts of product decisions on customer value.

Qualifications

  • Experience using or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on a function or industry.
  • Currently enrolled full-time in a master’s degree programme (including an MBA) at an accredited university, with a focus on Product Management, Engineering, Business Management, Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Applied Sciences, or a related field.
  • Expected to graduate in spring or summer 2028, or later.
  • Ability to translate technical capabilities into clear business value for different audiences
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with comfort engaging customers, sales teams, and executives
  • Strategic mindset: able to connect product capabilities to customer value, market opportunity, and business outcomes
  • Strong prioritization skills and the discipline to focus on high-impact activities
  • Deep curiosity about customer needs, along with building customer relationships and delivering high-value solutions
  • Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills, with a data-validated, hypothesis-driven approach to decisions
  • Preferred: Experience in product marketing, sales, consulting, solution engineering, or another customer-facing role
  • Preferred: Familiarity with enterprise software, competitive analysis, or pricing and packaging
  • Preferred: Demonstrated project management experience from a previous internship, or academic or personal projects

Job Description

Role overview 

The Employee Experience Solution Sales Executive (SSE) is a sales role built for experienced enterprise sellers who have the curiosity, confidence, and technical acumen to transform a customer’s employee experience with agentic AI. You will be bilingual in the business outcomes that matter to the C-suite leaders who typically co-own employee experience – the CIO and the CHRO.  

You will play a pivotal role in shaping ServiceNow's Employee Experience (EX) business, selling EmployeeWorks and HR Service Delivery (HRSD). People who excel at this job can lead discovery sessions, leverage value-based selling, and deliver measurable business outcomes through customer-specific priorities and use cases. The SSE has the technical fluency to present, demo, and provide customers with the confidence to invest in ServiceNow EX offerings. 

What you get to do in this role 

  • Lead end-to-end EX sales cycles in partnership with the core account executive, from opportunity creation through close, adoption, and expansion. 

  • Own and sell the EX portfolio (EmployeeWorks and HRSD) across your assigned accounts. 

  • Build strategic account plans and manage pipeline to grow new business and expand with existing customers. 

  • Lead discovery, value-based conversations, technical presentations, and demos with CHROs, CIOs, and their leadership teams to uncover priorities, pain points, and accelerate EX initiatives. 

  • Identify, define, and demonstrate high-value enterprise AI assistant and HR AI use cases, and orchestrate complex enterprise deals across HR, IT, and the broader account team. 

  • Deliver applied thought leadership to CHROs and CIOs, introducing ServiceNow as the enabler of their vision rather than leading with products and features. 

  • Build durable relationships with CHROs, CIOs, HR technology leaders, IT platform owners and other leaders to increase awareness, influence, and long-term account health. 

Qualifications

What you bring 

  • 5+ years of enterprise field sales experience, with an emphasis on employee experience, HR technology, or AI-adjacent solutions preferred. 

  • Fluency in both CHRO and CIO priorities and deep domain expertise in enterprise AI assistants, agentic AI, and HR AI use cases. 

  • Experience selling enterprise AI assistant solutions (such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Glean, etc.) or HR technologies (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, UKG, etc.) is an advantage, along with a strong understanding of the broader enterprise AI and HR tech market. 

  • Experience with the ServiceNow ecosystem, platform, use cases, and target buyers is a huge plus. 

  • A track record of multi-threading accounts and opening new buying centers, including developing a second buyer across HR and IT alongside the primary one. 

  • A self-starter and hands-on thought leader, comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed product, sales, and GTM environment. 

  • Comfort operating with ambiguity and speed while the EX category, buyer expectations, product capabilities, and competitive landscape evolve, creating clarity and momentum without waiting for a perfect playbook. 

  • Excellent executive communication and relationship-building skills across both business and technical stakeholders.

Employee Experience is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce.

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.

Employee Experience is trusted by over 5.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Employee Experience was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award.

In December 2025, Employee Experience was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Employee Experience’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business.

ServiceNow

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

● Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Specialist Solution Consultants (SSCs), supporting discovery calls, live demos, and solution alignment.

● Provide oversight on the forecasting, execution, and technical qualification of deals for your region(s).

● Collaborate closely with the sales and solution consulting teams to provide support for strategic initiatives.

● Leverage your technical expertise to refine innovative solutions to solve our customers' business problems and scale them through our team.

● Collaborate directly with economic buyers on deals, coaching your team to engage with architects, developers, administrators, and other technical points of contacts to achieve a technical win.

● Conduct interactive workshops with customers to identify existing issues and propose well-crafted solutions for future enhancements.

● Evangelize Employee Experience through field, corporate, and regional marketing events.

● Develop comprehensive materials that empower the presales team to operate more efficiently and effectively, fostering reusability and knowledge sharing.

● Establish yourself as the go-to subject matter expert on a specific topic within the presales organization, driving knowledge, expertise, and specialty.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Be a seasoned professional with over 8 years of hands-on experience in pre-sales customer-facing technical roles leading to at least 3 years of pre-sales management

● Proven track record of providing exceptional support to large enterprises with a workforce of over 20,000 employees, delivering impactful solutions.

● Understanding of REST APIs and integration technologies.

● Adept at identifying areas for improvement and scaling operations across presales organizations to maximize efficiency and effectiveness.

● Innovative mindset with a genuine passion for crafting cutting-edge technical solutions that push the boundaries of what's possible.

● Demonstrated expertise in successfully delivering proof-of-concepts, showcasing the practical application of technical solutions.

● Experience working with enterprise systems such as ITSMs, ERPs, HCMs, and CRMs.

● Proven ability to lead and drive large-scale cross-functional projects, ensuring seamless collaboration and successful project outcomes.

● Exemplary presentation and communication skills, capable of conveying complex technical concepts with clarity and confidence.

● Effective at communicating deep technical insights to a diverse audience, ranging from developers and administrators to senior executives.

● Enthusiastic about understanding customers' unique use cases, identifying gaps, and tenaciously resolving issues, regardless of complexity.

● Comfortable and articulate in discussions with both technical professionals and senior leadership, adapting communication to suit the audience.

● A coach through and through, but one who can pitch in as needed at all levels of an opportunity.

● Experience with Conversational AI technologies is an added benefit.

Job Description

The Employee Experience Solution Sales Executive (SSE) is a sales role built for experienced enterprise sellers who have the curiosity, confidence, and technical acumen to transform a customer’s employee experience with agentic AI. You will be bilingual in the business outcomes that matter to the C-suite leaders who typically co-own employee experience – the CIO and the CHRO.

You will play a pivotal role in shaping ServiceNow's Employee Experience business, selling EmployeeWorks and HR Service Delivery (HRSD). Working in partnership with the core account team, you will help customers transform employee experience through AI-powered solutions and measurable business outcomes. This senior role is designed for a highly experienced enterprise seller who can lead the largest and most complex opportunities, create executive sponsorship and coordinate broad account teams through long, multi-threaded deal cycles.

What you get to do in this role

  • Lead end-to-end sales cycles in partnership with the core account executive, from opportunity creation through close, adoption and expansion.
  • Own and sell the Employee Experience portfolio, including EmployeeWorks and HRSD, across assigned accounts or territory.
  • Build account and territory plans, develop pipeline and identify new opportunities within existing and prospective customers.
  • Lead discovery, value-based conversations, technical presentations, and demos with CHROs, CIOs, and their leadership teams to uncover priorities, pain points, and accelerate EX initiatives. 
  • Identify, define, and demonstrate high-value enterprise AI assistant and HR AI use cases, and orchestrate complex enterprise deals across HR, IT, and the broader account team. 
  • Deliver applied thought leadership to CHROs and CIOs, introducing ServiceNow as the enabler of their vision rather than leading with products and features. 
  • Build durable relationships with CHROs, CIOs, HR technology leaders, IT platform owners and other leaders to increase awareness, influence, and long-term account health.
  •  Act as a senior thought partner to customers and internal stakeholders, bringing clarity and momentum to ambiguous or highly competitive opportunities.
  • Maintain rigorous qualification, forecasting and deal governance

Qualifications

What you bring

  • 10+ years of enterprise field sales experience, with an emphasis on employee experience, HR technology, or AI-adjacent solutions preferred.
  • Fluency in both CHRO and CIO priorities and deep domain expertise in enterprise AI assistants, agentic AI, and HR AI use cases.
  • Experience selling enterprise AI assistant solutions (such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Glean, etc.) or HR technologies (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, UKG, etc.) is an advantage, along with a strong understanding of the broader enterprise AI and HR tech market.
  • Experience with the ServiceNow ecosystem, platform, use cases, and target buyers is a huge plus.
  • A track record of multi-threading accounts and opening new buying centers, including developing a second buyer across HR and IT alongside the primary one.
  • A self-starter and hands-on thought leader, comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed product, sales, and GTM environment.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity and speed while the EX category, buyer expectations, product capabilities, and competitive landscape evolve, creating clarity and momentum without waiting for a perfect playbook.

Job Description

About the team

The AI Platform Go-to-Market (GTM) team, part of Strategic Operations, ensures ServiceNow’s AI Platform innovations translate into successful market launches and customer adoption. We ensure go-to-market readiness and adoption enablement across the AI Platform portfolio. Each GTM owner runs the end-to-end operating rhythm for a solution pillar, connecting Product strategy and roadmap execution with ecosystem readiness and customer adoption. We also build the shared processes, tools, and AI-native ways of working that every pillar uses.

What you get to do in this role

You will be the GTM owner for one of our AI Platform solution pillars. You will work with Inbound and Outbound Product Management, Sales, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, Partners, and Marketing to make sure your pillar’s products are ready for market and successfully adopted by customers.

Own GTM readiness and delivery for your pillar

  • Turn the product roadmap into a GTM plan. Work with Product Management to understand scope and release timing, keep the facts about what is shipping (naming, availability, what changed) accurate, and define for each audience who must be ready, by when, and what “ready” means.
  • Run the readiness process for monthly and quarterly releases and new product introductions, including plan reviews, checkpoints, and scorecards. Set regular cadences with Outbound Product Management and other stakeholders, hold each group to its commitments, and escalate risks and dependencies early.
  • Coordinate enablement, messaging, pricing and packaging changes, and partner and services readiness. Functional owners build the assets, and you make sure the right ones are scoped, scheduled, and delivered.
  • Serve as the front door for GTM requests for your pillar. Triage requests, prioritize them against the plan, and route work to the right owner.
  • Maintain a single source of truth for pillar status, risks, and choices, and prepare concise readouts for senior executives.
  • Help stakeholder groups adopt the readiness process and manage the change as the process evolves.

Drive adoption and learn from the field

  • Track adoption metrics for your pillar’s products and keep them visible to executives.
  • Work with the field and adoption teams to find what is blocking customer adoption, and feed those insights back to Product.

Grow into strategy and continuous improvement

  • Your first year will emphasize building deep pillar expertise and establishing a highly reliable GTM operating rhythm. As that foundation matures, your scope will expand toward shaping GTM priorities with Product and the field, identifying adoption opportunities and recommending changes to the GTM plan.
  • Help improve how the whole team works by contributing to shared templates, standards, and processes, and by replacing repeated manual work with automation and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Use AI tools to improve program efficiency, judgment, communication, and risk management.
  • Collaborate across pillars on launches and bundles that span more than one product area, and adapt as pillar boundaries evolve.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, we need someone who has:

  • 8+ years of related experience with a bachelor’s degree (or 6+ with a Master’s, or equivalent experience) in technical program management, GTM or product operations, strategy and operations, or product launch and readiness.
  • 4+ years running GTM readiness, product launch, or enablement programs for a SaaS company.
  • A record of guiding cross-functional work through influence across product, sales, solution consulting, marketing, customer success, and partners, including holding peers to commitments without formal authority.
  • Excellent facilitation skills in guiding planning meetings, readiness reviews, and retrospectives with senior executives (VP/SVP).
  • Familiarity with technical products. You can understand how a platform works well enough to plan around it and talk credibly with Product and the field.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You can build a plan and keep it moving while org structure and priorities change.
  • A process-focused approach, with a habit of building repeatable processes, templates, and automation so the same work isn’t redone every release.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, including executive-level narratives and presentations.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your daily work. You can describe a recurring workflow you replaced or sped up with AI, and you are curious about how enterprise AI products (agents, LLMs, workflow automation) are built and sold.
  • Availability for regular overlap with US Eastern and Pacific time zones, and willingness to travel a few times a year (e.g., Santa Clara) for team and executive meetings.

It would be great if you also have:

  • Experience with ServiceNow or another enterprise platform company.
  • Exposure to agentic AI concepts such as MCP, orchestration, and evaluation.
  • Experience launching new products, pricing and packaging changes, or sales and partner enablement.
  • A professional certification such as PMP.

Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The Employee Experience Sr Solution Sales Executive (SSE) is a sales role built for experienced enterprise sellers who have the curiosity, confidence, and technical acumen to transform a customer’s employee experience with agentic AI. You will be bilingual in the business outcomes that matter to the C-suite leaders who typically co-own employee experience – the CIO and the CHRO.

You will play a pivotal role in shaping ServiceNow's Employee Experience business, selling EmployeeWorks and HR Service Delivery (HRSD). Working in partnership with the core account team, you will help customers transform employee experience through AI-powered solutions and measurable business outcomes. This senior role is designed for a highly experienced enterprise seller who can lead the largest and most complex opportunities, create executive sponsorship and coordinate broad account teams through long, multi-threaded deal cycles.

What you get to do in this role

  • Lead end-to-end sales cycles in partnership with the core account executive, from opportunity creation through close, adoption and expansion.
  • Own and sell the Employee Experience portfolio, including EmployeeWorks and HRSD, across assigned accounts or territory.
  • Build account and territory plans, develop pipeline and identify new opportunities within existing and prospective customers.
  • Lead discovery, value-based conversations, technical presentations, and demos with CHROs, CIOs, and their leadership teams to uncover priorities, pain points, and accelerate EX initiatives. 
  • Identify, define, and demonstrate high-value enterprise AI assistant and HR AI use cases, and orchestrate complex enterprise deals across HR, IT, and the broader account team. 
  • Deliver applied thought leadership to CHROs and CIOs, introducing ServiceNow as the enabler of their vision rather than leading with products and features. 
  • Build durable relationships with CHROs, CIOs, HR technology leaders, IT platform owners and other leaders to increase awareness, influence, and long-term account health.
  •  Act as a senior thought partner to customers and internal stakeholders, bringing clarity and momentum to ambiguous or highly competitive opportunities.
  • Maintain rigorous qualification, forecasting and deal governance

Qualifications

What you bring

  • 10+ years of enterprise field sales experience, with an emphasis on employee experience, HR technology, or AI-adjacent solutions preferred.
  • Fluency in both CHRO and CIO priorities and deep domain expertise in enterprise AI assistants, agentic AI, and HR AI use cases.
  • Experience selling enterprise AI assistant solutions (such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Glean, etc.) or HR technologies (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, UKG, etc.) is an advantage, along with a strong understanding of the broader enterprise AI and HR tech market.
  • Experience with the ServiceNow ecosystem, platform, use cases, and target buyers is a huge plus.
  • A track record of multi-threading accounts and opening new buying centers, including developing a second buyer across HR and IT alongside the primary one.
  • A self-starter and hands-on thought leader, comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed product, sales, and GTM environment.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity and speed while the EX category, buyer expectations, product capabilities, and competitive landscape evolve, creating clarity and momentum without waiting for a perfect playbook.
  • Excellent executive communication and relationship-building skills across both business and technical stakeholders.

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity,  veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.  

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance. 

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

What you get to do in this role:

The Advanced Technology Group (ATG) at ServiceNow is a customer-focused innovation group building intelligent software and smart user experiences using existing and latest advanced technologies to enable end-to-end, industry-leading work experiences for customers. We are a group of researchers, applied scientists, engineers, and product managers with a dual mission. We build and evolve the AI platform, and partner with teams to build products and end-to-end AI-powered work experiences. In equal measure, we lay the foundations, research, experiment, and de-risk AI technologies that unlock new work experiences in the future.

You will play a major part in building AI and Machine Learning (ML) solutions that transform the user experience and workflow efficiency of enterprise services. Traditional analytical tools tend to require a technically knowledgeable user to produce even simple results. We are taking a completely fresh approach with the expectation that any user, regardless of technical knowledge, can use the AI/ML solutions we develop to operate the services in the enterprise setting in a thoughtful and scalable manner. We are just getting started with our early-adopter customers and we need your help in building and making available an amazing range of solutions to our 5k+ enterprise customers around the world.

  • Build the best cloud-based AI/ML solutions to power intelligent enterprise services
  • Collaborate daily with a team of like-minded developers, product managers and quality engineers to produce quality software
  • Work with product owners to understand detailed requirements and own your code from design, implementation, testing and delivery of high-quality solutions to our users

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience leveraging or critically evaluating how AI can be integrated into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This includes using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's impact on the business or industry.
  • Expertise in Java or Python, OOP, Design Patterns, time and space-efficient algorithms
  • Experience building new products that use challenging algorithms
  • Expertise in coding efficient, object-oriented, modularized and quality software
  • Knowledge of core AI/ML techniques and algorithms
  • Knowledge of unit testing, profiling, and code tuning

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

What you get to do in this role:  

The Advisory Solution Consultant, Employee Experience is a technical & business consultant with the advanced ability to develop, position and provide industry and product specific solutions during sales cycles while achieving quarterly and annual sales goals for an assigned territory.  

  • Partner closely with ServiceNow Account Executives as the Employee Experience product, AI, and domain expert, supporting complex sales cycles and driving deal strategy across one or more industries.  

  • Lead customer discovery sessions and workshops to understand business challenges, technical environments, and success criteria, aligning Moveworks capabilities to customer needs and outcomes.  

  • Deliver compelling, persona- and value-based product demonstrations that “explain by showing” how Moveworks and ServiceNow together automate work and improve employee experiences.  

  • Facilitate technical and architectural workshops covering Moveworks’ AI/ML approach, integrations, security, and platform architecture, in the context of the customer’s ServiceNow environment.  

  • Partner with Business Value Services to build data-driven business cases, prioritize use cases, and articulate measurable ROI using reports, calculators, and insights.  

  • Define customer success criteria and lead the design, execution, and management of end-to-end proof-of-concept engagements.  

  • Develop trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and client partners, guiding strategic programs such as roadmap alignment, customer journey mapping, and outcome planning in top accounts.  

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure a smooth transition from pre-sales to post-sales by documenting requirements and facilitating a clean handoff to Customer Success teams.  

  • Provide continuous feedback to Product Management on customer needs, competitive insights, and market trends to help influence product direction and strategy.  

  • Stay current on competitive positioning and market differentiation, clearly articulating Moveworks’ value within the broader ServiceNow ecosystem.  

  • Contribute to team excellence by sharing best practices, reusable assets, and continuously improving demos, presentations, and sales processes to be more scalable and impactful.  

  • Support field and marketing initiatives, including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and industry events.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have: 

  • Experience applying and evaluating AI in enterprise environments, including integrating AI into workflows, decision-making, and problem-solving through automation, AI-powered tools, and data-driven insights.

We are seeking a Solution Consultant to partner with Sales and help enterprise customers address complex security, identity, access, asset visibility, exposure management, and risk challenges. 

In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical and business advisor, leading discovery, solution design, product demonstrations, proof-of-value engagements, and customer validation activities. The ideal candidate has strong cybersecurity knowledge, practical enterprise networking experience, strong communication skills, and a proven ability to support complex enterprise sales cycles. 

Responsibilities 

  • Partner with Sales to lead technical discovery, solution design, and customer validation.

  • Lead technical training sessions based on customer use cases and POV findings. 
  • Support marketing events, conferences, webinars, and speaking engagements. 
  • Collaborate with Product, Enablement, Marketing, Customer Success, and Support teams to share field insights and improve execution. 
  • Travel as required, typically 25–50%, depending on region and business needs. 

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering, Pre-Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or a related technical role. 
  • 5+ years of customer-facing technical, pre-sales, or customer support experience. 
  • Experience supporting complex cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise platform sales cycles with enterprise customers. 
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts, identity and access, governance and risk, and security operations. 
  • Required strong working knowledge of enterprise networking concepts, including routing, switching, VLANs, subnetting, firewalls, DNS, NAT, and network segmentation.

  • Ability to understand and explain how security platforms integrate with customer network environments to collect data, provide visibility, and support technical validation during demos, POVs, and POCs. 
  • Strong presentation, storytelling, and executive communication skills. 
  • Ability to engage effectively with technical practitioners, business stakeholders, and executive buyers. 
  • Demonstrated track record of contributing to technical wins, deal progression, and successful customer outcomes. 
  • BS degree in Computer Science, MIS, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience. 

Preferred Experience

  • Background in Security Operations or security engineering 
  • Experience with asset discovery across IoT, OT, or IoMT environments 
  • Exposure to vulnerability management or risk-based vulnerability programs 
  • Security, cloud, or relevant technical certifications preferred 
  • Linux or Python scripting experience

  • Delivery of high-quality demos, POVs, and POCs that advance pipelines. 
  • Build trusted-advisor relationships with customers and Sales partners. 
  • Demonstrates strong technical credibility across complex opportunities. 
  • Connects technical solutions to measurable business outcomes. 
  • Contributes to improved win rates, stronger deal quality, and scalable Solution Consulting execution.

  • Experience working for an innovative technology company, ideally with an AI component, and a strong understanding of AI technologies, requirements, and architecture. 

  • Broad and deep sales leadership experience, ideally across multiple geographies; prior experience engaging at executive level is preferred. 

  • Demonstrated success in recruiting, coaching, developing, and retaining exceptional sales talent.

ServiceNow is opening a new AI engineering hub in West Palm Beach and hiring the founding leaders who will define its culture, teams, and technical direction from day one. If you've wanted the ownership of a startup with the scale of a global enterprise — this is that moment. 

Why this role: 

Engineering leadership roles that let you build a site from scratch — with a real charter, real resources, and real company-wide impact — are rare at any scale. This isn't a "manage the org" role. It's a "create the org" role. 

For leaders who want to leave a mark on both the product and the people who build it, this is the opportunity. 

About the Team: 

You'll join the AI Engineering and Delivery team— the group building the agentic AI and enterprise-scale systems that power Now Assist, AI Agents, and the AI-driven experiences running inside 85% of the Fortune 500. We build AI as foundational infrastructure, not a feature layer. 

About the role:  

Build and lead a world-class Platform Engineering organization in West Palm Beach that powers AI-native enterprise experiences across web and mobile surfaces. This leader will hire exceptional engineering and AI talent, establish an AI-forward engineering culture, and deliver scalable web, mobile, and AI platform capabilities for purpose-built enterprise applications.  

Build an AI-Native Engineering Culture in West Palm Beach  

  • Establish and grow the Platform Engineering organization in West Palm Beach as a strategic hub for AI platform innovation.  
  • Recruit, develop, and retain excellent platform engineering talent including, but not limited to JavaScript, iOS, Android, Java, and Python.  
  • Embed AI-assisted development, automated quality systems, agentic workflows, and rapid experimentation into day-to-day engineering practices.  
  • Create a high-performance culture centered on ownership, technical excellence, customer impact, and continuous learning.  

Lead Mobile Platform Strategy and Execution  

  • Own the technical roadmap for enterprise platform capabilities including Web, Desktop, Android and iOS.  
  • Establish and run on-call rotations, incident response processes, and a blameless postmortem culture that drives reliability improvements. 
  • Define reusable frameworks, SDKs, and platform patterns that accelerate application development across multiple product teams.  
  • Partner with Product, Design, AI, Infrastructure, and Business leaders to deliver differentiated mobile experiences.  
  • Drive excellence in performance, reliability, security, scalability, and operational rigor across the mobile platform.  

Architect Enterprise Mobile Experiences  

  • Design platform capabilities for purpose-built enterprise applications across customer service, field service, operations, and productivity workflows.  
  • Lead architecture for synchronization, offline-first experiences, notifications, inbox experiences, real-time interactions, and workflow execution.  
  • Ensure applications perform reliably in low-connectivity and offline environments while meeting enterprise-grade security, privacy, and compliance requirements.  
  • Create seamless experiences across mobile clients, AI services, platform capabilities, and enterprise workflows.  

Provide Technical Leadership  

  • Lead critical architecture reviews and complex technical decisions across mobile, platform integration, and application layers.  
  • Own the mobile build and delivery pipeline, including CI/CD reliability, build speed and test infrastructure. 
  • Establish standards for observability, telemetry, mobile performance benchmarking, release quality, and production readiness.  
  • Mentor Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, and senior technical contributors.  
  • Advance mobile innovation through AI-enabled workflows, modern development practices, and strong engineering fundamentals.  

Qualifications

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience with significant experience leading mobile engineering organizations (Android and iOS).  
  • 3+ years leading engineering managers or multi-team organizations.  
  • Strong technical depth in mobile architecture, APIs, distributed systems, cloud-native services, networking, security, data synchronization, and MAM/MDM enterprise integrations. 
  • Track record building and scaling enterprise-grade mobile applications or mobile platforms used at large scale.  
  • Experience managing Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders. 

Specific AI skills we value  

  • Experience building or integrating generative AI, LLM-powered experiences, AI agents, or copilots into mobile or enterprise applications.  
  • Working knowledge of RAG, prompt engineering, agent orchestration, tool use, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and AI safety principles.  
  • Familiarity with AI platforms and frameworks such as Azure AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or comparable ecosystems.  
  • Understanding of on-device AI patterns, small language models, speech or vision models, real-time inference constraints, and mobile latency tradeoffs.  
  • Experience applying AI to engineering productivity, including code generation, test generation, automated review, incident analysis, or quality automation.  
  • Ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, secure, enterprise-grade mobile workflows.

locations: New York, New York, United States
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About the Role 

As a AI Agent Engineer (AIAE), specializing in partnership initiatives at Moveworks, you’ll be responsible for ensuring a successful technical delivery of the Moveworks platform by our partners within the Partner ecosystem. You serve as the technical backbone of Moveworks partner projects. Partners lead day-to-day delivery, project management, customer communications, and on-time, on-budget execution. We support them through stage gate sign-offs, technical troubleshooting, escalations to product and engineering and assist on future product roadmap discussions and enhancements. You are a critical and technical individual that operates at the intersection of Customer Success, Product Management, and Engineering. 

Your primary mission is to provide technical oversight of partner projects and guide partners through translating complex customer business process challenges into innovative, high-impact AI solutions built on the Moveworks platform. This role provides full-stack ownership of technical success on partner projects, allowing you to not only advise and guide partners through deploying capabilities in the current product but also directly influencing the product's evolution by ensuring that learnings are folded back into our core platform. 

Core Responsibilities & Impact: 

  • Full-stack Ownership: Collaborate deeply with partners throughout the entire delivery lifecycle of AI Agents on the Moveworks Platform: Vision-Lock, Solution Design/Architecture, Building, Tuning, and launch.  
  • Technical Subject Matter Expert: Advise and consult partners through complex requirements and design integrations into the Moveworks platform in an innovative, secure and performant manner. 
  • Product Documentation: Identify and remedy product knowledge gaps on partner projects, owning the full cycle of product knowledge gaps on partner projects. 
  • Product Partnership: Work closely with engineering and product teams on new product rollouts and help drive product decision making by synthesizing on-the-ground customer feedback and technical gaps. 

About You 

You are a technical generalist & a “do-er” with a deep, intuitive understanding of complex systems and a relentless focus on customer impact. You thrive in a dynamic, high-growth environment where you can both build and lead. 

  • Technical Acumen & Curiosity Mindset: You are a rapid learner with high technical aptitude and strong generalist with instincts to quickly learn both new technical and business domains. You possess a curiosity to understand details from both a technical and a business perspective i.e: trying to understand: "what happens under the hood?" and “why is this done that way?” 
  • Technical Mastery: Strong grasp of API based systems integration, LLM-based systems design including prompt engineering, context engineering, and data modeling. 
  • Product Excellence Obsession: You have product taste/judgement and are obsessed with building and delivering exceptional product experiences for users. 
  • Reusability: You share what works with the broader team, and help generalize solutions into reusable templates. 
  • Customer-Centric Soft Skills: You have the communication skills required for deep customer partnerships, and you genuinely enjoy working directly with customers. You are compelled to develop and deliver compelling solution narratives through creation of high-quality artifacts (e.g. architecture diagrams, solution proposals, product documentation, SOWs) as well as engaging presentations and demos, tailored to the technical and business awareness of the audience. 
  • Strategic Guidance & Influence: Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, providing strategic direction to help them overcome technical and organizational obstacles. This includes developing and delivering context-specific solutions, as well as upskilling customer teams to leverage the product independently. 
  • Entrepreneurial Drive/Grit: You aspire to a high-growth career path, actively seeking to gain maximum exposure and learning across engineering, product, and business functions as quickly as possible. You lean into navigating through challenging business situations or antiquated legacy systems. 
  • Ecosystem Partnership: You possess a strong sense of personal accountability to both customers and internal teammates who rely on your expertise. 

Qualifications

Required: 

  • 8+ years of experience in a technical role, such as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Customer Success Engineer, Solutions Architect, Consulting Engineer or Software Engineer. 
  • Proven ability to operate across multiple business functions or technical domains, demonstrating adaptability, quick-to-learn, and broad technical skills. 
  • Demonstrable experience designing, building and launching full-stack workflows, and automations, leveraging REST APIs, iPaaS automation (Workato, Azure Functions, AWS Lambdas, ServiceNow Flow Designer), or generic scripting (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Golang, etc.). 
  • You possess a bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field 
  • You are willing to travel up to 25% of the time 

Preferred: 

  • Familiarity with enterprise platforms (e.g. ServiceNow, Jira Service Desk, Zendesk, Workday, Okta, etc.) is a plus 
  • You have familiarity with Linux and Windows environments and using the command line. 
  • You have a great track record of driving successful technical adoption with medium to large-sized enterprise projects 
  • You stay current with the latest AI tools and frameworks, and think about how to apply them thoughtfully to work smarter and build reliable, scalable solutions. 

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $166,500 - $291,400, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce. 

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.=

Moveworks is trusted by over 5.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award. 

In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Moveworks’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business. 

Come join us!

ServiceNow

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Job Description

We are looking for self-driven individuals to join our Moveworks Technical Support team, supporting a sophisticated Moveworks ServiceNow platform powered by machine learning, enterprise search (RAG), and agentic workflows. This role sits at the intersection of understanding a complex AI driven product and clearly communicating its behavior and value to our growing customer base.

Our platform enables users to not only find answers but also automate tasks end to end through AI agents that reason, plan, and execute actions across enterprise systems . As a result, customer questions range from configuration guidance to deeper investigations into why the assistant behaved a certain way spanning both educational support and complex debugging of AI behavior, integrations, and workflows.

An ideal candidate is curious, proactive, and thrives in a fast-paced environment, with a strong appetite for learning and solving complex technical problems.

What you get to do in this role:   

  • Provide day to day technical support to customers using the AI Assistant platform to drive automation, search, and workflow execution

  • Troubleshoot issues across:

    • AI responses (RAG based retrieval and answer quality)

    • Agentic workflows (planning, execution, and action failures)

    • API integrations with enterprise systems

  • Communicate clearly with customers and simplify complex AI/system behaviors

  • Identify root causes of issues using logs, telemetry, and system analysis (e.g., Kibana, Grafana)

  • Identify defects, document them clearly, and track them in defect management systems

  • Ensure timely responses to customers and adherence to SLAs

  • Triage support tickets and escalate to appropriate teams (Customer Success Engineering, Product, Engineering, etc.)

  • Analyze API failures and integration issues across connected enterprise systems

  • Perform configuration changes to optimize assistant behavior and fulfill customer requirements

  • Identify recurring issues and contribute to internal and customer facing knowledge bases

  • Reproduce, document, and communicate bugs, outages, and workflow failures effectively

Qualifications

Qualifications and technical skills that will lead to success: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field

  • 2-5 years of experience in customer-facing technical support or similar roles

  • Experience working with ServiceNow platform and enterprise integrations

  • Strong understanding of REST APIs and debugging integration issues

  • Experience working with automated, bi-directional integrations between systems

  • Understanding of system design concepts to distinguish between configuration issues and product limitations

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to analyze logs and monitoring tools (e.g., Kibana, Grafana)

  • Strong written communication skills and ability to simplify complex technical concepts

  • Ability to debug issues across workflows, APIs, and system interactions

  • Experience reproducing, documenting, and communicating bugs effectively

  • Passion for technology with a strong desire to learn and grow

Nice to Haves:

  • Familiarity with AI/ML systems, especially RAG-based search or conversational AI

  • Understanding of agent-based or workflow automation systems

  • Familiarity with configuration file formats such as XML, JSON, and YAML

  • Experience with logging and observability tools such as Kibana and Grafana

  • Basic coding skills, preferably Python

  • Knowledge of distributed version control systems (Git is a plus)

  • Experience with enterprise IT platforms (Okta, Workday, Google Workspace, Microsoft Active Directory)

descriptionHtml:
