Job Description

We are the AI Experience Framework (AIUX) team that builds the platform that powers ServiceNow's AI-first user interfaces. Using modern Lit-based web components, AIUX builds modular, reusable conversational experiences that serve as the technical foundation for conversation-first applications like Employee Slate. This role owns full-stack architectural decisions in a modern JavaScript/component-driven environment, working across AI integration, performance scale, and multi-team coordination — spanning our SSR runtime (server-rendered Lit components, versioned request routing, isolated execution pools) and the ServiceNow Glide platform layer it integrates with.

What you'll do:

  • Work with product owners to understand detailed requirements and drive the full development lifecycle
  • Build software that is simple to use, allowing customers to extend and customize functionality to meet their specific needs
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of new products and features while enhancing the existing product suite
  • Apply advanced knowledge of data structures, algorithms, OO design, design patterns, and performance/scale considerations
  • Raise the engineering bar through architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and technical direction

Qualifications

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • Completed no higher than a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar field
  • 1 - 3 years of professional software engineering experience with deep expertise in JavaScript and substantial experience in Java or a similar OO language (C++, C#, Go)
  • Experience using JavaScript and the Web as a platform, reusability, and componentization
  • Demonstrated experience with modern UI frameworks: Angular, React, Vue, or Lit
  • Demonstrated knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and performance/scale considerations
  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience with relational databases: development, troubleshooting, and performance optimization
  • Demonstrated experience in server-side rendering and hydration, including the failure modes specific to isomorphic rendering (markup mismatches, browser-API leakage into server code)
  • Demonstrated systems-level Node.js experience: process/worker isolation (V8 isolates or equivalent sandboxing), HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 semantics, reverse proxying, and designing for concurrent versioned rollouts
  • Comfortable working across a JVM/Maven backend (Java, ServiceNow Glide platform conventions) in addition to a Node/TypeScript SSR stack
  • Demonstrated experience as a senior individual contributor responsible for code quality, and mentoring
  • Exposure to multiple technology stacks: Cloud Dev, Platforms, Web Dev, Frameworks, service-oriented architecture

Preferred — AIUX Framework specific

  • Experience with build systems that emit multiple targets from one component source (server bundles vs. code-split browser bundles)
  • Hands-on experience operating services in Kubernetes: deployment configuration, scaling, rollout/rollback, and incident response
  • Experience building and maintaining observability tooling (Grafana dashboards, Prometheus alerting) for production systems

Job Description

About the Role

Our AI Search platform runs on search engines, and we are evolving that foundation over time, including moving from an embedded Apache Lucene engine toward OpenSearch. As a Staff engineer, you will own significant features end to end across our stateless search service and the search engine layer, including faceting, deep paging, embeddings, and field-level security. You will work closely with the hiring manager and senior engineers to shape the technical direction of the platform.

What You’ll Do

  • Own complex features end to end, from design through production operation, across the search service and the search engine layer.
  • Drive search relevancy, text analysis, and analyzer design, which are top priorities for the team. This includes Lucene-level work where it matters.
  • Contribute to the design of search backends, including abstractions that let one service run on more than one engine.
  • Lead design reviews for your areas. Weigh backward compatibility, reindexing cost, and migration risk before code lands, and require measured evidence for quality and latency claims.
  • Keep the test suite reliable. Diagnose and fix flaky integration tests rather than working around them.
  • Operate and improve the platform on Kubernetes, with attention to infrastructure and reliability as a second priority.
  • Mentor engineers and raise the bar on design and code review.

Qualifications

What you bring:

  • 7+ years of software engineering, with a track record of owning complex features in distributed systems.
  • Deep working knowledge of search relevancy, analyzers and tokenization, and Lucene or a comparable search engine.
  • Strong Java skills (we use Java 21 and Maven) and a habit of writing clear, well-tested code.
  • Experience designing features that must stay correct across versions, including index compatibility, schema changes, and rolling upgrades.
  • Influence on technical direction through written design, not only through code.
  • Clear, direct communication in design reviews, including pushback when a proposal is risky.

Strongly preferred:

  • Hands-on experience with a search engine such as OpenSearch or Elasticsearch in a Kubernetes environment, including plugin development.
  • Experience with kNN and vector search, embeddings, reranking, or learning-to-rank.
  • Experience with faceting, aggregations, or large-result paging at scale.
  • Experience with multilingual search, such as tokenizers for non-English languages.
  • Experience with field-level security or access control in search results.

We’re the Component Library team. We build reusable, AI-native UI components for product teams and customers across the ServiceNow AI Platform. We work closely with product managers, designers, and workflow and platform teams to take components from definition through release.

What You'll Do

  • Own the delivery of reusable UI components end to end, from definition through release.
  • Partner with designers and product managers from definition through verification, weighing trade-offs between user value, complexity, and delivery timelines.
  • Design and build components that are accessible (WCAG), performant, and secure in the browser, including protection against cross-site scripting (XSS) and unsafe rendering.
  • Define testing strategies and automation, covering functional, regression, integration, accessibility, and performance testing within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Review pull requests and raise the team's bar for code quality, maintainability, and testability.
  • Apply AI coding tools throughout the development lifecycle and review AI-generated code for correctness, security, accessibility, and performance before merging.
  • Improve the team's tooling and development workflows. Mentor engineers and share best practices for AI-assisted development and code quality.
  • Lead defect burn-down efforts, resolve complex customer issues, and support teams integrating our components.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software development experience building modern web applications.
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tools and applying sound judgment when evaluating AI-generated output.
  • Deep expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, and strong experience with modern UI frameworks such as Lit, React, Angular, or Vue.
  • Experience building reusable components or component libraries, with a passion for the web platform and component-based development.
  • Experience integrating with backend APIs (REST, GraphQL) and familiarity with server-side technologies such as Java or Node.js.
  • Strong knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG), front-end performance optimization, browser security, and modern testing practices.
  • Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, and design patterns.

Job Description

The Senior ER Partner provides advice and counsel on performance management, interpersonal conflict, conduct issues, leadership concerns, and other complex employee relations matters. The Senior ER Partner supports investigations and grievance processes, ensuring they are conducted in a thorough, neutral, and timely manner, and partners with Global Employment Law as appropriate. The role also identifies broader employee relations themes and trends across the enterprise, partnering cross-functionally with Centers of Excellence (COEs) to recommend and implement consistent, compassionate, and scalable improvements to the employee experience. What You Get To Do • Bring our People Pact to life by supporting the delivery of Employee Relations programs to managers and employees; serve as a first point of contact for managers regarding performance concerns, conflict management, and other Employee Relations matters; and maintain accurate and timely Employee Relations case records within the designated case management platform (ERCM). • Advise and counsel managers and HR partners on the enterprise performance philosophy and performance-related matters; provide relevant resources, tools, and guidance on best practices; and coach managers on providing and meaningfully documenting feedback and performance conversations. • Act as a key thought partner to HRBPs, business leaders, and managers on interpersonal challenges, conduct issues, leadership concerns, and other complex employee relations matters; provide objective, practical, and empathetic guidance to help drive appropriate outcomes. • Conduct low- to moderate-complexity investigations, grievance processes, and disciplinary processes, ensuring appropriate documentation is created and maintained and providing actionable recommendations and insights to relevant stakeholders. • Play a key role in maintaining the integrity and effectiveness of Employee Relations case management practices; create and maintain accurate case records, case notes, statuses, and outcomes; conduct periodic data-quality reviews and audits; and leverage reporting and dashboards to identify trends, themes, risks, and opportunities for ER intervention and process improvement. • Support the development and expansion of training and enablement materials for managers and employees; collaborate with cross-functional partners to identify areas where additional enablement is needed; and contribute to content that improves the employee experience and supports ServiceNow's workplace culture. • Partner with the Global Employment Law team to provide policy, process, and program guidance to employees and managers, as appropriate; develop expertise in relevant local and regional employment legislation and policy interpretation to help ensure compliance. • Play an active role in standardizing, digitizing, and continuously improving Employee Relations processes through the ServiceNow platform, automation, and GenAI capabilities. Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort and duplication, strengthen data quality, and create scalable and consistent ER experiences. Support the testing, adoption, and continuous improvement of technology-enabled ER capabilities. • Act as a culture champion, regionally and globally, partnering with HR and business stakeholders to support a highly engaged, inclusive, and positive workplace culture. • Contribute to cross-functional HR projects, programs, reporting, and other initiatives, as required. Who You Are • You have demonstrated ability to provide feedback and coaching to employees and leaders at every level, leading with empathy while helping others reflect, grow, and navigate workplace challenges. You are able to influence effectively and help drive situations toward appropriate outcomes. • You have excellent interpersonal, communication, empathy, and active listening skills, with the ability to adapt your communication style to effectively support and influence employees and leaders at various levels of the organization. • You have strong analytical capability, with the ability to interpret ER case data, identify patterns and emerging themes, and translate insights into practical recommendations for ER, HR, and business stakeholders. • You have experience leveraging AI and GenAI tools to improve work processes, decision-making, knowledge management, reporting, or employee experiences, and can identify responsible and practical opportunities for AI-enabled automation and process improvement, with appropriate consideration for confidentiality, data privacy, and human judgment. • You have strong learning agility and the ability to navigate ambiguous, fluid, and rapidly evolving situations with flexibility, composure, and sound judgment, while effectively managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. • You are committed to valuing diversity and contributing to an equitable and inclusive working environment, with the ability to assess situations objectively, remain neutral, and work toward fair and reasonable outcomes.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressive, client-facing Employee Relations experience, including working closely with business leaders, managers, and HR partners to navigate performance management, employee conduct, workplace conflict, and other complex employee matters; experience conducting workplace investigations and/or grievance and disciplinary processes strongly preferred.
  • Experience using Employee Relations case management, HR service delivery, or similar case management platforms; experience with the ServiceNow platform is strongly preferred. Demonstrated ability to maintain accurate case data and leverage dashboards and reporting to identify trends and actionable insights.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and experience navigating HRIS and people analytics tools such as Workday and Tableau; demonstrated ability to leverage technology to improve ER processes and employee experiences.

The Employee Experience business at ServiceNow is on an explosive growth trajectory and this individual will be at the center of driving ambitious targets.   • Set quality standards and ensure Employee Experience campaigns deliver exceptional work that meets brand standards and in-market goals across regions 
  • Guide and mentor campaign managers and cross-functional partners, sharing best practices and building capability across the team

  • Influence and drive adoption of campaign standards and processes with partner teams, ensuring smooth execution across dependencies 
  • Communicate campaign strategy, progress, and results clearly and persuasively to senior stakeholders 

Campaign Performance & Optimization

  • Provide regular performance updates, insights, and recommendations to the VP of Solution Marketing and senior stakeholders to drive continuous improvement

Experience & Skills

  • Proven track record leading complex, multi-channel campaigns with multiple stakeholders and significant budgets, including launches targeting buyers and line-of-business leaders 
  • Deep familiarity with full-funnel marketing across digital, email, content, and field marketing, applied to buying journeys 
  • Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional campaign work, influence without direct authority, and build capability across teams supporting go-to-market 
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and balance strategic direction with operational excellence
